1) İlk iş: Tıklanma oranını artır (ikon + thumbnail + başlık)

  • İkon: Tek odaklı, parlak renk, büyük karakter/yüz ifadesi, az detay.
  • Thumbnail: “En zor bölüm”, “lava kaçışı”, “100 stage” gibi net vaat.
  • Başlık: Kısa ve aranabilir: “Mega Obby 150 Stages (Easy to Hard)”
  • Açıklamaya anahtar kelime koy: obby, parkour, easy, hard, stages.
Hedef CTR: %3+ A/B test: haftada 2 yeni görsel

2) İlk 60 saniyeyi düzelt (oyuncu kaçışını engelle)

  • Spawn olur olmaz ne yapacağını gösteren kısa UI: “Checkpoint’e git”.
  • İlk 5 bölüm çok kolay olsun; oyuncu başarı hissini hızlı alsın.
  • Her 3-5 bölümde ödül: trail, pet coin, title, efekt.
  • Ölünce bekleme olmasın; hızlı respawn.
Hedef 1 dk kalma: %45+ Hedef ortalama süre: 6+ dk

3) Keşfete çıkmak için sinyaller

  • Düzenli güncelleme: haftada 1 küçük update notu paylaş.
  • Favori ve beğeni isteme popup’ı: 3. checkpoint sonrası.
  • Arkadaşla oynama teşviki: party bonus / friend reward.
  • Sunucu doluluk ve aktiflik için başlangıçta 8-12 oyunculuk hedef.

4) Dış trafik getir (ilk kıvılcım şart)

  • TikTok/YouTube Shorts: 10-20 sn “imkansız parkur” klipleri.
  • Discord topluluklarında (spam değil) test oyuncusu bul.
  • Küçük Roblox içerik üreticilerine ücretsiz özel kod/alan ver.
  • İmkan varsa düşük bütçe Roblox sponsor reklam test et.

5) 7 günlük mini plan

Gün 1: İkon + 2 thumbnail yenile
Gün 2: İlk 10 stage kolaylaştır + onboarding UI
Gün 3: Ödül sistemi ve checkpoint akışı
Gün 4: Oyun açıklaması/etiket SEO düzenle
Gün 5: 3 kısa video paylaş
Gün 6: Küçük update + duyuru
Gün 7: Analiz: hangi stage’de bırakıyorlar?

Hızlı kontrol listesi

Not: Keşfet genelde ani olmaz. 2-4 hafta tutarlı optimizasyon gerekir.

response:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=no,viewport-fit=cover" />
  <title>Cut the Rope - Mobile Level</title>
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg1: #8fe9ff;
      --bg2: #5fc8ff;
      --panel: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
      --text: #1d2a38;
    }
    html, body {
      margin: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg1), var(--bg2));
      touch-action: none;
      font-family: "Trebuchet MS", "Arial Rounded MT Bold", system-ui, sans-serif;
    }
    canvas {
      display: block;
      width: 100vw;
      height: 100vh;
      touch-action: none;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  let w = 0, h = 0, dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);

  const game = {
    state: 'playing', // playing, win, lose
    starsCollected: 0,
    hintTimer: 6,
    elapsed: 0,
    lastTime: 0,
    swipeTrail: [],
    pointerDown: false,
    ui: { restart: {x:0,y:0,w:88,h:40} }
  };

  let candy, ropes, anchors, stars, blower, monster, spikes, particles;

  function resize() {
    w = window.innerWidth;
    h = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = Math.floor(w * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.floor(h * dpr);
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    setupLevel();
  }

  function setupLevel() {
    game.state = 'playing';
    game.starsCollected = 0;
    game.hintTimer = 7;
    game.elapsed = 0;
    game.swipeTrail.length = 0;
    particles = [];

    const cx = w * 0.5;
    const cy = h * 0.34;
    candy = {
      x: cx, y: cy,
      vx: 0, vy: 0,
      r: Math.max(16, Math.min(24, w * 0.05)),
      m: 1,
      angle: 0,
      angVel: 0
    };

    anchors = [
      { x: w * 0.24, y: h * 0.16 },
      { x: w * 0.76, y: h * 0.20 }
    ];

    ropes = anchors.map(a => {
      const dx = candy.x - a.x;
      const dy = candy.y - a.y;
      return {
        anchor: a,
        length: Math.hypot(dx, dy) * 1.02,
        active: true
      };
    });

    stars = [
      { x: w * 0.30, y: h * 0.47, r: 16, got: false, pulse: Math.random() * 6 },
      { x: w * 0.74, y: h * 0.58, r: 16, got: false, pulse: Math.random() * 6 },
      { x: w * 0.50, y: h * 0.72, r: 16, got: false, pulse: Math.random() * 6 }
    ];

    blower = {
      x: w * 0.17,
      y: h * 0.70,
      r: Math.max(34, Math.min(58, w * 0.11)),
      dirX: 0.93,
      dirY: -0.36,
      power: 820
    };

    monster = {
      x: w * 0.5,
      y: h - Math.max(70, h * 0.10),
      bodyR: Math.max(64, Math.min(84, w * 0.18)),
      mouthR: Math.max(30, Math.min(42, w * 0.09)),
      chew: 0
    };

    spikes = {
      y: h - 24,
      h: 20,
      gapL: monster.x - monster.mouthR - 16,
      gapR: monster.x + monster.mouthR + 16
    };

    game.ui.restart = { x: w - 98, y: 16, w: 82, h: 38 };
  }

  function pointInRect(px, py, r) {
    return px >= r.x && px <= r.x + r.w && py >= r.y && py <= r.y + r.h;
  }

  function segIntersect(a,b,c,d) {
    const cross = (p1,p2,p3) => (p2.x-p1.x)*(p3.y-p1.y) - (p2.y-p1.y)*(p3.x-p1.x);
    const c1 = cross(a,b,c);
    const c2 = cross(a,b,d);
    const c3 = cross(c,d,a);
    const c4 = cross(c,d,b);
    return ((c1===0 && c2===0) ? overlap(a,b,c,d) : (c1*c2<=0 && c3*c4<=0));
  }

  function overlap(a,b,c,d){
    const min = (x,y)=>x<y?x:y;
    const max = (x,y)=>x>y?x:y;
    return max(min(a.x,b.x), min(c.x,d.x)) <= min(max(a.x,b.x), max(c.x,d.x)) &&
           max(min(a.y,b.y), min(c.y,d.y)) <= min(max(a.y,b.y), max(c.y,d.y));
  }

  function cutRope(i) {
    if (!ropes[i].active || game.state !== 'playing') return;
    ropes[i].active = false;
    for (let k = 0; k < 12; k++) {
      particles.push({
        x: candy.x + (Math.random()-0.5)*10,
        y: candy.y + (Math.random()-0.5)*10,
        vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*160,
        vy: (Math.random()-0.5)*160,
        life: 0.45 + Math.random()*0.35,
        t: 0,
        color: '#c78b4b'
      });
    }
  }

  function screenPos(evt) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    return {
      x: (evt.clientX - rect.left),
      y: (evt.clientY - rect.top)
    };
  }

  canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
    const p = screenPos(e);
    game.pointerDown = true;
    game.swipeTrail.length = 0;
    game.swipeTrail.push(p);

    if (pointInRect(p.x, p.y, game.ui.restart)) {
      setupLevel();
      return;
    }

    if (game.state !== 'playing') {
      setupLevel();
    }
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
    if (!game.pointerDown || game.state !== 'playing') return;
    const p = screenPos(e);
    const prev = game.swipeTrail[game.swipeTrail.length - 1];
    game.swipeTrail.push(p);
    if (game.swipeTrail.length > 14) game.swipeTrail.shift();

    for (let i = 0; i < ropes.length; i++) {
      if (!ropes[i].active) continue;
      const segA = ropes[i].anchor;
      const segB = { x: candy.x, y: candy.y };
      if (segIntersect(prev, p, segA, segB)) {
        cutRope(i);
      }
    }
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', () => {
    game.pointerDown = false;
    setTimeout(() => game.swipeTrail.length = 0, 40);
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel', () => {
    game.pointerDown = false;
    game.swipeTrail.length = 0;
  });

  function update(dt) {
    game.elapsed += dt;
    if (game.hintTimer > 0) game.hintTimer -= dt;

    if (game.state === 'playing') {
      // gravity
      let ax = 0;
      let ay = 900;

      // blower force
      const bdx = candy.x - blower.x;
      const bdy = candy.y - blower.y;
      const bdist = Math.hypot(bdx, bdy);
      if (bdist < blower.r) {
        const strength = (1 - bdist / blower.r);
        ax += blower.dirX * blower.power * strength;
        ay += blower.dirY * blower.power * strength;
      }

      // ropes: tension only
      for (const rope of ropes) {
        if (!rope.active) continue;
        const dx = candy.x - rope.anchor.x;
        const dy = candy.y - rope.anchor.y;
        const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 0.0001;

        if (dist > rope.length) {
          const nx = dx / dist;
          const ny = dy / dist;
          const stretch = dist - rope.length;
          const k = 95;
          const damp = 6.5;
          const vAlong = candy.vx * nx + candy.vy * ny;
          const force = k * stretch + damp * vAlong;
          ax += (-force * nx) / candy.m;
          ay += (-force * ny) / candy.m;

          // positional correction keeps rope taut
          const corr = Math.min(stretch, 8);
          candy.x -= nx * corr * 0.52;
          candy.y -= ny * corr * 0.52;
        }
      }

      candy.vx += ax * dt;
      candy.vy += ay * dt;
      candy.vx *= 0.997;
      candy.vy *= 0.997;
      candy.x += candy.vx * dt;
      candy.y += candy.vy * dt;
      candy.angVel += candy.vx * 0.0009;
      candy.angVel *= 0.99;
      candy.angle += candy.angVel;

      // walls
      if (candy.x < candy.r) {
        candy.x = candy.r;
        candy.vx *= -0.35;
      } else if (candy.x > w - candy.r) {
        candy.x = w - candy.r;
        candy.vx *= -0.35;
      }
      if (candy.y < candy.r) {
        candy.y = candy.r;
        candy.vy *= -0.3;
      }

      // stars
      for (const s of stars) {
        if (s.got) continue;
        s.pulse += dt * 4;
        const d = Math.hypot(candy.x - s.x, candy.y - s.y);
        if (d < candy.r + s.r) {
          s.got = true;
          game.starsCollected++;
          for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
            const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
            const sp = 90 + Math.random() * 180;
            particles.push({
              x: s.x, y: s.y,
              vx: Math.cos(a) * sp,
              vy: Math.sin(a) * sp,
              life: 0.55,
              t: 0,
              color: '#ffe36b'
            });
          }
        }
      }

      // win condition (mouth)
      const mouthY = monster.y + 6;
      const md = Math.hypot(candy.x - monster.x, candy.y - mouthY);
      if (md < monster.mouthR - 2) {
        game.state = 'win';
        monster.chew = 1.4;
        candy.vx = candy.vy = 0;
        candy.x = monster.x;
        candy.y = mouthY + 3;
        for (let i = 0; i < 28; i++) {
          const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
          particles.push({
            x: monster.x, y: mouthY,
            vx: Math.cos(a) * (50 + Math.random() * 240),
            vy: Math.sin(a) * (50 + Math.random() * 240),
            life: 0.7 + Math.random()*0.6,
            t: 0,
            color: ['#ff6d6d','#6dff95','#ffd86d','#8ed8ff'][i%4]
          });
        }
      }

      // lose condition (spikes or out)
      if (candy.y + candy.r >= spikes.y) {
        if (candy.x < spikes.gapL || candy.x > spikes.gapR) {
          game.state = 'lose';
          for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            particles.push({
              x: candy.x, y: candy.y,
              vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*220,
              vy: -Math.random()*220,
              life: 0.6,
              t: 0,
              color: '#ff5b5b'
            });
          }
        }
      }

      if (candy.y > h + 120) game.state = 'lose';
    } else if (game.state === 'win') {
      monster.chew = Math.max(0, monster.chew - dt);
    }

    // particles
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.t += dt;
      if (p.t >= p.life) {
        particles.splice(i, 1);
        continue;
      }
      p.vy += 420 * dt;
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
    }
  }

  function drawStar(x, y, r, rot, fill='#ffe06b', alpha=1) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    ctx.rotate(rot);
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      const rr = i % 2 === 0 ? r : r * 0.45;
      const a = -Math.PI / 2 + i * Math.PI / 5;
      const px = Math.cos(a) * rr;
      const py = Math.sin(a) * rr;
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py);
      else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
    }
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = fill;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,180,45,0.9)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawBackground() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,h);
    g.addColorStop(0,'#a7f4ff');
    g.addColorStop(1,'#54b8ff');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);

    // clouds
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.18;
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const cx = (i * 93 + (game.elapsed * 10) % (w + 160)) % (w + 160) - 80;
      const cy = 70 + (i%3)*65;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, 26, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.arc(cx+24, cy+4, 20, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.arc(cx-24, cy+6, 18, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawMonster() {
    const m = monster;
    const bodyY = m.y + 28;
    ctx.save();

    // body
    const bodyGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(m.x-20, bodyY-30, 10, m.x, bodyY, m.bodyR+25);
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#9afc61');
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#53b920');
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyGrad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(m.x, bodyY, m.bodyR, Math.PI, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.lineTo(m.x + m.bodyR, h);
    ctx.lineTo(m.x - m.bodyR, h);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // eyes
    const eyeY = m.y - 7;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x - 22, eyeY, 12, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x + 22, eyeY, 12, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#202020';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x - 20, eyeY+1, 5, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x + 24, eyeY+1, 5, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();

    // mouth
    const open = game.state === 'playing' ? (0.75 + Math.sin(game.elapsed * 5) * 0.15) : (game.state==='win' ? 0.25 + m.chew * 0.35 : 0.45);
    const mouthH = m.mouthR * open;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1d1020';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(m.x, m.y + 6, m.mouthR, mouthH, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();

    // teeth
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    for (let i = -2; i <= 2; i++) {
      const tx = m.x + i * 10;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(tx - 3, m.y + 3);
      ctx.lineTo(tx + 3, m.y + 3);
      ctx.lineTo(tx, m.y + 12);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    }

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawSpikes() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#b5d8ff';
    ctx.fillRect(0, spikes.y, w, h - spikes.y);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#c8d2dc';
    const step = 18;
    for (let x = 0; x < w + step; x += step) {
      if (x > spikes.gapL - step && x < spikes.gapR) continue;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, spikes.y);
      ctx.lineTo(x + step * 0.5, spikes.y - spikes.h);
      ctx.lineTo(x + step, spikes.y);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawBlower() {
    const b = blower;
    const pulse = 0.8 + Math.sin(game.elapsed * 8) * 0.2;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(b.x, b.y);

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(250,255,255,0.55)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, b.r, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const ox = -8 + i * 8;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(ox - 4, 3);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(ox + 10 * pulse, -6, ox + 20 * pulse, -14);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawRopes() {
    for (const rope of ropes) {
      const a = rope.anchor;
      // anchor peg
      ctx.fillStyle = '#7c4a24';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, 8, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#b5794a';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(a.x-2, a.y-2, 3, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();

      if (!rope.active) continue;
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#8f5c2f';
      ctx.lineWidth = 4;
      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(a.x, a.y);
      ctx.lineTo(candy.x, candy.y);
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(a.x+1, a.y-1);
      ctx.lineTo(candy.x+1, candy.y-1);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  function drawCandy() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(candy.x, candy.y);
    ctx.rotate(candy.angle);

    const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(-6,-7,4,0,0,candy.r);
    grad.addColorStop(0, '#ffabab');
    grad.addColorStop(1, '#f04f4f');
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0,0,candy.r,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.lineWidth = 5;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
    for (let i = -2; i <= 2; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0,0,candy.r - 6 + i*3, i*0.5, i*0.5 + Math.PI*1.2);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.55)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(-6,-7,5,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    for (const p of particles) {
      const a = 1 - p.t / p.life;
      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 3, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawUI() {
    // top bar
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.78)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(12, 12, 168, 44, 14);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#1f2b38';
    ctx.font = 'bold 18px Trebuchet MS, Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Level 1', 24, 40);

    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const gx = 104 + i * 22;
      const got = i < game.starsCollected;
      drawStar(gx, 34, 8, -0.1, got ? '#ffdf5a' : '#d9e2ea', got ? 1 : 0.75);
    }

    // restart button
    const r = game.ui.restart;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.88)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, 12);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2b3a48';
    ctx.font = 'bold 16px Trebuchet MS, Arial';
    ctx.fillText('↻ Retry', r.x + 12, r.y + 25);

    // hint
    if (game.hintTimer > 0 && game.state === 'playing') {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.roundRect(18, h - 86, w - 36, 54, 14);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#213040';
      ctx.font = 'bold 15px Trebuchet MS, Arial';
      ctx.fillText('Swipe across a rope to cut it. Feed Om Nom!', 30, h - 52);
    }

    if (game.state !== 'playing') {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(15,25,35,0.45)';
      ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.95)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.roundRect(w*0.12, h*0.34, w*0.76, h*0.24, 20);
      ctx.fill();

      ctx.fillStyle = '#1e2c3b';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.font = 'bold 34px Trebuchet MS, Arial';
      ctx.fillText(game.state === 'win' ? 'Sweet!' : 'Oops!', w*0.5, h*0.42);
      ctx.font = 'bold 20px Trebuchet MS, Arial';
      ctx.fillText(`Stars: ${game.starsCollected} / 3`, w*0.5, h*0.47);
      ctx.font = '16px Trebuchet MS, Arial';
      ctx.fillText('Tap anywhere to try again', w*0.5, h*0.53);
      ctx.textAlign = 'start';
    }

    // swipe trail
    if (game.swipeTrail.length > 1) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 4;
      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(game.swipeTrail[0].x, game.swipeTrail[0].y);
      for (let i = 1; i < game.swipeTrail.length; i++) {
        const p = game.swipeTrail[i];
        ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y);
      }
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  if (!CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.roundRect) {
    CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.roundRect = function(x, y, width, height, radii) {
      const r = Math.min(radii, width/2, height/2);
      this.beginPath();
      this.moveTo(x + r, y);
      this.arcTo(x + width, y, x + width, y + height, r);
      this.arcTo(x + width, y + height, x, y + height, r);
      this.arcTo(x, y + height, x, y, r);
      this.arcTo(x, y, x + width, y, r);
      this.closePath();
      return this;
    };
  }

  function render() {
    drawBackground();
    drawSpikes();
    drawBlower();

    for (const s of stars) {
      if (s.got) continue;
      const pulse = 1 + Math.sin(s.pulse) * 0.12;
      drawStar(s.x, s.y, s.r * pulse, s.pulse * 0.25);
    }

    drawRopes();
    if (game.state !== 'win') drawCandy();
    drawMonster();
    drawParticles();
    drawUI();
  }

  function loop(t) {
    if (!game.lastTime) game.lastTime = t;
    const dt = Math.min(0.033, (t - game.lastTime) / 1000);
    game.lastTime = t;

    update(dt);
    render();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=no,viewport-fit=cover" />
  <title>Cut the Rope - Mobile Level</title>
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg1: #8fe9ff;
      --bg2: #5fc8ff;
      --panel: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
      --text: #1d2a38;
    }
    html, body {
      margin: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg1), var(--bg2));
      touch-action: none;
      font-family: "Trebuchet MS", "Arial Rounded MT Bold", system-ui, sans-serif;
    }
    canvas {
      display: block;
      width: 100vw;
      height: 100vh;
      touch-action: none;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  let w = 0, h = 0, dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);

  const game = {
    state: 'playing', // playing, win, lose
    starsCollected: 0,
    hintTimer: 6,
    elapsed: 0,
    lastTime: 0,
    swipeTrail: [],
    pointerDown: false,
    ui: { restart: {x:0,y:0,w:88,h:40} }
  };

  let candy, ropes, anchors, stars, blower, monster, spikes, particles;

  function resize() {
    w = window.innerWidth;
    h = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = Math.floor(w * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.floor(h * dpr);
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    setupLevel();
  }

  function setupLevel() {
    game.state = 'playing';
    game.starsCollected = 0;
    game.hintTimer = 7;
    game.elapsed = 0;
    game.swipeTrail.length = 0;
    particles = [];

    const cx = w * 0.5;
    const cy = h * 0.34;
    candy = {
      x: cx, y: cy,
      vx: 0, vy: 0,
      r: Math.max(16, Math.min(24, w * 0.05)),
      m: 1,
      angle: 0,
      angVel: 0
    };

    anchors = [
      { x: w * 0.24, y: h * 0.16 },
      { x: w * 0.76, y: h * 0.20 }
    ];

    ropes = anchors.map(a => {
      const dx = candy.x - a.x;
      const dy = candy.y - a.y;
      return {
        anchor: a,
        length: Math.hypot(dx, dy) * 1.02,
        active: true
      };
    });

    stars = [
      { x: w * 0.30, y: h * 0.47, r: 16, got: false, pulse: Math.random() * 6 },
      { x: w * 0.74, y: h * 0.58, r: 16, got: false, pulse: Math.random() * 6 },
      { x: w * 0.50, y: h * 0.72, r: 16, got: false, pulse: Math.random() * 6 }
    ];

    blower = {
      x: w * 0.17,
      y: h * 0.70,
      r: Math.max(34, Math.min(58, w * 0.11)),
      dirX: 0.93,
      dirY: -0.36,
      power: 820
    };

    monster = {
      x: w * 0.5,
      y: h - Math.max(70, h * 0.10),
      bodyR: Math.max(64, Math.min(84, w * 0.18)),
      mouthR: Math.max(30, Math.min(42, w * 0.09)),
      chew: 0
    };

    spikes = {
      y: h - 24,
      h: 20,
      gapL: monster.x - monster.mouthR - 16,
      gapR: monster.x + monster.mouthR + 16
    };

    game.ui.restart = { x: w - 98, y: 16, w: 82, h: 38 };
  }

  function pointInRect(px, py, r) {
    return px >= r.x && px <= r.x + r.w && py >= r.y && py <= r.y + r.h;
  }

  function segIntersect(a,b,c,d) {
    const cross = (p1,p2,p3) => (p2.x-p1.x)*(p3.y-p1.y) - (p2.y-p1.y)*(p3.x-p1.x);
    const c1 = cross(a,b,c);
    const c2 = cross(a,b,d);
    const c3 = cross(c,d,a);
    const c4 = cross(c,d,b);
    return ((c1===0 && c2===0) ? overlap(a,b,c,d) : (c1*c2<=0 && c3*c4<=0));
  }

  function overlap(a,b,c,d){
    const min = (x,y)=>x<y?x:y;
    const max = (x,y)=>x>y?x:y;
    return max(min(a.x,b.x), min(c.x,d.x)) <= min(max(a.x,b.x), max(c.x,d.x)) &&
           max(min(a.y,b.y), min(c.y,d.y)) <= min(max(a.y,b.y), max(c.y,d.y));
  }

  function cutRope(i) {
    if (!ropes[i].active || game.state !== 'playing') return;
    ropes[i].active = false;
    for (let k = 0; k < 12; k++) {
      particles.push({
        x: candy.x + (Math.random()-0.5)*10,
        y: candy.y + (Math.random()-0.5)*10,
        vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*160,
        vy: (Math.random()-0.5)*160,
        life: 0.45 + Math.random()*0.35,
        t: 0,
        color: '#c78b4b'
      });
    }
  }

  function screenPos(evt) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    return {
      x: (evt.clientX - rect.left),
      y: (evt.clientY - rect.top)
    };
  }

  canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
    const p = screenPos(e);
    game.pointerDown = true;
    game.swipeTrail.length = 0;
    game.swipeTrail.push(p);

    if (pointInRect(p.x, p.y, game.ui.restart)) {
      setupLevel();
      return;
    }

    if (game.state !== 'playing') {
      setupLevel();
    }
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
    if (!game.pointerDown || game.state !== 'playing') return;
    const p = screenPos(e);
    const prev = game.swipeTrail[game.swipeTrail.length - 1];
    game.swipeTrail.push(p);
    if (game.swipeTrail.length > 14) game.swipeTrail.shift();

    for (let i = 0; i < ropes.length; i++) {
      if (!ropes[i].active) continue;
      const segA = ropes[i].anchor;
      const segB = { x: candy.x, y: candy.y };
      if (segIntersect(prev, p, segA, segB)) {
        cutRope(i);
      }
    }
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', () => {
    game.pointerDown = false;
    setTimeout(() => game.swipeTrail.length = 0, 40);
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel', () => {
    game.pointerDown = false;
    game.swipeTrail.length = 0;
  });

  function update(dt) {
    game.elapsed += dt;
    if (game.hintTimer > 0) game.hintTimer -= dt;

    if (game.state === 'playing') {
      // gravity
      let ax = 0;
      let ay = 900;

      // blower force
      const bdx = candy.x - blower.x;
      const bdy = candy.y - blower.y;
      const bdist = Math.hypot(bdx, bdy);
      if (bdist < blower.r) {
        const strength = (1 - bdist / blower.r);
        ax += blower.dirX * blower.power * strength;
        ay += blower.dirY * blower.power * strength;
      }

      // ropes: tension only
      for (const rope of ropes) {
        if (!rope.active) continue;
        const dx = candy.x - rope.anchor.x;
        const dy = candy.y - rope.anchor.y;
        const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 0.0001;

        if (dist > rope.length) {
          const nx = dx / dist;
          const ny = dy / dist;
          const stretch = dist - rope.length;
          const k = 95;
          const damp = 6.5;
          const vAlong = candy.vx * nx + candy.vy * ny;
          const force = k * stretch + damp * vAlong;
          ax += (-force * nx) / candy.m;
          ay += (-force * ny) / candy.m;

          // positional correction keeps rope taut
          const corr = Math.min(stretch, 8);
          candy.x -= nx * corr * 0.52;
          candy.y -= ny * corr * 0.52;
        }
      }

      candy.vx += ax * dt;
      candy.vy += ay * dt;
      candy.vx *= 0.997;
      candy.vy *= 0.997;
      candy.x += candy.vx * dt;
      candy.y += candy.vy * dt;
      candy.angVel += candy.vx * 0.0009;
      candy.angVel *= 0.99;
      candy.angle += candy.angVel;

      // walls
      if (candy.x < candy.r) {
        candy.x = candy.r;
        candy.vx *= -0.35;
      } else if (candy.x > w - candy.r) {
        candy.x = w - candy.r;
        candy.vx *= -0.35;
      }
      if (candy.y < candy.r) {
        candy.y = candy.r;
        candy.vy *= -0.3;
      }

      // stars
      for (const s of stars) {
        if (s.got) continue;
        s.pulse += dt * 4;
        const d = Math.hypot(candy.x - s.x, candy.y - s.y);
        if (d < candy.r + s.r) {
          s.got = true;
          game.starsCollected++;
          for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
            const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
            const sp = 90 + Math.random() * 180;
            particles.push({
              x: s.x, y: s.y,
              vx: Math.cos(a) * sp,
              vy: Math.sin(a) * sp,
              life: 0.55,
              t: 0,
              color: '#ffe36b'
            });
          }
        }
      }

      // win condition (mouth)
      const mouthY = monster.y + 6;
      const md = Math.hypot(candy.x - monster.x, candy.y - mouthY);
      if (md < monster.mouthR - 2) {
        game.state = 'win';
        monster.chew = 1.4;
        candy.vx = candy.vy = 0;
        candy.x = monster.x;
        candy.y = mouthY + 3;
        for (let i = 0; i < 28; i++) {
          const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
          particles.push({
            x: monster.x, y: mouthY,
            vx: Math.cos(a) * (50 + Math.random() * 240),
            vy: Math.sin(a) * (50 + Math.random() * 240),
            life: 0.7 + Math.random()*0.6,
            t: 0,
            color: ['#ff6d6d','#6dff95','#ffd86d','#8ed8ff'][i%4]
          });
        }
      }

      // lose condition (spikes or out)
      if (candy.y + candy.r >= spikes.y) {
        if (candy.x < spikes.gapL || candy.x > spikes.gapR) {
          game.state = 'lose';
          for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            particles.push({
              x: candy.x, y: candy.y,
              vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*220,
              vy: -Math.random()*220,
              life: 0.6,
              t: 0,
              color: '#ff5b5b'
            });
          }
        }
      }

      if (candy.y > h + 120) game.state = 'lose';
    } else if (game.state === 'win') {
      monster.chew = Math.max(0, monster.chew - dt);
    }

    // particles
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.t += dt;
      if (p.t >= p.life) {
        particles.splice(i, 1);
        continue;
      }
      p.vy += 420 * dt;
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
    }
  }

  function drawStar(x, y, r, rot, fill='#ffe06b', alpha=1) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    ctx.rotate(rot);
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      const rr = i % 2 === 0 ? r : r * 0.45;
      const a = -Math.PI / 2 + i * Math.PI / 5;
      const px = Math.cos(a) * rr;
      const py = Math.sin(a) * rr;
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py);
      else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
    }
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = fill;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,180,45,0.9)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawBackground() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,h);
    g.addColorStop(0,'#a7f4ff');
    g.addColorStop(1,'#54b8ff');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);

    // clouds
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.18;
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const cx = (i * 93 + (game.elapsed * 10) % (w + 160)) % (w + 160) - 80;
      const cy = 70 + (i%3)*65;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, 26, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.arc(cx+24, cy+4, 20, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.arc(cx-24, cy+6, 18, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawMonster() {
    const m = monster;
    const bodyY = m.y + 28;
    ctx.save();

    // body
    const bodyGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(m.x-20, bodyY-30, 10, m.x, bodyY, m.bodyR+25);
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#9afc61');
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#53b920');
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyGrad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(m.x, bodyY, m.bodyR, Math.PI, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.lineTo(m.x + m.bodyR, h);
    ctx.lineTo(m.x - m.bodyR, h);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // eyes
    const eyeY = m.y - 7;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x - 22, eyeY, 12, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x + 22, eyeY, 12, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#202020';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x - 20, eyeY+1, 5, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x + 24, eyeY+1, 5, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();

    // mouth
    const open = game.state === 'playing' ? (0.75 + Math.sin(game.elapsed * 5) * 0.15) : (game.state==='win' ? 0.25 + m.chew * 0.35 : 0.45);
    const mouthH = m.mouthR * open;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1d1020';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(m.x, m.y + 6, m.mouthR, mouthH, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();

    // teeth
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    for (let i = -2; i <= 2; i++) {
      const tx = m.x + i * 10;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(tx - 3, m.y + 3);
      ctx.lineTo(tx + 3, m.y + 3);
      ctx.lineTo(tx, m.y + 12);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    }

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawSpikes() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#b5d8ff';
    ctx.fillRect(0, spikes.y, w, h - spikes.y);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#c8d2dc';
    const step = 18;
    for (let x = 0; x < w + step; x += step) {
      if (x > spikes.gapL - step && x < spikes.gapR) continue;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, spikes.y);
      ctx.lineTo(x + step * 0.5, spikes.y - spikes.h);
      ctx.lineTo(x + step, spikes.y);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawBlower() {
    const b = blower;
    const pulse = 0.8 + Math.sin(game.elapsed * 8) * 0.2;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(b.x, b.y);

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(250,255,255,0.55)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, b.r, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const ox = -8 + i * 8;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(ox - 4, 3);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(ox + 10 * pulse, -6, ox + 20 * pulse, -14);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawRopes() {
    for (const rope of ropes) {
      const a = rope.anchor;
      // anchor peg
      ctx.fillStyle = '#7c4a24';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, 8, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#b5794a';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(a.x-2, a.y-2, 3, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();

      if (!rope.active) continue;
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#8f5c2f';
      ctx.lineWidth = 4;
      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(a.x, a.y);
      ctx.lineTo(candy.x, candy.y);
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(a.x+1, a.y-1);
      ctx.lineTo(candy.x+1, candy.y-1);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  function drawCandy() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(candy.x, candy.y);
    ctx.rotate(candy.angle);

    const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(-6,-7,4,0,0,candy.r);
    grad.addColorStop(0, '#ffabab');
    grad.addColorStop(1, '#f04f4f');
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0,0,candy.r,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.lineWidth = 5;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
    for (let i = -2; i <= 2; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0,0,candy.r - 6 + i*3, i*0.5, i*0.5 + Math.PI*1.2);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.55)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(-6,-7,5,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    for (const p of particles) {
      const a = 1 - p.t / p.life;
      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 3, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawUI() {
    // top bar
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.78)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(12, 12, 168, 44, 14);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#1f2b38';
    ctx.font = 'bold 18px Trebuchet MS, Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Level 1', 24, 40);

    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const gx = 104 + i * 22;
      const got = i < game.starsCollected;
      drawStar(gx, 34, 8, -0.1, got ? '#ffdf5a' : '#d9e2ea', got ? 1 : 0.75);
    }

    // restart button
    const r = game.ui.restart;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.88)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, 12);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2b3a48';
    ctx.font = 'bold 16px Trebuchet MS, Arial';
    ctx.fillText('↻ Retry', r.x + 12, r.y + 25);

    // hint
    if (game.hintTimer > 0 && game.state === 'playing') {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.roundRect(18, h - 86, w - 36, 54, 14);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#213040';
      ctx.font = 'bold 15px Trebuchet MS, Arial';
      ctx.fillText('Swipe across a rope to cut it. Feed Om Nom!', 30, h - 52);
    }

    if (game.state !== 'playing') {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(15,25,35,0.45)';
      ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.95)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.roundRect(w*0.12, h*0.34, w*0.76, h*0.24, 20);
      ctx.fill();

      ctx.fillStyle = '#1e2c3b';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.font = 'bold 34px Trebuchet MS, Arial';
      ctx.fillText(game.state === 'win' ? 'Sweet!' : 'Oops!', w*0.5, h*0.42);
      ctx.font = 'bold 20px Trebuchet MS, Arial';
      ctx.fillText(`Stars: ${game.starsCollected} / 3`, w*0.5, h*0.47);
      ctx.font = '16px Trebuchet MS, Arial';
      ctx.fillText('Tap anywhere to try again', w*0.5, h*0.53);
      ctx.textAlign = 'start';
    }

    // swipe trail
    if (game.swipeTrail.length > 1) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 4;
      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(game.swipeTrail[0].x, game.swipeTrail[0].y);
      for (let i = 1; i < game.swipeTrail.length; i++) {
        const p = game.swipeTrail[i];
        ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y);
      }
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  if (!CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.roundRect) {
    CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.roundRect = function(x, y, width, height, radii) {
      const r = Math.min(radii, width/2, height/2);
      this.beginPath();
      this.moveTo(x + r, y);
      this.arcTo(x + width, y, x + width, y + height, r);
      this.arcTo(x + width, y + height, x, y + height, r);
      this.arcTo(x, y + height, x, y, r);
      this.arcTo(x, y, x + width, y, r);
      this.closePath();
      return this;
    };
  }

  function render() {
    drawBackground();
    drawSpikes();
    drawBlower();

    for (const s of stars) {
      if (s.got) continue;
      const pulse = 1 + Math.sin(s.pulse) * 0.12;
      drawStar(s.x, s.y, s.r * pulse, s.pulse * 0.25);
    }

    drawRopes();
    if (game.state !== 'win') drawCandy();
    drawMonster();
    drawParticles();
    drawUI();
  }

  function loop(t) {
    if (!game.lastTime) game.lastTime = t;
    const dt = Math.min(0.033, (t - game.lastTime) / 1000);
    game.lastTime = t;

    update(dt);
    render();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

      if(!this.ctx || this.muted) return;
      const t = this.ctx.currentTime;
      const o = this.ctx.createOscillator();

  function startNewGame(){
    game.levels = buildLevels();
    game.levelIndex = 0;
    game.player = makePlayer(80, 300);
    game.score = 0;
    game.enemiesDefeated = 0;
    loadLevel(0,true);
    game.state='playing';
    audio.init();
    audio.startMusic();
  }

  function loadLevel(index, first=false){
    game.levelIndex = index;
    game.level = game.levels[index];
    const l = game.level;
    const p = game.player;
    p.x = l.spawn.x; p.y = l.spawn.y; p.vx = p.vy = 0;
    p.spawnX = l.spawn.x; p.spawnY = l.spawn.y;
    p.attackTimer=0; p.dashTimer=0; p.invuln=1;
    if(first){ p.lives=5; p.coins=0; p.totalScore=0; p.babouche=0; p.shield=0; }
    game.cameraX = 0;
    game.levelStartTime = performance.now();
    game.timer = 0;
    game.sandOverlay = 0;
  }

  function completeLevel(){
    const elapsed = (performance.now()-game.levelStartTime)/1000;
    const timeBonus = Math.max(0, Math.floor(2500 - elapsed*30));
    const coinBonus = game.player.coins*10;
    const enemyBonus = game.enemiesDefeated*50;
    const levelScore = timeBonus + coinBonus + enemyBonus + game.player.lives*120;
    game.score += levelScore;
    game.player.totalScore = game.score;
    game.lastStats = {
      level: game.level.name,
      elapsed: elapsed.toFixed(1),
      timeBonus, coinBonus, enemyBonus, levelScore, total: game.score
    };
    game.state = 'levelComplete';
  }

  function nextLevel(){
    if(game.levelIndex < game.levels.length-1){
      loadLevel(game.levelIndex+1,false);
      game.state='playing';
    }else{
      game.state='victory';
    }
  }

  function loseLife(reason=''){
    const p = game.player;
    if(p.invuln>0) return;
    if(p.shield>0){
      p.shield = 0;
      p.invuln = 1.2;
      audio.sfx('hit');
      return;
    }
    p.lives--;
    p.invuln = 2;
    audio.sfx('hit');
    if(p.lives<=0){
      game.state='gameOver';
      return;
    }
    p.x = p.spawnX; p.y = p.spawnY;
    p.vx = p.vy = 0;
  }

  function solidRects(level){
    const arr = [];
    for(const g of level.grounds) arr.push(g);
    for(const p of level.platforms) arr.push(p);
    for(const c of level.crates) arr.push(c);
    return arr;
  }

  function update(dt){
    if(game.state!=='playing') return;
    const l = game.level, p = game.player;
    game.timer += dt;

    // moving platforms
    for(const plat of l.platforms){
      if(plat.type==='moving'){
        plat.t += dt*plat.speed/100;
        const ox = Math.sin(plat.t)*plat.dx;
        const oy = Math.sin(plat.t*0.9)*plat.dy;
        plat.prevX = plat.x; plat.prevY = plat.y;
        plat.x = plat.baseX + ox;
        plat.y = plat.baseY + oy;
      }
    }

    // level hazards: sandstorm
    if(l.sandstorm){
      l.stormTimer += dt;
      const cyc = l.stormTimer % 13;
      l.stormActive = cyc > 6.5 && cyc < 10.8;
      if(l.stormActive){
        game.sandOverlay = lerp(game.sandOverlay,0.75,dt*4);
        p.vx += -120*dt;
        l.stormDamageTick += dt;
        if(l.stormDamageTick>1.2){
          l.stormDamageTick = 0;
          if(Math.random()<0.35) loseLife('sandstorm');
        }
      }else{
        game.sandOverlay = lerp(game.sandOverlay,0,dt*2);
      }
    }

    // input
    const left = keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['KeyA'];
    const right = keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['KeyD'];
    const jump = justPressed['Space'] || justPressed['KeyW'] || justPressed['ArrowUp'];
    const dash = justPressed['ShiftLeft'] || justPressed['ShiftRight'] || justPressed['KeyC'];
    const attack = justPressed['KeyX'] || justPressed['KeyJ'];

    const accel = 1250;
    const maxSpeed = 290;
    const airCtrl = 0.72;

    // timers
    p.attackCooldown = Math.max(0,p.attackCooldown-dt);
    p.attackTimer = Math.max(0,p.attackTimer-dt);
    p.dashCooldown = Math.max(0,p.dashCooldown-dt);
    p.dashTimer = Math.max(0,p.dashTimer-dt);
    p.invuln = Math.max(0,p.invuln-dt);
    p.babouche = Math.max(0,p.babouche-dt);
    p.shield = Math.max(0,p.shield-dt);

    // dash
    if(dash && p.dashCooldown<=0){
      p.dashTimer = 0.14;
      p.dashCooldown = 0.9;
      p.invuln = Math.max(p.invuln,0.25);
      p.vx = p.facing*670;
      p.vy *= 0.2;
      audio.sfx('dash');
    }

    if(p.dashTimer<=0){
      let targetAcc = p.onGround?accel:accel*airCtrl;
      if(left){ p.vx -= targetAcc*dt; p.facing=-1; }
      if(right){ p.vx += targetAcc*dt; p.facing=1; }

      const standingOn = p.onPlat;
      let friction = 10;
      if(standingOn && standingOn.type==='slippery') friction = 2.8;
      if(!left && !right){
        p.vx = lerp(p.vx,0,Math.min(1,friction*dt));
      }
      p.vx = clamp(p.vx,-maxSpeed,maxSpeed);
    }

    if(jump && p.onGround){
      p.vy = -(p.babouche>0?760:610);
      p.onGround = false;
      audio.sfx('jump');
    }

    if(attack && p.attackCooldown<=0){
      p.attackTimer = 0.18;
      p.attackCooldown = 0.28;
      audio.sfx('enemy');
    }

    // gravity
    p.vy += GRAVITY*dt;
    if(p.vy>1100) p.vy=1100;

    // if standing on moving platform carry
    if(p.onPlat && p.onPlat.type==='moving'){
      const dpx = (p.onPlat.x - (p.onPlat.prevX ?? p.onPlat.x));
      const dpy = (p.onPlat.y - (p.onPlat.prevY ?? p.onPlat.y));
      p.x += dpx; p.y += dpy;
    }

    // move x
    p.x += p.vx*dt;
    let solids = solidRects(l);
    p.onPlat = null;
    for(const s of solids){
      if(rectsIntersect(p,s)){
        if(p.vx>0) p.x = s.x - p.w;
        else if(p.vx<0) p.x = s.x + s.w;
        p.vx = 0;
      }
    }

    // move y
    p.y += p.vy*dt;
    p.onGround=false;
    for(const s of solids){
      if(rectsIntersect(p,s)){
        if(p.vy>0){
          p.y = s.y - p.h;
          p.vy = 0;
          p.onGround = true;
          p.onPlat = s;
        }else if(p.vy<0){
          p.y = s.y + s.h;
          p.vy = 40;
        }
      }
    }

    // boundaries / pit
    p.x = clamp(p.x,0,l.worldW-p.w);
    if(p.y > H+200) loseLife('fall');

    // checkpoint
    for(const cp of l.checkpoints){
      if(!cp.active && p.x+ p.w/2 >= cp.x){
        cp.active = true;
        p.spawnX = cp.x+10;
        p.spawnY = 320;
        game.msg = "Checkpoint!";
      }
    }

    // coins
    for(const c of l.coins){
      if(c.collected) continue;
      const dx = (p.x+p.w/2)-c.x, dy=(p.y+p.h/2)-c.y;
      if(dx*dx+dy*dy < (p.w*0.5+11)*(p.w*0.5+11)){
        c.collected=true;
        p.coins++;
        game.score += 25;
        audio.sfx('coin');
      }
    }

    // powerups
    for(const pu of l.powerups){
      if(pu.collected) continue;
      if(rectsIntersect(p,{x:pu.x,y:pu.y,w:pu.w,h:pu.h})){
        pu.collected=true;
        if(pu.type==='babouche') p.babouche = 14;
        if(pu.type==='tajine') p.shield = 13;
        game.score += 120;
        audio.sfx('power');
      }
    }

    // enemies
    const atkBox = (p.attackTimer>0)?{
      x: p.facing>0 ? p.x+p.w-2 : p.x-36,
      y: p.y+12, w:36, h:26
    }:null;

    for(const e of l.enemies){
      if(!e.alive) continue;
      if(e.type==='scarab'){
        e.x += e.vx*e.dir*dt;
        if(e.x < 10 || e.x > l.worldW-60) e.dir*=-1;
        if(Math.abs(e.x - (e.anchor??(e.anchor=e.x))) > e.range) e.dir*=-1;
        // keep on ground by simple ray
        let gy = 430;
        for(const g of l.grounds){ if(e.x+e.w/2>=g.x && e.x+e.w/2<g.x+g.w){ gy = g.y- e.h; break; } }
        e.y = gy;
      }else if(e.type==='pigeon'){
        e.x += 80*dt*(Math.sin(game.timer+e.phase)>0?1:-1);
        e.y = e.baseY + Math.sin(game.timer*2+e.phase)*24;
        e.x = clamp(e.x,60,l.worldW-60);
      }else if(e.type==='bandit'){
        const dist = (p.x-e.x);
        if(Math.abs(dist)<240) e.dir = dist>0?1:-1;
        e.x += e.vx*e.dir*dt;
        if(Math.abs(e.x - (e.anchor??(e.anchor=e.x))) > e.range) e.dir*=-1;
        let gy = 420;
        for(const g of l.grounds){ if(e.x+e.w/2>=g.x && e.x+e.w/2<g.x+g.w){ gy = g.y- e.h; break; } }
        e.y = gy;
      }

      const er = {x:e.x,y:e.y,w:e.w,h:e.h};
      if(atkBox && rectsIntersect(atkBox,er)){
        if(e.type==='bandit'){
          e.hp--;
          if(e.hp<=0){ e.alive=false; game.enemiesDefeated++; game.score += 110; }
        } else {
          e.alive=false; game.enemiesDefeated++; game.score += 90;
        }
        audio.sfx('enemy');
      }

      if(rectsIntersect(p,er)){
        const stomp = p.vy>150 && (p.y+p.h-8)<e.y+8;
        if(stomp){
          e.alive=false; p.vy=-360; game.enemiesDefeated++; game.score += 80; audio.sfx('enemy');
        }else{
          loseLife('enemy');
        }
      }
    }

    // boss logic
    if(l.boss && !l.boss.defeated){
      const b = l.boss;
      if(!b.active && p.x > 1320){
        b.active = true;
        b.state = 'idle';
        b.timer = 1.1;
        audio.sfx('boss');
      }
      if(b.active){
        b.hitCD = Math.max(0,b.hitCD-dt);
        b.timer -= dt;

        if(b.state==='idle' && b.timer<=0){
          const cycle = (Math.random()*3)|0;
          if(cycle===0){ b.state='teleJump'; b.timer=0.85; }
          else if(cycle===1){ b.state='teleThrow'; b.timer=0.95; }
          else { b.state='teleCharge'; b.timer=0.8; }
        }
        if(b.state==='teleJump' && b.timer<=0){
          b.state='jump'; b.vy=-760; b.vx=(p.x>b.x?140:-140); b.onGround=false;
        }
        if(b.state==='jump'){
          b.vy += GRAVITY*dt;
          b.x += b.vx*dt; b.y += b.vy*dt;
          const gy = 475-b.h;
          if(b.y>=gy){
            b.y=gy; b.vy=0; b.vx=0; b.state='slam'; b.timer=0.4;
            b.shockwaves.push({x:b.x+b.w/2,y:475-16,dir:-1,speed:320,alive:true});
            b.shockwaves.push({x:b.x+b.w/2,y:475-16,dir:1,speed:320,alive:true});
            audio.sfx('hit');
          }
        }
        if(b.state==='slam' && b.timer<=0){ b.state='idle'; b.timer=1.0; }

        if(b.state==='teleThrow' && b.timer<=0){
          b.state='throw'; b.timer=1.1;
          for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
            const angle = -Math.PI*0.75 + i*0.22 + (p.x<b.x?-0.15:0.15);
            b.projectiles.push({x:b.x+b.w/2,y:b.y+20,vx:Math.cos(angle)*260,vy:Math.sin(angle)*260,w:24,h:24,alive:true});
          }
          audio.sfx('boss');
        }
        if(b.state==='throw' && b.timer<=0){ b.state='idle'; b.timer=0.8; }

        if(b.state==='teleCharge' && b.timer<=0){
          b.state='charge'; b.vx = (p.x>b.x?1:-1)*460; b.timer=1.2;
        }
        if(b.state==='charge'){
          b.x += b.vx*dt;
          if(b.x<1220 || b.x>2060-b.w){ b.vx*=-1; b.timer-=0.35; }
          if(b.timer<=0){ b.vx=0; b.state='idle'; b.timer=1.0; }
        }

        // projectiles
        for(const pr of b.projectiles){
          if(!pr.alive) continue;
          pr.vy += 1200*dt;
          pr.x += pr.vx*dt; pr.y += pr.vy*dt;
          if(pr.y>520 || pr.x<1150 || pr.x>2200) pr.alive=false;
          if(rectsIntersect(p,pr)){ pr.alive=false; loseLife('bossProj'); }
        }
        for(const sw of b.shockwaves){
          if(!sw.alive) continue;
          sw.x += sw.dir*sw.speed*dt;
          if(sw.x<1120||sw.x>2140) sw.alive=false;
          if(Math.abs((p.x+p.w/2)-sw.x)<22 && p.y+p.h>445) loseLife('shockwave');
        }

        // player attack to boss
        const br = {x:b.x,y:b.y,w:b.w,h:b.h};
        if(atkBox && rectsIntersect(atkBox,br) && b.hitCD<=0){
          b.hp--; b.hitCD = 0.25; game.score += 90; audio.sfx('enemy');
          if(b.hp<=0){
            b.defeated=true; b.active=false;
            game.score += 2000;
            game.msg = "Guardiano sconfitto!";
          }
        }

        if(rectsIntersect(p,br) && b.state!=='slam' && b.state!=='teleThrow'){
          loseLife('bossTouch');
        }
      }
    }

    // camera
    const targetCam = p.x - W*0.35;
    game.cameraX = clamp(lerp(game.cameraX,targetCam,dt*4),0,Math.max(0,l.worldW-W));

    // goal
    if(l.boss){
      if(l.boss.defeated && p.x > l.goalX-40){
        completeLevel();
      }
    } else if(p.x > l.goalX){
      completeLevel();
    }

    if(game.msg) setTimeout(()=>{game.msg='';},800);

    for(const k in justPressed) justPressed[k]=false;
    mouse.clicked=false;
  }

  function drawBackground(theme, camX){
    if(theme==='medina'){
      const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H); g.addColorStop(0,'#7ec8e3'); g.addColorStop(1,'#f9e7c6');
      ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
      ctx.fillStyle='#d6a86f';
      for(let i=0;i<8;i++){
        const x=(i*260-camX*0.3)%2200;
        ctx.fillRect(x,210,170,250);
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,210); ctx.arc(x+85,210,85,Math.PI,0); ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.fillStyle='#b77b47';
      for(let i=0;i<12;i++){
        const x=(i*190-camX*0.45)%2400;
        ctx.fillRect(x,280,120,180);
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x+20,280); ctx.arc(x+60,280,40,Math.PI,0); ctx.fill();
      }
    }else if(theme==='desert'){
      const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H); g.addColorStop(0,'#87d7ff'); g.addColorStop(0.55,'#ffd084'); g.addColorStop(1,'#e8a457');
      ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
      ctx.fillStyle='#f6d365';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(820,90,55,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
        ctx.fillStyle=i%2?'#eebf6f':'#e4a85f';
        ctx.beginPath();
        const y=360+i*28;
        ctx.moveTo(-120,y);
        for(let x=-120;x<=W+140;x+=50) ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+25,y+(i%2?22:-18),x+50,y);
        ctx.lineTo(W+140,H); ctx.lineTo(-120,H); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      }
    }else if(theme==='oasis'){
      const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H); g.addColorStop(0,'#8ed7c6'); g.addColorStop(1,'#ffd49a');
      ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
      ctx.fillStyle='#74c69d';
      ctx.fillRect(0,380,W,60);
      ctx.fillStyle='#5dade2';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(280-camX*0.05,410,170,46,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle='#8b5e34';
      for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
        const x=120+i*170-(camX*0.2%170);
        ctx.fillRect(x,290,10,110);
        ctx.fillStyle='#2a9d8f';
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x+5,284,28,20,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle='#8b5e34';
      }
    }else{
      const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H); g.addColorStop(0,'#2b2d42'); g.addColorStop(1,'#8d99ae');
      ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
      for(let i=0;i<30;i++){
        ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,220,120,0.3)';
        const x=(i*83-camX*0.25)%1100,y=60+(i%8)*40;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,3+(i%3),0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.fillStyle='#5c3d2e';
      ctx.fillRect(0,320,W,220);
      ctx.fillStyle='#7f5539';
      for(let i=0;i<10;i++){ ctx.fillRect(i*110-(camX*0.35%110),280,70,260); }
    }
  }

  function drawWorld(){
    const l=game.level,p=game.player,cam=game.cameraX;
    drawBackground(l.theme,cam);

    // goal arch
    ctx.save();
    const gx=l.goalX-cam;
    ctx.translate(gx,330);
    ctx.fillStyle='#8c6239'; ctx.fillRect(-20,0,70,160);
    ctx.fillRect(120,0,70,160);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(85,0,85,Math.PI,0); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    // grounds
    for(const g of l.grounds){
      const x=g.x-cam; if(x+g.w<0||x>W) continue;
      ctx.fillStyle = l.theme==='desert' ? '#d39b56' : (l.theme==='oasis'?'#b08968':'#c08a58');
      ctx.fillRect(x,g.y,g.w,g.h);
      ctx.strokeStyle='#7f5539'; ctx.lineWidth=2; ctx.strokeRect(x,g.y,g.w,18);
    }

    // platforms
    for(const pl of l.platforms){
      const x=pl.x-cam,y=pl.y;if(x+pl.w<0||x>W) continue;
      if(pl.type==='slippery'){
        ctx.fillStyle='#d1495b';
        ctx.fillRect(x,y,pl.w,pl.h);
        ctx.fillStyle='#ff8fa3';
        for(let i=0;i<pl.w;i+=14) ctx.fillRect(x+i,y+6,8,4);
      }else{
        ctx.fillStyle=pl.type==='moving'?'#a98467':'#9c6644';
        ctx.fillRect(x,y,pl.w,pl.h);
      }
      ctx.strokeStyle='#5e3023'; ctx.lineWidth=2; ctx.strokeRect(x,y,pl.w,pl.h);
    }

    // crates
    for(const c of l.crates){
      const x=c.x-cam;if(x+c.w<0||x>W) continue;
      ctx.fillStyle='#b5651d'; ctx.fillRect(x,c.y,c.w,c.h);
      ctx.strokeStyle='#7f4f24'; ctx.lineWidth=3; ctx.strokeRect(x,c.y,c.w,c.h);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,c.y); ctx.lineTo(x+c.w,c.y+c.h); ctx.moveTo(x+c.w,c.y); ctx.lineTo(x,c.y+c.h); ctx.stroke();
    }

    // checkpoints
    for(const cp of l.checkpoints){
      const x=cp.x-cam; if(x<-20||x>W+20) continue;
      ctx.strokeStyle='#2d6a4f'; ctx.lineWidth=4;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,460); ctx.lineTo(x,370); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle=cp.active?'#06d6a0':'#f1fa8c';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,375); ctx.lineTo(x+36,388); ctx.lineTo(x,402); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    }

    // coins
    for(const c of l.coins){
      if(c.collected) continue;
      const x=c.x-cam, y=c.y+Math.sin(game.timer*6 + c.x*0.01)*4;
      if(x<-20||x>W+20) continue;
      ctx.fillStyle='#ffd166';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,c.r,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle='#fca311'; ctx.lineWidth=3; ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle='#9c6644'; ctx.font='bold 11px sans-serif'; ctx.fillText('D',x-4,y+4);
    }

    // powerups
    for(const pu of l.powerups){
      if(pu.collected) continue;
      const x=pu.x-cam,y=pu.y+Math.sin(game.timer*4+pu.x*0.02)*3;
      if(x<-30||x>W+30) continue;
      if(pu.type==='babouche'){
        ctx.fillStyle='#ff9f1c'; ctx.strokeStyle='#8d5524'; ctx.lineWidth=2;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,y+20); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+8,y+5,x+22,y+16); ctx.lineTo(x+18,y+25); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
      }else{
        ctx.fillStyle='#e76f51'; ctx.strokeStyle='#7f5539'; ctx.lineWidth=2;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x+15,y+18,14,10,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle='#f4a261'; ctx.fillRect(x+5,y+8,20,8);
      }
    }

    // enemies
    for(const e of l.enemies){
      if(!e.alive) continue;
      const x=e.x-cam,y=e.y;
      if(x<-80||x>W+80) continue;
      if(e.type==='scarab'){
        ctx.fillStyle='#2d6a4f'; ctx.strokeStyle='#1b4332'; ctx.lineWidth=2;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x+14,y+12,14,10,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle='#40916c'; ctx.fillRect(x+4,y+6,20,4);
      }else if(e.type==='pigeon'){
        ctx.fillStyle='#8d99ae'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x+15,y+12,14,10,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle='#edf2f4'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x+21,y+9,5,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle='#2b2d42'; ctx.lineWidth=2;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x+4,y+12); ctx.lineTo(x-6+Math.sin(game.timer*16)*4,y+8); ctx.moveTo(x+26,y+12); ctx.lineTo(x+36-Math.sin(game.timer*16)*4,y+8); ctx.stroke();
      }else{
        ctx.fillStyle='#6d597a'; ctx.fillRect(x+8,y+14,20,30);
        ctx.fillStyle='#ffdab9'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x+18,y+11,10,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle='#b56576'; ctx.fillRect(x+8,y+8,20,5);
        ctx.fillStyle='#222'; ctx.fillRect(x+12,y+40,6,10); ctx.fillRect(x+20,y+40,6,10);
      }
    }

    // boss
    if(l.boss && (l.boss.active || l.boss.defeated)){
      const b=l.boss;
      const x=b.x-cam,y=b.y;
      ctx.save();
      let color='#7f5539';
      if(b.state.startsWith('tele')) color='#ef476f';
      if(b.state==='charge') color='#f77f00';
      ctx.fillStyle=color; ctx.strokeStyle='#2d1e2f'; ctx.lineWidth=4;
      ctx.fillRect(x+18,y+35,70,80);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x+53,y+30,28,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle='#ffddb3'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x+53,y+30,16,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle='#2d1e2f'; ctx.fillRect(x+40,y+92,16,24); ctx.fillRect(x+63,y+92,16,24);
      ctx.fillStyle='#9c6644'; ctx.fillRect(x+8,y+58,18,14); ctx.fillRect(x+88,y+58,18,14);
      ctx.restore();

      for(const pr of b.projectiles){
        if(!pr.alive) continue;
        ctx.fillStyle='#b5651d'; ctx.fillRect(pr.x-cam,pr.y,pr.w,pr.h);
        ctx.strokeStyle='#7f4f24'; ctx.strokeRect(pr.x-cam,pr.y,pr.w,pr.h);
      }
      for(const sw of b.shockwaves){
        if(!sw.alive) continue;
        ctx.fillStyle='#ef476f';
        ctx.fillRect(sw.x-14-cam,457,28,8);
      }

      // boss hp bar
      ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.45)';
      ctx.fillRect(W/2-180,20,360,18);
      ctx.fillStyle='#e63946';
      ctx.fillRect(W/2-178,22,(356)*(b.hp/b.maxHp),14);
      ctx.strokeStyle='#fff'; ctx.strokeRect(W/2-180,20,360,18);
      ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='bold 14px sans-serif'; ctx.fillText('Guardiano del Souk',W/2-72,16);
    }

    // player
    drawPlayer(p,cam);

    // storm overlay
    if(game.sandOverlay>0.02){
      ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(237, 196, 120, ${game.sandOverlay*0.45})`;
      ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
      ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(245,222,179,${game.sandOverlay*0.7})`;
      for(let i=0;i<80;i++){
        const y=(i*13 + (game.timer*260)%H)%H;
        const x=((i*59 - game.timer*350)%W+W)%W;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,y); ctx.lineTo(x+20,y-3); ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
  }

  function drawPlayer(p,cam){
    const x=p.x-cam,y=p.y;
    ctx.save();
    if(p.invuln>0 && Math.floor(game.timer*16)%2===0) ctx.globalAlpha=0.55;
    // robe
    ctx.fillStyle='#2a9d8f'; ctx.strokeStyle='#1d6f67'; ctx.lineWidth=2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x+7,y+52); ctx.lineTo(x+27,y+52); ctx.lineTo(x+30,y+24); ctx.lineTo(x+4,y+24); ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
    // vest
    ctx.fillStyle='#e9c46a'; ctx.fillRect(x+10,y+28,14,20);
    // head
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffddb3'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x+17,y+15,11,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    // modern chechia cap
    ctx.fillStyle='#e63946'; ctx.fillRect(x+8,y+3,18,6);
    ctx.fillStyle='#c1121f'; ctx.fillRect(x+13,y+0,8,4);
    // scarf
    ctx.strokeStyle='#f4a261'; ctx.lineWidth=3; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x+6,y+25); ctx.lineTo(x+29,y+25); ctx.stroke();
    // legs
    ctx.fillStyle='#264653';
    ctx.fillRect(x+9,y+52,7,2);
    ctx.fillRect(x+19,y+52,7,2);
    // attack slash
    if(p.attackTimer>0){
      ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.8)'; ctx.lineWidth=4;
      const sx = p.facing>0 ? x+p.w+6 : x-6;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx,y+24,16,p.facing>0?-0.7:Math.PI-0.7,p.facing>0?0.7:Math.PI+0.7); ctx.stroke();
    }
    // shield glow
    if(p.shield>0){
      ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(66, 135, 245, 0.7)'; ctx.lineWidth=3;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x+17,y+28,24,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawUI(){
    const p=game.player;
    // top panel
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.35)'; ctx.fillRect(8,8,320,92);
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.25)'; ctx.strokeRect(8,8,320,92);

    ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='bold 18px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Vite:',18,33);
    for(let i=0;i<p.lives;i++){
      ctx.fillStyle='#ef476f';
      const hx=72+i*22, hy=24;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(hx,hy);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(hx-8,hy-8,hx-18,hy+4,hx,hy+16);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(hx+18,hy+4,hx+8,hy-8,hx,hy);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    ctx.fillStyle='#ffd166'; ctx.fillText('Dinar:',18,58);
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.fillText(p.coins,90,58);

    ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.fillText('Punteggio: '+game.score,18,82);

    // power bar
    const val = Math.max(p.babouche/14, p.shield/13);
    let label = 'Nessun Power-up';
    if(p.babouche>0) label='Babouche-Boost';
    if(p.shield>0) label='Tajine-Shield';
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.35)'; ctx.fillRect(340,8,260,46);
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.25)'; ctx.strokeRect(340,8,260,46);
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='bold 14px sans-serif'; ctx.fillText(label,350,26);
    ctx.fillStyle='#555'; ctx.fillRect(350,32,240,12);
    ctx.fillStyle=p.shield>0?'#4dabf7':'#ff9f1c';
    ctx.fillRect(350,32,240*val,12);

    // controls hint
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.3)'; ctx.fillRect(W-338,8,330,64);
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.2)'; ctx.strokeRect(W-338,8,330,64);
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='12px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Move: ← → / A D   Salto: SPACE   Dash: SHIFT/C   Attacco: X/J   M: Mute',W-330,32);
    ctx.fillText(game.level.name, W-330,54);

    if(game.msg){
      ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.4)'; ctx.fillRect(W/2-100,80,200,34);
      ctx.fillStyle='#f1fa8c'; ctx.font='bold 20px sans-serif'; ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.fillText(game.msg,W/2,104); ctx.textAlign='left';
    }
  }

  function drawButton(btn){
    ctx.fillStyle = btn.hover ? '#3a506b' : '#1f2f46';
    ctx.fillRect(btn.x,btn.y,btn.w,btn.h);
    ctx.strokeStyle='#ffd166'; ctx.lineWidth=3; ctx.strokeRect(btn.x,btn.y,btn.w,btn.h);
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='bold 24px sans-serif'; ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
    ctx.fillText(btn.text,btn.x+btn.w/2,btn.y+btn.h/2);
    ctx.textAlign='left'; ctx.textBaseline='alphabetic';
  }

  function uiScreen(title, lines, buttons){
    ctx.fillStyle='#14213d'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    // decor
    for(let i=0;i<12;i++){
      ctx.fillStyle = i%2?'#fca31122':'#2ec4b622';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(90+i*78,80+(i%3)*40,36,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='bold 48px sans-serif'; ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText(title,W/2,120);
    ctx.font='22px sans-serif';
    let y=190;
    for(const ln of lines){ ctx.fillText(ln,W/2,y); y+=34; }
    ctx.textAlign='left';
    game.buttons = buttons;
    for(const b of game.buttons){
      b.hover = mouse.x>=b.x && mouse.x<=b.x+b.w && mouse.y>=b.y && mouse.y<=b.y+b.h;
      drawButton(b);
    }
  }

  function render(){
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);

    if(game.state==='menu'){
      uiScreen('SOUK SPRINT',[
        'Platform 2D cartoon vettoriale ispirato ai classici arcade anni ’90',
        'Ambientazione tunisina • 4 livelli (Medina, Deserto, Oasi, Boss finale)',
        'Raccogli Dinar-coin, usa Babouche-Boost e Tajine-Shield'
      ],[
        {x:W/2-130,y:300,w:260,h:62,text:'GIOCA'},
        {x:W/2-130,y:380,w:260,h:54,text:audio.muted?'Audio: OFF':'Audio: ON'}
      ]);
    }else if(game.state==='playing'){
      drawWorld();
      drawUI();
    }else if(game.state==='levelComplete'){
      const s = game.lastStats;
      uiScreen('Livello Completato!',[
        s.level,
        `Tempo: ${s.elapsed}s   Bonus Tempo: ${s.timeBonus}`,
        `Bonus Monete: ${s.coinBonus}   Bonus Nemici: ${s.enemyBonus}`,
        `Punteggio Livello: ${s.levelScore}`,
        `Punteggio Totale: ${s.total}`
      ],[
        {x:W/2-130,y:390,w:260,h:62,text:'CONTINUA'}
      ]);
    }else if(game.state==='gameOver'){
      uiScreen('Game Over',[
        'Il Guardiano e il Souk ti aspettano ancora!',
        `Punteggio finale: ${game.score}`
      ],[
        {x:W/2-130,y:360,w:260,h:62,text:'RIPROVA'},
        {x:W/2-130,y:435,w:260,h:54,text:'MENU'}
      ]);
    }else if(game.state==='victory'){
      uiScreen('Vittoria!',[
        'Hai sconfitto il Guardiano del Souk!',
        `Dinar raccolti: ${game.player.coins}`,
        `Nemici sconfitti: ${game.enemiesDefeated}`,
        `Punteggio finale: ${game.score}`
      ],[
        {x:W/2-130,y:380,w:260,h:62,text:'NUOVA PARTITA'},
        {x:W/2-130,y:455,w:260,h:54,text:'MENU'}
      ]);
    }
  }

  function handleClicks(){
    if(!mouse.clicked) return;
    if(game.state==='menu'){
      const [b1,b2]=game.buttons;
      if(hitBtn(b1)){ audio.init(); audio.startMusic(); startNewGame(); }
      else if(hitBtn(b2)){ audio.init(); audio.toggleMute(); }
    }else if(game.state==='levelComplete'){
      if(hitBtn(game.buttons[0])) nextLevel();
    }else if(game.state==='gameOver'){
      if(hitBtn(game.buttons[0])) startNewGame();
      else if(hitBtn(game.buttons[1])) game.state='menu';
    }else if(game.state==='victory'){
      if(hitBtn(game.buttons[0])) startNewGame();
      else if(hitBtn(game.buttons[1])) game.state='menu';
    }
    mouse.clicked=false;
  }

  function hitBtn(b){
    return b && mouse.x>=b.x&&mouse.x<=b.x+b.w&&mouse.y>=b.y&&mouse.y<=b.y+b.h;
  }

  let last=performance.now();
  function loop(now){
    let dt=(now-last)/1000; last=now;
    dt=Math.min(0.033,dt);

    update(dt);
    render();
    handleClicks();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  // input
  window.addEventListener('keydown',(e)=>{
    if(!keys[e.code]) justPressed[e.code]=true;
    keys[e.code]=true;
    if(['ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','Space'].includes(e.code)) e.preventDefault();
    if(e.code==='KeyM'){ audio.init(); audio.toggleMute(); }
    if(game.state==='menu' && e.code==='Enter'){ audio.init(); audio.startMusic(); startNewGame(); }
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup',(e)=>{ keys[e.code]=false; });

  function updateMousePos(e){
    const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const sx=W/r.width, sy=H/r.height;
    mouse.x=(e.clientX-r.left)*sx; mouse.y=(e.clientY-r.top)*sy;
  }
  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove',updateMousePos);
  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown',(e)=>{ updateMousePos(e); mouse.down=true; mouse.clicked=true; });
  canvas.addEventListener('mouseup',()=>{ mouse.down=false; });

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
