<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
<title>Souk Sprint - Platform Tunisino</title>
<style>
  :root{
    --bg:#101820;
    --panel:#1e2a3a;
    --accent:#ffd166;
    --accent2:#06d6a0;
    --danger:#ef476f;
    --text:#f7fff7;
  }
  html,body{
    margin:0;
    width:100%;
    height:100%;
    overflow:hidden;
    background:var(--bg);
    font-family: "Trebuchet MS", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
    color:var(--text);
  }
  #game{
    display:block;
    width:100vw;
    height:100vh;
    image-rendering:auto;
    background:#000;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="960" height="540"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
  const GRAVITY = 1800;
  const keys = {};
  const justPressed = {};
  const mouse = {x:0,y:0,down:false,clicked:false};

  const rnd = (a,b)=>Math.random()*(b-a)+a;
  const clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
  const lerp=(a,b,t)=>a+(b-a)*t;
  const rectsIntersect=(a,b)=>a.x<a.x+a.w && b.x<b.x+b.w && a.x+b.w>b.x && a.y+b.h>b.y && a.y<a.y+a.h && a.x < b.x+b.w && a.x+a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y+b.h && a.y+a.h > b.y;

  class AudioEngine{
    constructor(){
      this.ctx=null;
      this.master=null;
      this.musicTimer=null;
      this.step=0;
      this.muted=false;
    }
    init(){
      if(this.ctx) return;
      const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
      this.ctx = new AC();
      this.master = this.ctx.createGain();
      this.master.gain.value = 0.17;
      this.master.connect(this.ctx.destination);
    }
    toggleMute(){
      this.muted=!this.muted;
      if(this.master) this.master.gain.value = this.muted?0:0.17;
    }
    blip(freq=440, dur=0.08, type='square', vol=0.05){
      if(!this.ctx || this.muted) return;
      const t = this.ctx.currentTime;
      const o = this.ctx.createOscillator();
      const g = this.ctx.createGain();
      o.type = type; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol, t);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t+dur);
      o.connect(g); g.connect(this.master);
      o.start(t); o.stop(t+dur);
    }
    noise(dur=0.08, vol=0.05){
      if(!this.ctx || this.muted) return;
      const len = this.ctx.sampleRate*dur;
      const buff = this.ctx.createBuffer(1,len,this.ctx.sampleRate);
      const data = buff.getChannelData(0);
      for(let i=0;i<len;i++) data[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*(1-i/len);
      const src = this.ctx.createBufferSource();
      const hp = this.ctx.createBiquadFilter(); hp.type='highpass'; hp.frequency.value=500;
      const g = this.ctx.createGain(); g.gain.value=vol;
      src.buffer=buff; src.connect(hp); hp.connect(g); g.connect(this.master);
      src.start();
    }
    sfx(name){
      if(!this.ctx || this.muted) return;
      if(name==='jump'){ this.blip(500,0.06,'square',0.05); this.blip(700,0.05,'triangle',0.03);}
      if(name==='coin'){ this.blip(880,0.05,'triangle',0.04); this.blip(1320,0.08,'sine',0.04);}
      if(name==='hit'){ this.noise(0.12,0.06); this.blip(140,0.08,'sawtooth',0.03);}
      if(name==='enemy'){ this.blip(220,0.06,'square',0.05);}
      if(name==='dash'){ this.noise(0.06,0.04); this.blip(300,0.05,'sawtooth',0.04);}
      if(name==='power'){ this.blip(660,0.07,'triangle',0.05); this.blip(990,0.12,'triangle',0.05);}
      if(name==='boss'){ this.blip(110,0.2,'sawtooth',0.08);}
    }
    startMusic(){
      if(!this.ctx || this.musicTimer) return;
      const hijaz = [0,1,4,5,7,8,10];
      const root=220;
      this.step = 0;
      this.musicTimer = setInterval(()=>{
        if(!game || game.state==='menu') return;
        const tStep = this.step++;
        // darbuka-like beat
        if(tStep%4===0){ this.noise(0.05,0.06); this.blip(90,0.04,'sine',0.03); }
        if(tStep%8===4){ this.noise(0.03,0.04); }
        // melody
        if(tStep%2===0){
          const deg = hijaz[(tStep/2)%hijaz.length|0];
          const freq = root*Math.pow(2,deg/12);
          this.blip(freq,0.12,'triangle',0.03);
          if(tStep%8===0) this.blip(freq/2,0.18,'sine',0.025);
        }
      }, 160);
    }
  }

  const audio = new AudioEngine();

  function makePlayer(x,y){
    return {
      x,y,w:34,h:54,vx:0,vy:0,
      onGround:false,onPlat:null,facing:1,
      lives:5,coins:0,totalScore:0,
      attackTimer:0,attackCooldown:0,
      dashTimer:0,dashCooldown:0,
      invuln:0,
      babouche:0, shield:0,
      spawnX:x, spawnY:y,
      color:'#2a9d8f'
    };
  }

  function generateGround(width, baseY, variation=0, step=180){
    const arr=[];
    let x=0;
    while(x<width){
      const h = baseY + (variation?Math.sin(x/260)*variation + Math.sin(x/110)*variation*0.35:0);
      arr.push({x, y:h, w:step, h:800, type:'ground'});
      x += step;
    }
    return arr;
  }

  function coinLine(level, x1, x2, y, step=45){
    for(let x=x1;x<=x2;x+=step) level.coins.push({x,y,r:9,collected:false});
  }

  function buildLevels(){
    const levels = [];

    // LIVELLO 1 - MEDINA
    const l1 = {
      name:"Livello 1 - Medina di Tunis",
      theme:'medina', worldW:3600, worldH:540, spawn:{x:80,y:380}, goalX:3450,
      grounds: generateGround(3600, 470, 10, 190),
      platforms: [
        {x:260,y:390,w:120,h:22,type:'solid'},
        {x:520,y:350,w:150,h:22,type:'slippery'},
        {x:760,y:320,w:110,h:22,type:'solid'},
        {x:980,y:360,w:120,h:22,type:'moving',dx:130,dy:0,speed:55,t:0,baseX:980,baseY:360},
        {x:1280,y:300,w:130,h:22,type:'solid'},
        {x:1560,y:340,w:150,h:22,type:'slippery'},
        {x:1860,y:300,w:140,h:22,type:'moving',dx:0,dy:90,speed:45,t:0,baseX:1860,baseY:300},
        {x:2140,y:370,w:110,h:22,type:'solid'},
        {x:2480,y:320,w:140,h:22,type:'solid'},
        {x:2720,y:290,w:120,h:22,type:'moving',dx:170,dy:0,speed:65,t:0,baseX:2720,baseY:290},
        {x:3080,y:340,w:150,h:22,type:'slippery'}
      ],
      crates:[
        {x:640,y:418,w:40,h:40},{x:1680,y:428,w:40,h:40},{x:2200,y:428,w:40,h:40},{x:2870,y:428,w:40,h:40}
      ],
      enemies:[],
      coins:[],
      powerups:[
        {type:'babouche',x:1220,y:260,w:28,h:28,collected:false},
        {type:'tajine',x:2360,y:330,w:30,h:30,collected:false}
      ],
      checkpoints:[{x:900,active:false},{x:1900,active:false},{x:2860,active:false}],
      sandstorm:false,
      scoreTarget: 3000
    };
    for(let i=0;i<8;i++) l1.enemies.push({type:'scarab',x:420+i*370,y:430,w:28,h:20,vx:40,range:100,dir:i%2?1:-1,alive:true});
    for(let i=0;i<6;i++) l1.enemies.push({type:'pigeon',x:650+i*430,y:220+rnd(-40,40),w:30,h:24,baseY:220+rnd(-30,30),phase:rnd(0,6.2),alive:true});
    for(let i=0;i<5;i++) l1.enemies.push({type:'bandit',x:1100+i*480,y:410,w:36,h:50,vx:36,range:120,dir:i%2?1:-1,hp:2,alive:true});
    coinLine(l1,150,800,320,50); coinLine(l1,900,1700,260,55); coinLine(l1,1900,3400,280,60);
    levels.push(l1);

    // LIVELLO 2 - DESERTO
    const l2 = {
      name:"Livello 2 - Dune e Rovine",
      theme:'desert', worldW:3900, worldH:540, spawn:{x:100,y:360}, goalX:3750,
      grounds: generateGround(3900, 475, 28, 180),
      platforms:[
        {x:430,y:350,w:120,h:22,type:'solid'},
        {x:730,y:315,w:130,h:22,type:'moving',dx:0,dy:80,speed:46,t:0,baseX:730,baseY:315},
        {x:1030,y:280,w:110,h:22,type:'solid'},
        {x:1320,y:340,w:160,h:22,type:'slippery'},
        {x:1660,y:300,w:120,h:22,type:'solid'},
        {x:1940,y:260,w:140,h:22,type:'moving',dx:170,dy:0,speed:60,t:0,baseX:1940,baseY:260},
        {x:2280,y:320,w:130,h:22,type:'solid'},
        {x:2560,y:280,w:110,h:22,type:'solid'},
        {x:2840,y:330,w:170,h:22,type:'slippery'},
        {x:3200,y:270,w:120,h:22,type:'moving',dx:0,dy:100,speed:55,t:0,baseX:3200,baseY:270}
      ],
      crates:[{x:1490,y:422,w:40,h:40},{x:2420,y:420,w:40,h:40},{x:3030,y:418,w:40,h:40}],
      enemies:[], coins:[],
      powerups:[
        {type:'tajine',x:1760,y:262,w:30,h:30,collected:false},
        {type:'babouche',x:3020,y:290,w:28,h:28,collected:false}
      ],
      checkpoints:[{x:980,active:false},{x:2150,active:false},{x:3180,active:false}],
      sandstorm:true, stormTimer:0, stormActive:false, stormDamageTick:0,
      scoreTarget: 4200
    };
    for(let i=0;i<10;i++) l2.enemies.push({type:'scarab',x:300+i*330,y:430,w:28,h:20,vx:45,range:100,dir:i%2?1:-1,alive:true});
    for(let i=0;i<7;i++) l2.enemies.push({type:'pigeon',x:500+i*470,y:190+rnd(-30,30),w:30,h:24,baseY:190+rnd(-25,25),phase:rnd(0,6.2),alive:true});
    for(let i=0;i<6;i++) l2.enemies.push({type:'bandit',x:860+i*500,y:400,w:36,h:50,vx:42,range:130,dir:i%2?1:-1,hp:2,alive:true});
    coinLine(l2,220,1200,280,50); coinLine(l2,1300,2400,230,52); coinLine(l2,2500,3700,250,55);
    levels.push(l2);

    // LIVELLO 3 - OASI & ANTICHE ROVINE
    const l3 = {
      name:"Livello 3 - Oasi Perduta",
      theme:'oasis', worldW:4200, worldH:540, spawn:{x:70,y:360}, goalX:4030,
      grounds: generateGround(4200, 472, 18, 170),
      platforms:[
        {x:260,y:380,w:130,h:22,type:'solid'},
        {x:530,y:340,w:120,h:22,type:'moving',dx:150,dy:0,speed:58,t:0,baseX:530,baseY:340},
        {x:860,y:300,w:110,h:22,type:'solid'},
        {x:1100,y:260,w:140,h:22,type:'moving',dx:0,dy:90,speed:50,t:0,baseX:1100,baseY:260},
        {x:1430,y:320,w:130,h:22,type:'slippery'},
        {x:1710,y:280,w:120,h:22,type:'solid'},
        {x:1940,y:240,w:110,h:22,type:'solid'},
        {x:2190,y:300,w:160,h:22,type:'moving',dx:180,dy:0,speed:68,t:0,baseX:2190,baseY:300},
        {x:2560,y:350,w:130,h:22,type:'slippery'},
        {x:2820,y:310,w:140,h:22,type:'solid'},
        {x:3090,y:270,w:120,h:22,type:'moving',dx:0,dy:100,speed:54,t:0,baseX:3090,baseY:270},
        {x:3400,y:240,w:130,h:22,type:'solid'},
        {x:3650,y:300,w:150,h:22,type:'moving',dx:170,dy:0,speed:62,t:0,baseX:3650,baseY:300}
      ],
      crates:[{x:980,y:420,w:40,h:40},{x:2050,y:420,w:40,h:40},{x:3270,y:420,w:40,h:40}],
      enemies:[], coins:[],
      powerups:[
        {type:'babouche',x:1180,y:220,w:28,h:28,collected:false},
        {type:'tajine',x:2850,y:272,w:30,h:30,collected:false},
        {type:'babouche',x:3500,y:200,w:28,h:28,collected:false}
      ],
      checkpoints:[{x:1000,active:false},{x:2200,active:false},{x:3350,active:false}],
      sandstorm:false,
      scoreTarget: 5600
    };
    for(let i=0;i<11;i++) l3.enemies.push({type:'scarab',x:360+i*330,y:430,w:28,h:20,vx:50,range:110,dir:i%2?1:-1,alive:true});
    for(let i=0;i<8;i++) l3.enemies.push({type:'pigeon',x:480+i*470,y:180+rnd(-40,35),w:30,h:24,baseY:180+rnd(-20,30),phase:rnd(0,6.2),alive:true});
    for(let i=0;i<7;i++) l3.enemies.push({type:'bandit',x:780+i*520,y:402,w:36,h:50,vx:48,range:140,dir:i%2?1:-1,hp:2,alive:true});
    coinLine(l3,150,1200,300,48); coinLine(l3,1250,2600,240,52); coinLine(l3,2660,4000,220,50);
    levels.push(l3);

    // LIVELLO 4 - BOSS FINALE
    const l4 = {
      name:"Livello 4 - Il Guardiano del Souk",
      theme:'boss', worldW:2200, worldH:540, spawn:{x:120,y:360}, goalX:2050,
      grounds: generateGround(2200, 475, 0, 200),
      platforms:[
        {x:420,y:350,w:160,h:22,type:'solid'},
        {x:760,y:310,w:130,h:22,type:'solid'},
        {x:1060,y:290,w:120,h:22,type:'moving',dx:150,dy:0,speed:52,t:0,baseX:1060,baseY:290}
      ],
      crates:[{x:620,y:420,w:40,h:40},{x:940,y:420,w:40,h:40}],
      enemies:[
        {type:'bandit',x:600,y:402,w:36,h:50,vx:40,range:120,dir:-1,hp:2,alive:true},
        {type:'bandit',x:920,y:402,w:36,h:50,vx:40,range:120,dir:1,hp:2,alive:true}
      ],
      coins:[],
      powerups:[{type:'tajine',x:1160,y:252,w:30,h:30,collected:false}],
      checkpoints:[{x:1050,active:false}],
      sandstorm:false,
      boss:{
        active:false, defeated:false,
        x:1580,y:360,w:110,h:120,vx:0,vy:0,onGround:false,
        hp:22,maxHp:22,state:'idle',timer:1.4,dir:-1,hitCD:0,
        projectiles:[],shockwaves:[]
      },
      scoreTarget: 8000
    };
    coinLine(l4,140,1000,250,55);
    levels.push(l4);
    return levels;
  }

  const game = {
    state:'menu',
    levels: buildLevels(),
    levelIndex:0,
    level:null,
    player:null,
    cameraX:0,
    timer:0,
    levelStartTime:0,
    enemiesDefeated:0,
    score:0,
    lastStats:null,
    buttons:[],
    particles:[],
    msg:'',
    sandOverlay:0
  };

  function startNewGame(){
    game.levels = buildLevels();
    game.levelIndex = 0;
    game.player = makePlayer(80, 300);
    game.score = 0;
    game.enemiesDefeated = 0;
    loadLevel(0,true);
    game.state='playing';
    audio.init();
    audio.startMusic();
  }

  function loadLevel(index, first=false){
    game.levelIndex = index;
    game.level = game.levels[index];
    const l = game.level;
    const p = game.player;
    p.x = l.spawn.x; p.y = l.spawn.y; p.vx = p.vy = 0;
    p.spawnX = l.spawn.x; p.spawnY = l.spawn.y;
    p.attackTimer=0; p.dashTimer=0; p.invuln=1;
    if(first){ p.lives=5; p.coins=0; p.totalScore=0; p.babouche=0; p.shield=0; }
    game.cameraX = 0;
    game.levelStartTime = performance.now();
    game.timer = 0;
    game.sandOverlay = 0;
  }

  function completeLevel(){
    const elapsed = (performance.now()-game.levelStartTime)/1000;
    const timeBonus = Math.max(0, Math.floor(2500 - elapsed*30));
    const coinBonus = game.player.coins*10;
    const enemyBonus = game.enemiesDefeated*50;
    const levelScore = timeBonus + coinBonus + enemyBonus + game.player.lives*120;
    game.score += levelScore;
    game.player.totalScore = game.score;
    game.lastStats = {
      level: game.level.name,
      elapsed: elapsed.toFixed(1),
      timeBonus, coinBonus, enemyBonus, levelScore, total: game.score
    };
    game.state = 'levelComplete';
  }

  function nextLevel(){
    if(game.levelIndex < game.levels.length-1){
      loadLevel(game.levelIndex+1,false);
      game.state='playing';
    }else{
      game.state='victory';
    }
  }

  function loseLife(reason=''){
    const p = game.player;
    if(p.invuln>0) return;
    if(p.shield>0){
      p.shield = 0;
      p.invuln = 1.2;
      audio.sfx('hit');
      return;
    }
    p.lives--;
    p.invuln = 2;
    audio.sfx('hit');
    if(p.lives<=0){
      game.state='gameOver';
      return;
    }
    p.x = p.spawnX; p.y = p.spawnY;
    p.vx = p.vy = 0;
  }

  function solidRects(level){
    const arr = [];
    for(const g of level.grounds) arr.push(g);
    for(const p of level.platforms) arr.push(p);
    for(const c of level.crates) arr.push(c);
    return arr;
  }

  function update(dt){
    if(game.state!=='playing') return;
    const l = game.level, p = game.player;
    game.timer += dt;

    // moving platforms
    for(const plat of l.platforms){
      if(plat.type==='moving'){
        plat.t += dt*plat.speed/100;
        const ox = Math.sin(plat.t)*plat.dx;
        const oy = Math.sin(plat.t*0.9)*plat.dy;
        plat.prevX = plat.x; plat.prevY = plat.y;
        plat.x = plat.baseX + ox;
        plat.y = plat.baseY + oy;
      }
    }

    // level hazards: sandstorm
    if(l.sandstorm){
      l.stormTimer += dt;
      const cyc = l.stormTimer % 13;
      l.stormActive = cyc > 6.5 && cyc < 10.8;
      if(l.stormActive){
        game.sandOverlay = lerp(game.sandOverlay,0.75,dt*4);
        p.vx += -120*dt;
        l.stormDamageTick += dt;
        if(l.stormDamageTick>1.2){
          l.stormDamageTick = 0;
          if(Math.random()<0.35) loseLife('sandstorm');
        }
      }else{
        game.sandOverlay = lerp(game.sandOverlay,0,dt*2);
      }
    }

    // input
    const left = keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['KeyA'];
    const right = keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['KeyD'];
    const jump = justPressed['Space'] || justPressed['KeyW'] || justPressed['ArrowUp'];
    const dash = justPressed['ShiftLeft'] || justPressed['ShiftRight'] || justPressed['KeyC'];
    const attack = justPressed['KeyX'] || justPressed['KeyJ'];

    const accel = 1250;
    const maxSpeed = 290;
    const airCtrl = 0.72;

    // timers
    p.attackCooldown = Math.max(0,p.attackCooldown-dt);
    p.attackTimer = Math.max(0,p.attackTimer-dt);
    p.dashCooldown = Math.max(0,p.dashCooldown-dt);
    p.dashTimer = Math.max(0,p.dashTimer-dt);
    p.invuln = Math.max(0,p.invuln-dt);
    p.babouche = Math.max(0,p.babouche-dt);
    p.shield = Math.max(0,p.shield-dt);

    // dash
    if(dash && p.dashCooldown<=0){
      p.dashTimer = 0.14;
      p.dashCooldown = 0.9;
      p.invuln = Math.max(p.invuln,0.25);
      p.vx = p.facing*670;
      p.vy *= 0.2;
      audio.sfx('dash');
    }

    if(p.dashTimer<=0){
      let targetAcc = p.onGround?accel:accel*airCtrl;
      if(left){ p.vx -= targetAcc*dt; p.facing=-1; }
      if(right){ p.vx += targetAcc*dt; p.facing=1; }

      const standingOn = p.onPlat;
      let friction = 10;
      if(standingOn && standingOn.type==='slippery') friction = 2.8;
      if(!left && !right){
        p.vx = lerp(p.vx,0,Math.min(1,friction*dt));
      }
      p.vx = clamp(p.vx,-maxSpeed,maxSpeed);
    }

    if(jump && p.onGround){
      p.vy = -(p.babouche>0?760:610);
      p.onGround = false;
      audio.sfx('jump');
    }

    if(attack && p.attackCooldown<=0){
      p.attackTimer = 0.18;
      p.attackCooldown = 0.28;
      audio.sfx('enemy');
    }

    // gravity
    p.vy += GRAVITY*dt;
    if(p.vy>1100) p.vy=1100;

    // if standing on moving platform carry
    if(p.onPlat && p.onPlat.type==='moving'){
      const dpx = (p.onPlat.x - (p.onPlat.prevX ?? p.onPlat.x));
      const dpy = (p.onPlat.y - (p.onPlat.prevY ?? p.onPlat.y));
      p.x += dpx; p.y += dpy;
    }

    // move x
    p.x += p.vx*dt;
    let solids = solidRects(l);
    p.onPlat = null;
    for(const s of solids){
      if(rectsIntersect(p,s)){
        if(p.vx>0) p.x = s.x - p.w;
        else if(p.vx<0) p.x = s.x + s.w;
        p.vx = 0;
      }
    }

    // move y
    p.y += p.vy*dt;
    p.onGround=false;
    for(const s of solids){
      if(rectsIntersect(p,s)){
        if(p.vy>0){
          p.y = s.y - p.h;
          p.vy = 0;
          p.onGround = true;
          p.onPlat = s;
        }else if(p.vy<0){
          p.y = s.y + s.h;
          p.vy = 40;
        }
      }
    }

    // boundaries / pit
    p.x = clamp(p.x,0,l.worldW-p.w);
    if(p.y > H+200) loseLife('fall');

    // checkpoint
    for(const cp of l.checkpoints){
      if(!cp.active && p.x+ p.w/2 >= cp.x){
        cp.active = true;
        p.spawnX = cp.x+10;
        p.spawnY = 320;
        game.msg = "Checkpoint!";
      }
    }

    // coins
    for(const c of l.coins){
      if(c.collected) continue;
      const dx = (p.x+p.w/2)-c.x, dy=(p.y+p.h/2)-c.y;
      if(dx*dx+dy*dy < (p.w*0.5+11)*(p.w*0.5+11)){
        c.collected=true;
        p.coins++;
        game.score += 25;
        audio.sfx('coin');
      }
    }

    // powerups
    for(const pu of l.powerups){
      if(pu.collected) continue;
      if(rectsIntersect(p,{x:pu.x,y:pu.y,w:pu.w,h:pu.h})){
        pu.collected=true;
        if(pu.type==='babouche') p.babouche = 14;
        if(pu.type==='tajine') p.shield = 13;
        game.score += 120;
        audio.sfx('power');
      }
    }

    // enemies
    const atkBox = (p.attackTimer>0)?{
      x: p.facing>0 ? p.x+p.w-2 : p.x-36,
      y: p.y+12, w:36, h:26
    }:null;

    for(const e of l.enemies){
      if(!e.alive) continue;
      if(e.type==='scarab'){
        e.x += e.vx*e.dir*dt;
        if(e.x < 10 || e.x > l.worldW-60) e.dir*=-1;
        if(Math.abs(e.x - (e.anchor??(e.anchor=e.x))) > e.range) e.dir*=-1;
        // keep on ground by simple ray
        let gy = 430;
        for(const g of l.grounds){ if(e.x+e.w/2>=g.x && e.x+e.w/2<g.x+g.w){ gy = g.y- e.h; break; } }
        e.y = gy;
      }else if(e.type==='pigeon'){
        e.x += 80*dt*(Math.sin(game.timer+e.phase)>0?1:-1);
        e.y = e.baseY + Math.sin(game.timer*2+e.phase)*24;
        e.x = clamp(e.x,60,l.worldW-60);
      }else if(e.type==='bandit'){
        const dist = (p.x-e.x);
        if(Math.abs(dist)<240) e.dir = dist>0?1:-1;
        e.x += e.vx*e.dir*dt;
        if(Math.abs(e.x - (e.anchor??(e.anchor=e.x))) > e.range) e.dir*=-1;
        let gy = 420;
        for(const g of l.grounds){ if(e.x+e.w/2>=g.x && e.x+e.w/2<g.x+g.w){ gy = g.y- e.h; break; } }
        e.y = gy;
      }

      const er = {x:e.x,y:e.y,w:e.w,h:e.h};
      if(atkBox && rectsIntersect(atkBox,er)){
        if(e.type==='bandit'){
          e.hp--;
          if(e.hp<=0){ e.alive=false; game.enemiesDefeated++; game.score += 110; }
        } else {
          e.alive=false; game.enemiesDefeated++; game.score += 90;
        }
        audio.sfx('enemy');
      }

      if(rectsIntersect(p,er)){
        const stomp = p.vy>150 && (p.y+p.h-8)<e.y+8;
        if(stomp){
          e.alive=false; p.vy=-360; game.enemiesDefeated++; game.score += 80; audio.sfx('enemy');
        }else{
          loseLife('enemy');
        }
      }
    }

    // boss logic
    if(l.boss && !l.boss.defeated){
      const b = l.boss;
      if(!b.active && p.x > 1320){
        b.active = true;
        b.state = 'idle';
        b.timer = 1.1;
        audio.sfx('boss');
      }
      if(b.active){
        b.hitCD = Math.max(0,b.hitCD-dt);
        b.timer -= dt;

        if(b.state==='idle' && b.timer<=0){
          const cycle = (Math.random()*3)|0;
          if(cycle===0){ b.state='teleJump'; b.timer=0.85; }
          else if(cycle===1){ b.state='teleThrow'; b.timer=0.95; }
          else { b.state='teleCharge'; b.timer=0.8; }
        }
        if(b.state==='teleJump' && b.timer<=0){
          b.state='jump'; b.vy=-760; b.vx=(p.x>b.x?140:-140); b.onGround=false;
        }
        if(b.state==='jump'){
          b.vy += GRAVITY*dt;
          b.x += b.vx*dt; b.y += b.vy*dt;
          const gy = 475-b.h;
          if(b.y>=gy){
            b.y=gy; b.vy=0; b.vx=0; b.state='slam'; b.timer=0.4;
            b.shockwaves.push({x:b.x+b.w/2,y:475-16,dir:-1,speed:320,alive:true});
            b.shockwaves.push({x:b.x+b.w/2,y:475-16,dir:1,speed:320,alive:true});
            audio.sfx('hit');
          }
        }
        if(b.state==='slam' && b.timer<=0){ b.state='idle'; b.timer=1.0; }

        if(b.state==='teleThrow' && b.timer<=0){
          b.state='throw'; b.timer=1.1;
          for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
            const angle = -Math.PI*0.75 + i*0.22 + (p.x<b.x?-0.15:0.15);
            b.projectiles.push({x:b.x+b.w/2,y:b.y+20,vx:Math.cos(angle)*260,vy:Math.sin(angle)*260,w:24,h:24,alive:true});
          }
          audio.sfx('boss');
        }
        if(b.state==='throw' && b.timer<=0){ b.state='idle'; b.timer=0.8; }

        if(b.state==='teleCharge' && b.timer<=0){
          b.state='charge'; b.vx = (p.x>b.x?1:-1)*460; b.timer=1.2;
        }
        if(b.state==='charge'){
          b.x += b.vx*dt;
          if(b.x<1220 || b.x>2060-b.w){ b.vx*=-1; b.timer-=0.35; }
          if(b.timer<=0){ b.vx=0; b.state='idle'; b.timer=1.0; }
        }

        // projectiles
        for(const pr of b.projectiles){
          if(!pr.alive) continue;
          pr.vy += 1200*dt;
          pr.x += pr.vx*dt; pr.y += pr.vy*dt;
          if(pr.y>520 || pr.x<1150 || pr.x>2200) pr.alive=false;
          if(rectsIntersect(p,pr)){ pr.alive=false; loseLife('bossProj'); }
        }
        for(const sw of b.shockwaves){
          if(!sw.alive) continue;
          sw.x += sw.dir*sw.speed*dt;
          if(sw.x<1120||sw.x>2140) sw.alive=false;
          if(Math.abs((p.x+p.w/2)-sw.x)<22 && p.y+p.h>445) loseLife('shockwave');
        }

        // player attack to boss
        const br = {x:b.x,y:b.y,w:b.w,h:b.h};
        if(atkBox && rectsIntersect(atkBox,br) && b.hitCD<=0){
          b.hp--; b.hitCD = 0.25; game.score += 90; audio.sfx('enemy');
          if(b.hp<=0){
            b.defeated=true; b.active=false;
            game.score += 2000;
            game.msg = "Guardiano sconfitto!";
          }
        }

        if(rectsIntersect(p,br) && b.state!=='slam' && b.state!=='teleThrow'){
          loseLife('bossTouch');
        }
      }
    }

    // camera
    const targetCam = p.x - W*0.35;
    game.cameraX = clamp(lerp(game.cameraX,targetCam,dt*4),0,Math.max(0,l.worldW-W));

    // goal
    if(l.boss){
      if(l.boss.defeated && p.x > l.goalX-40){
        completeLevel();
      }
    } else if(p.x > l.goalX){
      completeLevel();
    }

    if(game.msg) setTimeout(()=>{game.msg='';},800);

    for(const k in justPressed) justPressed[k]=false;
    mouse.clicked=false;
  }

  function drawBackground(theme, camX){
    if(theme==='medina'){
      const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H); g.addColorStop(0,'#7ec8e3'); g.addColorStop(1,'#f9e7c6');
      ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
      ctx.fillStyle='#d6a86f';
      for(let i=0;i<8;i++){
        const x=(i*260-camX*0.3)%2200;
        ctx.fillRect(x,210,170,250);
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,210); ctx.arc(x+85,210,85,Math.PI,0); ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.fillStyle='#b77b47';
      for(let i=0;i<12;i++){
        const x=(i*190-camX*0.45)%2400;
        ctx.fillRect(x,280,120,180);
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x+20,280); ctx.arc(x+60,280,40,Math.PI,0); ctx.fill();
      }
    }else if(theme==='desert'){
      const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H); g.addColorStop(0,'#87d7ff'); g.addColorStop(0.55,'#ffd084'); g.addColorStop(1,'#e8a457');
      ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
      ctx.fillStyle='#f6d365';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(820,90,55,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
        ctx.fillStyle=i%2?'#eebf6f':'#e4a85f';
        ctx.beginPath();
        const y=360+i*28;
        ctx.moveTo(-120,y);
        for(let x=-120;x<=W+140;x+=50) ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+25,y+(i%2?22:-18),x+50,y);
        ctx.lineTo(W+140,H); ctx.lineTo(-120,H); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      }
    }else if(theme==='oasis'){
      const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H); g.addColorStop(0,'#8ed7c6'); g.addColorStop(1,'#ffd49a');
      ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
      ctx.fillStyle='#74c69d';
      ctx.fillRect(0,380,W,60);
      ctx.fillStyle='#5dade2';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(280-camX*0.05,410,170,46,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle='#8b5e34';
      for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
        const x=120+i*170-(camX*0.2%170);
        ctx.fillRect(x,290,10,110);
        ctx.fillStyle='#2a9d8f';
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x+5,284,28,20,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle='#8b5e34';
      }
    }else{
      const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H); g.addColorStop(0,'#2b2d42'); g.addColorStop(1,'#8d99ae');
      ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
      for(let i=0;i<30;i++){
        ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,220,120,0.3)';
        const x=(i*83-camX*0.25)%1100,y=60+(i%8)*40;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,3+(i%3),0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.fillStyle='#5c3d2e';
      ctx.fillRect(0,320,W,220);
      ctx.fillStyle='#7f5539';
      for(let i=0;i<10;i++){ ctx.fillRect(i*110-(camX*0.35%110),280,70,260); }
    }
  }

  function drawWorld(){
    const l=game.level,p=game.player,cam=game.cameraX;
    drawBackground(l.theme,cam);

    // goal arch
    ctx.save();
    const gx=l.goalX-cam;
    ctx.translate(gx,330);
    ctx.fillStyle='#8c6239'; ctx.fillRect(-20,0,70,160);
    ctx.fillRect(120,0,70,160);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(85,0,85,Math.PI,0); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    // grounds
    for(const g of l.grounds){
      const x=g.x-cam; if(x+g.w<0||x>W) continue;
      ctx.fillStyle = l.theme==='desert' ? '#d39b56' : (l.theme==='oasis'?'#b08968':'#c08a58');
      ctx.fillRect(x,g.y,g.w,g.h);
      ctx.strokeStyle='#7f5539'; ctx.lineWidth=2; ctx.strokeRect(x,g.y,g.w,18);
    }

    // platforms
    for(const pl of l.platforms){
      const x=pl.x-cam,y=pl.y;if(x+pl.w<0||x>W) continue;
      if(pl.type==='slippery'){
        ctx.fillStyle='#d1495b';
        ctx.fillRect(x,y,pl.w,pl.h);
        ctx.fillStyle='#ff8fa3';
        for(let i=0;i<pl.w;i+=14) ctx.fillRect(x+i,y+6,8,4);
      }else{
        ctx.fillStyle=pl.type==='moving'?'#a98467':'#9c6644';
        ctx.fillRect(x,y,pl.w,pl.h);
      }
      ctx.strokeStyle='#5e3023'; ctx.lineWidth=2; ctx.strokeRect(x,y,pl.w,pl.h);
    }

    // crates
    for(const c of l.crates){
      const x=c.x-cam;if(x+c.w<0||x>W) continue;
      ctx.fillStyle='#b5651d'; ctx.fillRect(x,c.y,c.w,c.h);
      ctx.strokeStyle='#7f4f24'; ctx.lineWidth=3; ctx.strokeRect(x,c.y,c.w,c.h);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,c.y); ctx.lineTo(x+c.w,c.y+c.h); ctx.moveTo(x+c.w,c.y); ctx.lineTo(x,c.y+c.h); ctx.stroke();
    }

    // checkpoints
    for(const cp of l.checkpoints){
      const x=cp.x-cam; if(x<-20||x>W+20) continue;
      ctx.strokeStyle='#2d6a4f'; ctx.lineWidth=4;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,460); ctx.lineTo(x,370); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle=cp.active?'#06d6a0':'#f1fa8c';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,375); ctx.lineTo(x+36,388); ctx.lineTo(x,402); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    }

    // coins
    for(const c of l.coins){
      if(c.collected) continue;
      const x=c.x-cam, y=c.y+Math.sin(game.timer*6 + c.x*0.01)*4;
      if(x<-20||x>W+20) continue;
      ctx.fillStyle='#ffd166';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,c.r,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle='#fca311'; ctx.lineWidth=3; ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle='#9c6644'; ctx.font='bold 11px sans-serif'; ctx.fillText('D',x-4,y+4);
    }

    // powerups
    for(const pu of l.powerups){
      if(pu.collected) continue;
      const x=pu.x-cam,y=pu.y+Math.sin(game.timer*4+pu.x*0.02)*3;
      if(x<-30||x>W+30) continue;
      if(pu.type==='babouche'){
        ctx.fillStyle='#ff9f1c'; ctx.strokeStyle='#8d5524'; ctx.lineWidth=2;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,y+20); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+8,y+5,x+22,y+16); ctx.lineTo(x+18,y+25); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
      }else{
        ctx.fillStyle='#e76f51'; ctx.strokeStyle='#7f5539'; ctx.lineWidth=2;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x+15,y+18,14,10,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle='#f4a261'; ctx.fillRect(x+5,y+8,20,8);
      }
    }

    // enemies
    for(const e of l.enemies){
      if(!e.alive) continue;
      const x=e.x-cam,y=e.y;
      if(x<-80||x>W+80) continue;
      if(e.type==='scarab'){
        ctx.fillStyle='#2d6a4f'; ctx.strokeStyle='#1b4332'; ctx.lineWidth=2;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x+14,y+12,14,10,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle='#40916c'; ctx.fillRect(x+4,y+6,20,4);
      }else if(e.type==='pigeon'){
        ctx.fillStyle='#8d99ae'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x+15,y+12,14,10,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle='#edf2f4'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x+21,y+9,5,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle='#2b2d42'; ctx.lineWidth=2;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x+4,y+12); ctx.lineTo(x-6+Math.sin(game.timer*16)*4,y+8); ctx.moveTo(x+26,y+12); ctx.lineTo(x+36-Math.sin(game.timer*16)*4,y+8); ctx.stroke();
      }else{
        ctx.fillStyle='#6d597a'; ctx.fillRect(x+8,y+14,20,30);
        ctx.fillStyle='#ffdab9'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x+18,y+11,10,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle='#b56576'; ctx.fillRect(x+8,y+8,20,5);
        ctx.fillStyle='#222'; ctx.fillRect(x+12,y+40,6,10); ctx.fillRect(x+20,y+40,6,10);
      }
    }

    // boss
    if(l.boss && (l.boss.active || l.boss.defeated)){
      const b=l.boss;
      const x=b.x-cam,y=b.y;
      ctx.save();
      let color='#7f5539';
      if(b.state.startsWith('tele')) color='#ef476f';
      if(b.state==='charge') color='#f77f00';
      ctx.fillStyle=color; ctx.strokeStyle='#2d1e2f'; ctx.lineWidth=4;
      ctx.fillRect(x+18,y+35,70,80);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x+53,y+30,28,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle='#ffddb3'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x+53,y+30,16,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle='#2d1e2f'; ctx.fillRect(x+40,y+92,16,24); ctx.fillRect(x+63,y+92,16,24);
      ctx.fillStyle='#9c6644'; ctx.fillRect(x+8,y+58,18,14); ctx.fillRect(x+88,y+58,18,14);
      ctx.restore();

      for(const pr of b.projectiles){
        if(!pr.alive) continue;
        ctx.fillStyle='#b5651d'; ctx.fillRect(pr.x-cam,pr.y,pr.w,pr.h);
        ctx.strokeStyle='#7f4f24'; ctx.strokeRect(pr.x-cam,pr.y,pr.w,pr.h);
      }
      for(const sw of b.shockwaves){
        if(!sw.alive) continue;
        ctx.fillStyle='#ef476f';
        ctx.fillRect(sw.x-14-cam,457,28,8);
      }

      // boss hp bar
      ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.45)';
      ctx.fillRect(W/2-180,20,360,18);
      ctx.fillStyle='#e63946';
      ctx.fillRect(W/2-178,22,(356)*(b.hp/b.maxHp),14);
      ctx.strokeStyle='#fff'; ctx.strokeRect(W/2-180,20,360,18);
      ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='bold 14px sans-serif'; ctx.fillText('Guardiano del Souk',W/2-72,16);
    }

    // player
    drawPlayer(p,cam);

    // storm overlay
    if(game.sandOverlay>0.02){
      ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(237, 196, 120, ${game.sandOverlay*0.45})`;
      ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
      ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(245,222,179,${game.sandOverlay*0.7})`;
      for(let i=0;i<80;i++){
        const y=(i*13 + (game.timer*260)%H)%H;
        const x=((i*59 - game.timer*350)%W+W)%W;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,y); ctx.lineTo(x+20,y-3); ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
  }

  function drawPlayer(p,cam){
    const x=p.x-cam,y=p.y;
    ctx.save();
    if(p.invuln>0 && Math.floor(game.timer*16)%2===0) ctx.globalAlpha=0.55;
    // robe
    ctx.fillStyle='#2a9d8f'; ctx.strokeStyle='#1d6f67'; ctx.lineWidth=2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x+7,y+52); ctx.lineTo(x+27,y+52); ctx.lineTo(x+30,y+24); ctx.lineTo(x+4,y+24); ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
    // vest
    ctx.fillStyle='#e9c46a'; ctx.fillRect(x+10,y+28,14,20);
    // head
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffddb3'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x+17,y+15,11,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    // modern chechia cap
    ctx.fillStyle='#e63946'; ctx.fillRect(x+8,y+3,18,6);
    ctx.fillStyle='#c1121f'; ctx.fillRect(x+13,y+0,8,4);
    // scarf
    ctx.strokeStyle='#f4a261'; ctx.lineWidth=3; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x+6,y+25); ctx.lineTo(x+29,y+25); ctx.stroke();
    // legs
    ctx.fillStyle='#264653';
    ctx.fillRect(x+9,y+52,7,2);
    ctx.fillRect(x+19,y+52,7,2);
    // attack slash
    if(p.attackTimer>0){
      ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.8)'; ctx.lineWidth=4;
      const sx = p.facing>0 ? x+p.w+6 : x-6;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx,y+24,16,p.facing>0?-0.7:Math.PI-0.7,p.facing>0?0.7:Math.PI+0.7); ctx.stroke();
    }
    // shield glow
    if(p.shield>0){
      ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(66, 135, 245, 0.7)'; ctx.lineWidth=3;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x+17,y+28,24,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawUI(){
    const p=game.player;
    // top panel
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.35)'; ctx.fillRect(8,8,320,92);
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.25)'; ctx.strokeRect(8,8,320,92);

    ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='bold 18px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Vite:',18,33);
    for(let i=0;i<p.lives;i++){
      ctx.fillStyle='#ef476f';
      const hx=72+i*22, hy=24;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(hx,hy);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(hx-8,hy-8,hx-18,hy+4,hx,hy+16);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(hx+18,hy+4,hx+8,hy-8,hx,hy);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    ctx.fillStyle='#ffd166'; ctx.fillText('Dinar:',18,58);
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.fillText(p.coins,90,58);

    ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.fillText('Punteggio: '+game.score,18,82);

    // power bar
    const val = Math.max(p.babouche/14, p.shield/13);
    let label = 'Nessun Power-up';
    if(p.babouche>0) label='Babouche-Boost';
    if(p.shield>0) label='Tajine-Shield';
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.35)'; ctx.fillRect(340,8,260,46);
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.25)'; ctx.strokeRect(340,8,260,46);
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='bold 14px sans-serif'; ctx.fillText(label,350,26);
    ctx.fillStyle='#555'; ctx.fillRect(350,32,240,12);
    ctx.fillStyle=p.shield>0?'#4dabf7':'#ff9f1c';
    ctx.fillRect(350,32,240*val,12);

    // controls hint
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.3)'; ctx.fillRect(W-338,8,330,64);
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.2)'; ctx.strokeRect(W-338,8,330,64);
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='12px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Move: ← → / A D   Salto: SPACE   Dash: SHIFT/C   Attacco: X/J   M: Mute',W-330,32);
    ctx.fillText(game.level.name, W-330,54);

    if(game.msg){
      ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.4)'; ctx.fillRect(W/2-100,80,200,34);
      ctx.fillStyle='#f1fa8c'; ctx.font='bold 20px sans-serif'; ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.fillText(game.msg,W/2,104); ctx.textAlign='left';
    }
  }

  function drawButton(btn){
    ctx.fillStyle = btn.hover ? '#3a506b' : '#1f2f46';
    ctx.fillRect(btn.x,btn.y,btn.w,btn.h);
    ctx.strokeStyle='#ffd166'; ctx.lineWidth=3; ctx.strokeRect(btn.x,btn.y,btn.w,btn.h);
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='bold 24px sans-serif'; ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
    ctx.fillText(btn.text,btn.x+btn.w/2,btn.y+btn.h/2);
    ctx.textAlign='left'; ctx.textBaseline='alphabetic';
  }

  function uiScreen(title, lines, buttons){
    ctx.fillStyle='#14213d'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    // decor
    for(let i=0;i<12;i++){
      ctx.fillStyle = i%2?'#fca31122':'#2ec4b622';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(90+i*78,80+(i%3)*40,36,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='bold 48px sans-serif'; ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText(title,W/2,120);
    ctx.font='22px sans-serif';
    let y=190;
    for(const ln of lines){ ctx.fillText(ln,W/2,y); y+=34; }
    ctx.textAlign='left';
    game.buttons = buttons;
    for(const b of game.buttons){
      b.hover = mouse.x>=b.x && mouse.x<=b.x+b.w && mouse.y>=b.y && mouse.y<=b.y+b.h;
      drawButton(b);
    }
  }

  function render(){
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);

    if(game.state==='menu'){
      uiScreen('SOUK SPRINT',[
        'Platform 2D cartoon vettoriale ispirato ai classici arcade anni ’90',
        'Ambientazione tunisina • 4 livelli (Medina, Deserto, Oasi, Boss finale)',
        'Raccogli Dinar-coin, usa Babouche-Boost e Tajine-Shield'
      ],[
        {x:W/2-130,y:300,w:260,h:62,text:'GIOCA'},
        {x:W/2-130,y:380,w:260,h:54,text:audio.muted?'Audio: OFF':'Audio: ON'}
      ]);
    }else if(game.state==='playing'){
      drawWorld();
      drawUI();
    }else if(game.state==='levelComplete'){
      const s = game.lastStats;
      uiScreen('Livello Completato!',[
        s.level,
        `Tempo: ${s.elapsed}s   Bonus Tempo: ${s.timeBonus}`,
        `Bonus Monete: ${s.coinBonus}   Bonus Nemici: ${s.enemyBonus}`,
        `Punteggio Livello: ${s.levelScore}`,
        `Punteggio Totale: ${s.total}`
      ],[
        {x:W/2-130,y:390,w:260,h:62,text:'CONTINUA'}
      ]);
    }else if(game.state==='gameOver'){
      uiScreen('Game Over',[
        'Il Guardiano e il Souk ti aspettano ancora!',
        `Punteggio finale: ${game.score}`
      ],[
        {x:W/2-130,y:360,w:260,h:62,text:'RIPROVA'},
        {x:W/2-130,y:435,w:260,h:54,text:'MENU'}
      ]);
    }else if(game.state==='victory'){
      uiScreen('Vittoria!',[
        'Hai sconfitto il Guardiano del Souk!',
        `Dinar raccolti: ${game.player.coins}`,
        `Nemici sconfitti: ${game.enemiesDefeated}`,
        `Punteggio finale: ${game.score}`
      ],[
        {x:W/2-130,y:380,w:260,h:62,text:'NUOVA PARTITA'},
        {x:W/2-130,y:455,w:260,h:54,text:'MENU'}
      ]);
    }
  }

  function handleClicks(){
    if(!mouse.clicked) return;
    if(game.state==='menu'){
      const [b1,b2]=game.buttons;
      if(hitBtn(b1)){ audio.init(); audio.startMusic(); startNewGame(); }
      else if(hitBtn(b2)){ audio.init(); audio.toggleMute(); }
    }else if(game.state==='levelComplete'){
      if(hitBtn(game.buttons[0])) nextLevel();
    }else if(game.state==='gameOver'){
      if(hitBtn(game.buttons[0])) startNewGame();
      else if(hitBtn(game.buttons[1])) game.state='menu';
    }else if(game.state==='victory'){
      if(hitBtn(game.buttons[0])) startNewGame();
      else if(hitBtn(game.buttons[1])) game.state='menu';
    }
    mouse.clicked=false;
  }

  function hitBtn(b){
    return b && mouse.x>=b.x&&mouse.x<=b.x+b.w&&mouse.y>=b.y&&mouse.y<=b.y+b.h;
  }

  let last=performance.now();
  function loop(now){
    let dt=(now-last)/1000; last=now;
    dt=Math.min(0.033,dt);

    update(dt);
    render();
    handleClicks();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  // input
  window.addEventListener('keydown',(e)=>{
    if(!keys[e.code]) justPressed[e.code]=true;
    keys[e.code]=true;
    if(['ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','Space'].includes(e.code)) e.preventDefault();
    if(e.code==='KeyM'){ audio.init(); audio.toggleMute(); }
    if(game.state==='menu' && e.code==='Enter'){ audio.init(); audio.startMusic(); startNewGame(); }
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup',(e)=>{ keys[e.code]=false; });

  function updateMousePos(e){
    const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const sx=W/r.width, sy=H/r.height;
    mouse.x=(e.clientX-r.left)*sx; mouse.y=(e.clientY-r.top)*sy;
  }
  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove',updateMousePos);
  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown',(e)=>{ updateMousePos(e); mouse.down=true; mouse.clicked=true; });
  canvas.addEventListener('mouseup',()=>{ mouse.down=false; });

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

Présentation

L’apprentissage du français
en milieu rural

Favoriser l’égalité des chances linguistiques, scolaires et sociales.

École Familles Communauté Numérique

Pourquoi c’est un enjeu majeur ?

  • Le français est la langue d’accès aux savoirs scolaires et administratifs.
  • En zone rurale, l’éloignement et le manque de ressources accentuent les inégalités.
  • Une bonne maîtrise du français améliore l’insertion, la confiance et la mobilité.
+ réussiteprogression scolaire
+ inclusionparticipation citoyenne
+ aveniraccès à l’emploi

Principaux défis en milieu rural

Contraintes structurelles

  • Distance entre domicile, école, bibliothèque et centres de formation.
  • Classes multi-niveaux avec temps pédagogique limité.
  • Accès inégal à Internet et aux outils numériques.

Contraintes socio-linguistiques

  • Faible exposition quotidienne au français standard.
  • Manque de supports écrits à la maison (livres, presse, jeux de mots).
  • Parfois peu de temps disponible pour l’accompagnement parental.

Leviers efficaces

  • Approche contextualisée : apprendre le français à partir de la vie locale (marché, agriculture, patrimoine, métiers).
  • Pédagogie active : jeux de rôle, débats, théâtre, radio scolaire, carnet de terrain.
  • Rituels quotidiens : 15 à 20 minutes de lecture, dictée négociée, expression orale.
  • Partenariats : médiathèques itinérantes, associations, collectivités, maisons de jeunes.

Exemples d’activités concrètes

En classe

  • Ateliers “Parler pour raconter” sur des expériences du village.
  • Création d’un journal local des élèves.
  • Correspondance inter-écoles (papier + audio).

Hors classe

  • Clubs lecture dans les mairies et centres communautaires.
  • Concours de contes en français avec les familles.
  • Balades linguistiques : nommer, décrire, interviewer.

Rôle clé des acteurs locaux

  • Enseignants : différenciation pédagogique et suivi individuel.
  • Parents : valorisation de la parole, de la lecture et des échanges quotidiens.
  • Collectivités : transport, équipement, espaces d’apprentissage.
  • Jeunes mentors : tutorat linguistique et aide aux devoirs.

Objectif : créer un écosystème où le français est pratiqué dans tous les lieux de vie.

Plan d’action en 4 étapes

  1. Diagnostiquer les besoins linguistiques des élèves et des familles.
  2. Former les enseignants aux pratiques d’oral, lecture et écriture adaptées.
  3. Déployer des activités hebdomadaires en classe et dans la communauté.
  4. Évaluer les progrès (compréhension, expression, confiance) chaque trimestre.
Conclusion

Investir dans le français en milieu rural,
c’est investir dans l’avenir

Un apprentissage régulier, concret et collectif permet de réduire les écarts, de renforcer la réussite scolaire et de dynamiser les territoires ruraux.

Message clé : proximité + pédagogie + communauté = impact durable.

prompt: # Game Development Brief: "Sky Runner - Aviation Endless Runner"## Core ConceptBuild a 3D endless runner game inspired by Subway Surfers but with a CUSTOM AIRPLANE/THEME. Instead of running on train tracks, the player pilots a small aircraft through an aerial obstacle course.## Key Differences from Subway Surfers| Subway Surfers | Sky Runner (This Game) ||---------------|------------------------|| Ground-based running | Aerial flight mechanics || Train tracks | Sky lanes with cloud corridors || Jump/roll/dodge | Pitch up/down, barrel roll, boost || Coin collection | Fuel orbs + cargo packages || Police chase | Storm cloud pursuit system |## Game Mechanics1. **Movement:** 3-lane horizontal system (left, center, right) + vertical pitch control2. **Actions:** - Swipe Up: Climb altitude - Swipe Down: Dive - Swipe Left/Right: Change lanes - Double Tap: Barrel roll (invincibility frame)3. **Obstacles:** - Other aircraft (must dodge) - Storm clouds (slowdown zone) - Bird flocks (damage) - Air traffic control towers - Turbulence zones4. **Collectibles:** - Fuel orbs (extend run time) - Cargo crates (bonus points) - Golden propellers (currency) - Power-ups: Turbo boost, Shield, Magnet## Visual Style- **Art Direction:** Low-poly stylized 3D (like Subway Surfers but aviation-themed)- **Color Palette:** Sky blues, sunset oranges, cloud whites, metallic grays- **Environment:** Dynamic skybox with day/night cycle, volumetric clouds- **Player Character:** Customizable pilot with different aircraft skins- **UI:** Minimalist HUD, altitude meter, fuel gauge, score counter## Technical Stack- **Engine:** Unity 2023 LTS or Three.js (for web-based)- **Language:** C# (Unity) or JavaScript/TypeScript (Three.js)- **Physics:** Custom arcade physics (not realistic flight sim)- **Platform:** Mobile (iOS/Android) + Web GL- **Performance:** 60 FPS target, LOD system for distant objects## Required Features1. **Main Menu:** Hangar scene with aircraft selection2. **Game Loop:** Endless procedurally generated sky lanes3. **Progression:** Unlock new planes, pilots, and trails4. **Leaderboard:** Global and friend scores5. **Daily Challenges:** Specific mission types (collect X fuel, dodge Y birds)6. **Shop System:** In-game currency for cosmetics7. **Save System:** Cloud save for progress## Deliverables- Complete project structure- Player controller script with swipe gestures- Obstacle spawning system (object pooling)- Collision detection and damage system- UI manager (score, fuel, game over screen)- 3 sample aircraft models (placeholder or procedurally generated)- Background music + SFX placeholders## Unique Selling Points1. **Verticality:** Unlike Subway Surfers, players can change altitude2. **Aircraft Customization:** Wings, engines, paint jobs, contrail effects3. **Weather System:** Dynamic weather affects gameplay (rain = slippery, wind = lane drift)4. **Multiplayer Mode:** Real-time race against ghost data of other players# OutputGenerate the complete codebase structure, core gameplay scripts, and UI components. Include comments for easy customization. Make it modular for future feature additions.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0" />
<title>Pixel Terra RPG</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; background: #0b0f1b; font-family: monospace; }
  canvas { display: block; image-rendering: pixelated; cursor: crosshair; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;

  function resize() {
    canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
  resize();

  const TILE = 24;
  const WORLD_W = 260;
  const WORLD_H = 100;
  const GRAVITY = 1650;
  const MAX_FALL = 850;

  const TILE_DEF = {
    0: { name: "Air", solid: false, hardness: 0, color: "#00000000", drop: 0 },
    1: { name: "Grass", solid: true, hardness: 0.9, drop: 2 },
    2: { name: "Dirt", solid: true, hardness: 0.9, drop: 2 },
    3: { name: "Stone", solid: true, hardness: 1.8, drop: 3 },
    4: { name: "Wood", solid: true, hardness: 1.2, drop: 4 },
    5: { name: "Leaf", solid: false, hardness: 0.45, drop: 0 },
    6: { name: "Copper", solid: true, hardness: 2.2, drop: 6 },
  };
  const HOTBAR = [2,3,4,1,6];

  const world = Array.from({length: WORLD_H}, () => new Uint8Array(WORLD_W));
  const surface = new Int16Array(WORLD_W);

  function clamp(v,a,b){ return v<a?a:v>b?b:v; }
  function rnd(a,b){ return Math.random()*(b-a)+a; }
  function irnd(a,b){ return (Math.random()*(b-a+1)|0)+a; }

  function hash2(x,y){
    let n = x * 374761393 + y * 668265263;
    n = (n ^ (n >> 13)) * 1274126177;
    n = n ^ (n >> 16);
    return (n >>> 0) / 4294967295;
  }

  function generateWorld() {
    let h = Math.floor(WORLD_H * 0.42);
    for (let x=0;x<WORLD_W;x++){
      h += irnd(-1,1);
      h = clamp(h, Math.floor(WORLD_H*0.30), Math.floor(WORLD_H*0.55));
      surface[x] = h;

      for (let y=0;y<WORLD_H;y++){
        if (y < h) world[y][x] = 0;
        else if (y === h) world[y][x] = 1;
        else if (y <= h + 4 + irnd(0,2)) world[y][x] = 2;
        else world[y][x] = 3;
      }
    }

    // Caves
    for (let i=0;i<180;i++){
      let x = irnd(5, WORLD_W-6);
      let y = irnd(Math.floor(WORLD_H*0.38), WORLD_H-8);
      let steps = irnd(35, 110);
      for (let s=0;s<steps;s++){
        for(let oy=-1; oy<=1; oy++){
          for(let ox=-1; ox<=1; ox++){
            const tx=x+ox, ty=y+oy;
            if (tx>1 && tx<WORLD_W-1 && ty>1 && ty<WORLD_H-1 && ty>surface[tx]+1) world[ty][tx]=0;
          }
        }
        x += irnd(-1,1);
        y += irnd(-1,1);
        x = clamp(x,2,WORLD_W-3);
        y = clamp(y,Math.floor(WORLD_H*0.30),WORLD_H-3);
      }
    }

    // Copper ore pockets
    for (let i=0;i<380;i++){
      const x = irnd(3,WORLD_W-4);
      const y = irnd(Math.floor(WORLD_H*0.42), WORLD_H-5);
      if (world[y][x]===3 && Math.random()<0.7) {
        const r = irnd(1,2);
        for(let oy=-r;oy<=r;oy++) for(let ox=-r;ox<=r;ox++){
          const tx=x+ox, ty=y+oy;
          if(tx>0&&tx<WORLD_W&&ty>0&&ty<WORLD_H&&world[ty][tx]===3&&Math.hypot(ox,oy)<=r+0.3){
            world[ty][tx]=6;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Trees
    for (let x=4;x<WORLD_W-4;x++){
      if (world[surface[x]][x]===1 && Math.random()<0.09){
        const th = irnd(4,7);
        for(let t=1;t<=th;t++){
          const ty = surface[x]-t;
          if (ty>2) world[ty][x]=4;
        }
        const topY = surface[x]-th;
        for(let oy=-2; oy<=2; oy++){
          for(let ox=-2; ox<=2; ox++){
            const tx=x+ox, ty=topY+oy;
            if(tx>0&&tx<WORLD_W&&ty>0&&ty<WORLD_H&&Math.hypot(ox,oy)<2.35){
              if(world[ty][tx]===0) world[ty][tx]=5;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  generateWorld();

  function isSolid(tx,ty){
    if (tx < 0 || tx >= WORLD_W || ty >= WORLD_H) return true;
    if (ty < 0) return false;
    return TILE_DEF[world[ty][tx]].solid;
  }

  function rectHitsSolid(x,y,w,h){
    const l = Math.floor(x / TILE), r = Math.floor((x+w-0.001)/TILE);
    const t = Math.floor(y / TILE), b = Math.floor((y+h-0.001)/TILE);
    for(let yy=t; yy<=b; yy++) for(let xx=l; xx<=r; xx++) if(isSolid(xx,yy)) return true;
    return false;
  }

  function tileAtPixel(px,py){
    return { tx: Math.floor(px/TILE), ty: Math.floor(py/TILE) };
  }

  function findGroundY(tx){
    tx = clamp(tx,0,WORLD_W-1);
    for(let y=0;y<WORLD_H-1;y++){
      if(!TILE_DEF[world[y][tx]].solid && TILE_DEF[world[y+1][tx]].solid) return y;
    }
    return surface[tx]-1;
  }

  const spawnX = Math.floor(WORLD_W * 0.5);
  const spawnY = surface[spawnX] - 3;

  const player = {
    x: spawnX*TILE, y: spawnY*TILE, w: 18, h: 34,
    vx: 0, vy: 0, dir: 1, onGround: false,

    hp: 100, maxHp: 100,
    mana: 50, maxMana: 50,
    level: 1, xp: 0, nextXp: 45,
    attack: 12,

    hurtCd: 0,
    meleeCd: 0,
    castCd: 0,
    swingTimer: 0,

    inventory: { 1: 5, 2: 45, 3: 0, 4: 18, 6: 0 },
    selected: 0
  };

  const cam = { x: 0, y: 0 };

  const keys = {};
  const mouse = { x:0, y:0, worldX:0, worldY:0, left:false, right:false };

  const enemies = [];
  const projectiles = [];
  const stars = Array.from({length: 120}, () => ({x: Math.random(), y: Math.random()*0.65, s: Math.random()*2+1}));

  let dayTime = 0.25; // 0..1
  let enemySpawnTimer = 0;
  let mineTarget = null;
  let mineProgress = 0;
  let placeCd = 0;

  function addItem(tileId, count=1){
    player.inventory[tileId] = (player.inventory[tileId]||0) + count;
  }

  function gainXP(v){
    player.xp += v;
    while(player.xp >= player.nextXp){
      player.xp -= player.nextXp;
      player.level++;
      player.nextXp = Math.floor(player.nextXp * 1.35 + 8);
      player.maxHp += 12;
      player.maxMana += 6;
      player.attack += 2;
      player.hp = player.maxHp;
      player.mana = player.maxMana;
    }
  }

  function hurtPlayer(dmg){
    if (player.hurtCd > 0) return;
    player.hp -= dmg;
    player.hurtCd = 0.65;
    player.vx += (Math.random()<0.5?-1:1) * 140;
    player.vy = -180;
    if (player.hp <= 0){
      player.hp = player.maxHp;
      player.mana = player.maxMana;
      player.x = spawnX*TILE;
      player.y = (surface[spawnX]-4)*TILE;
      player.vx = 0; player.vy = 0;
    }
  }

  function spawnSlime(xTile){
    xTile = clamp(xTile, 5, WORLD_W-6);
    const gy = findGroundY(xTile);
    const ex = xTile*TILE + 3;
    const ey = gy*TILE - 18;
    enemies.push({
      x: ex, y: ey, w: 22, h: 18,
      vx: 0, vy: 0, hp: 24 + player.level*5, maxHp: 24 + player.level*5,
      jumpCd: rnd(0.4,1.1), dir: Math.random()<0.5?-1:1
    });
  }

  function meleeAttack(){
    if(player.meleeCd>0) return;
    player.meleeCd = 0.34;
    player.swingTimer = 0.12;

    const range = 50;
    const cx = player.x + player.w/2 + player.dir*24;
    const cy = player.y + player.h/2;
    for(let i=enemies.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const e = enemies[i];
      const ex = e.x + e.w/2, ey = e.y + e.h/2;
      if(Math.hypot(ex-cx, ey-cy) < range){
        e.hp -= player.attack;
        e.vx += player.dir*170;
        e.vy = -170;
        if(e.hp<=0){
          gainXP(12 + (Math.random()*4|0));
          if(Math.random()<0.55) addItem(2,1);
          enemies.splice(i,1);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function castBolt(){
    if(player.castCd>0 || player.mana < 10) return;
    player.castCd = 0.25;
    player.mana -= 10;
    const speed = 420;
    const dx = mouse.worldX - (player.x+player.w/2);
    const dy = mouse.worldY - (player.y+player.h/2);
    const len = Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
    projectiles.push({
      x: player.x+player.w/2, y: player.y+player.h/2-6,
      vx: dx/len*speed, vy: dy/len*speed,
      life: 1.2, dmg: 14 + player.level*2
    });
  }

  function mineTile(tx,ty,dt){
    if(tx<0||tx>=WORLD_W||ty<0||ty>=WORLD_H) { mineTarget=null; mineProgress=0; return; }
    const id = world[ty][tx];
    if(id===0){ mineTarget=null; mineProgress=0; return; }

    const px = player.x + player.w/2, py = player.y + player.h/2;
    const cx = tx*TILE + TILE/2, cy = ty*TILE + TILE/2;
    if(Math.hypot(cx-px, cy-py) > TILE*6){
      mineTarget=null; mineProgress=0; return;
    }

    if(!mineTarget || mineTarget.tx!==tx || mineTarget.ty!==ty){
      mineTarget = {tx,ty};
      mineProgress = 0;
    }

    const hardness = TILE_DEF[id].hardness || 1;
    const minePower = 1.15 + player.level*0.14;
    mineProgress += dt * minePower / hardness;
    if(mineProgress >= 1){
      world[ty][tx] = 0;
      const drop = TILE_DEF[id].drop;
      if(drop) addItem(drop,1);
      if(id===6) gainXP(8);
      mineTarget = null;
      mineProgress = 0;
    }
  }

  function placeSelectedBlock(){
    if(placeCd>0) return;
    placeCd = 0.12;
    const id = HOTBAR[player.selected];
    if((player.inventory[id]||0)<=0) return;

    const {tx,ty} = tileAtPixel(mouse.worldX, mouse.worldY);
    if(tx<0||tx>=WORLD_W||ty<0||ty>=WORLD_H) return;
    if(world[ty][tx]!==0) return;

    const px = player.x + player.w/2, py = player.y + player.h/2;
    const cx = tx*TILE + TILE/2, cy = ty*TILE + TILE/2;
    if(Math.hypot(cx-px, cy-py) > TILE*6) return;

    const aroundSolid = isSolid(tx+1,ty)||isSolid(tx-1,ty)||isSolid(tx,ty+1)||isSolid(tx,ty-1);
    if(!aroundSolid) return;

    const rx=tx*TILE, ry=ty*TILE;
    const overlap = !(player.x+player.w<=rx || player.x>=rx+TILE || player.y+player.h<=ry || player.y>=ry+TILE);
    if(overlap) return;

    world[ty][tx] = id;
    player.inventory[id]--;
  }

  function moveBody(body, dt){
    body.vy += GRAVITY * dt;
    if(body.vy > MAX_FALL) body.vy = MAX_FALL;

    body.x += body.vx * dt;
    if(rectHitsSolid(body.x, body.y, body.w, body.h)){
      if(body.vx > 0){
        const tx = Math.floor((body.x + body.w)/TILE);
        body.x = tx*TILE - body.w - 0.01;
      }else if(body.vx < 0){
        const tx = Math.floor(body.x/TILE);
        body.x = (tx+1)*TILE + 0.01;
      }
      body.vx = 0;
    }

    body.y += body.vy * dt;
    if(rectHitsSolid(body.x, body.y, body.w, body.h)){
      if(body.vy > 0){
        const ty = Math.floor((body.y + body.h)/TILE);
        body.y = ty*TILE - body.h - 0.01;
        body.onGround = true;
      }else if(body.vy < 0){
        const ty = Math.floor(body.y/TILE);
        body.y = (ty+1)*TILE + 0.01;
      }
      body.vy = 0;
    } else {
      body.onGround = false;
    }
  }

  window.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
    keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
    if(e.key >= "1" && e.key <= "5") player.selected = +e.key - 1;
    if(e.key.toLowerCase()==="f") meleeAttack();
    if(e.key.toLowerCase()==="q") castBolt();
  });
  window.addEventListener("keyup", e => keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false);

  canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", e => {
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    mouse.x = e.clientX - r.left;
    mouse.y = e.clientY - r.top;
  });
  canvas.addEventListener("mousedown", e => {
    if(e.button===0) mouse.left = true;
    if(e.button===2){ mouse.right = true; placeSelectedBlock(); }
  });
  window.addEventListener("mouseup", e => {
    if(e.button===0){ mouse.left = false; mineTarget=null; mineProgress=0; }
    if(e.button===2) mouse.right = false;
  });
  canvas.addEventListener("contextmenu", e => e.preventDefault());
  canvas.addEventListener("wheel", e => {
    if(e.deltaY>0) player.selected = (player.selected+1)%HOTBAR.length;
    else player.selected = (player.selected-1+HOTBAR.length)%HOTBAR.length;
    e.preventDefault();
  }, {passive:false});

  function update(dt){
    dayTime = (dayTime + dt * 0.012) % 1;

    const accel = player.onGround ? 1900 : 1200;
    const maxSpeed = player.onGround ? 220 : 250;
    const left = keys["a"] || keys["arrowleft"];
    const right = keys["d"] || keys["arrowright"];
    if(left) { player.vx -= accel*dt; player.dir = -1; }
    if(right){ player.vx += accel*dt; player.dir = 1; }
    if(!left && !right){
      const drag = player.onGround ? 1900 : 450;
      if(player.vx>0) player.vx = Math.max(0, player.vx-drag*dt);
      else player.vx = Math.min(0, player.vx+drag*dt);
    }
    player.vx = clamp(player.vx, -maxSpeed, maxSpeed);

    if((keys["w"]||keys["arrowup"]||keys[" "]) && player.onGround){
      player.vy = -520;
      player.onGround = false;
    }

    moveBody(player, dt);

    player.hurtCd = Math.max(0, player.hurtCd-dt);
    player.meleeCd = Math.max(0, player.meleeCd-dt);
    player.castCd = Math.max(0, player.castCd-dt);
    player.swingTimer = Math.max(0, player.swingTimer-dt);
    placeCd = Math.max(0, placeCd-dt);

    player.mana = Math.min(player.maxMana, player.mana + dt*5.2);

    cam.x = clamp(player.x + player.w/2 - canvas.width/2, 0, WORLD_W*TILE - canvas.width);
    cam.y = clamp(player.y + player.h/2 - canvas.height/2, 0, WORLD_H*TILE - canvas.height);

    mouse.worldX = mouse.x + cam.x;
    mouse.worldY = mouse.y + cam.y;

    if(mouse.left){
      const t = tileAtPixel(mouse.worldX, mouse.worldY);
      mineTile(t.tx,t.ty,dt);
    }

    // Enemies
    enemySpawnTimer -= dt;
    const night = (Math.sin(dayTime*Math.PI*2 - Math.PI/2)+1)/2 < 0.35;
    if(enemySpawnTimer<=0 && enemies.length<18){
      enemySpawnTimer = rnd(1.2,2.8);
      const side = Math.random()<0.5?-1:1;
      const tx = Math.floor(player.x/TILE) + side*irnd(9,18);
      if(tx>3&&tx<WORLD_W-4 && (night || player.y/TILE > surface[clamp(tx,0,WORLD_W-1)]+5)) spawnSlime(tx);
    }

    for(let i=enemies.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const e = enemies[i];
      const px = player.x + player.w/2;
      const ex = e.x + e.w/2;
      const dir = px < ex ? -1 : 1;
      e.vx += dir * 340 * dt;
      e.vx = clamp(e.vx, -95, 95);

      e.jumpCd -= dt;
      if(e.onGround && e.jumpCd<=0 && Math.abs(px-ex)<240){
        e.vy = -320;
        e.jumpCd = rnd(0.8,1.6);
      }

      moveBody(e,dt);
      e.vx *= e.onGround ? 0.92 : 0.99;

      // touch damage
      if(!(player.x+player.w<e.x || player.x>e.x+e.w || player.y+player.h<e.y || player.y>e.y+e.h)){
        hurtPlayer(8);
      }

      // despawn far
      if(Math.abs(e.x-player.x) > canvas.width*2.6) enemies.splice(i,1);
    }

    // Projectiles
    for(let i=projectiles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const p = projectiles[i];
      p.life -= dt;
      p.x += p.vx*dt;
      p.y += p.vy*dt;

      const tx = Math.floor(p.x/TILE), ty = Math.floor(p.y/TILE);
      if(p.life<=0 || isSolid(tx,ty)){ projectiles.splice(i,1); continue; }

      let hit = false;
      for(let j=enemies.length-1;j>=0;j--){
        const e = enemies[j];
        if(p.x>e.x && p.x<e.x+e.w && p.y>e.y && p.y<e.y+e.h){
          e.hp -= p.dmg;
          e.vx += Math.sign(p.vx)*130;
          e.vy = -120;
          hit = true;
          if(e.hp<=0){
            gainXP(14);
            if(Math.random()<0.4) addItem(3,1);
            enemies.splice(j,1);
          }
          break;
        }
      }
      if(hit) projectiles.splice(i,1);
    }
  }

  function tileColor(id, x, y){
    const n = hash2(x,y);
    switch(id){
      case 1: return ["#7a4f2f","#66bb3a",n];
      case 2: return ["#7a4f2f",null,n];
      case 3: return ["#6d7177",null,n];
      case 4: return ["#8a5c2f",null,n];
      case 5: return ["#3fae42",null,n];
      case 6: return ["#6d7177","#c97b2f",n];
      default: return ["#000",null,0];
    }
  }

  function drawTile(id, tx, ty, sx, sy){
    if(id===0) return;
    const [base, accent, n] = tileColor(id, tx, ty);
    ctx.fillStyle = base;
    ctx.fillRect(sx,sy,TILE,TILE);

    if(id===1){
      ctx.fillStyle = "#5cb338";
      ctx.fillRect(sx,sy, TILE, 6);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#4da02f";
      for(let i=0;i<4;i++) ctx.fillRect(sx+(i*6),sy+5,3,1);
    } else if(id===2){
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.12)";
      for(let i=0;i<4;i++) ctx.fillRect(sx+((i*5+((n*9)|0))%TILE), sy+((i*6+((n*13)|0))%TILE), 2,2);
    } else if(id===3){
      ctx.fillStyle = "#838a93";
      for(let i=0;i<5;i++) ctx.fillRect(sx+((i*4+((n*7)|0))%TILE), sy+((i*5+((n*11)|0))%TILE), 2,2);
    } else if(id===4){
      ctx.fillStyle = "#6f451f";
      ctx.fillRect(sx+8,sy,2,TILE);
      ctx.fillRect(sx+14,sy,2,TILE);
    } else if(id===5){
      ctx.fillStyle = "#57c457";
      for(let i=0;i<6;i++) ctx.fillRect(sx+((i*4+((n*17)|0))%TILE), sy+((i*3+((n*7)|0))%TILE), 3,3);
    } else if(id===6){
      ctx.fillStyle = "#8a8f97";
      for(let i=0;i<4;i++) ctx.fillRect(sx+((i*5+3)%TILE), sy+((i*6+5)%TILE), 2,2);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#c77933";
      for(let i=0;i<5;i++) ctx.fillRect(sx+((i*3+((n*19)|0))%TILE), sy+((i*5+((n*23)|0))%TILE), 3,3);
    }
  }

  function drawBackground(){
    const t = (Math.sin(dayTime*Math.PI*2 - Math.PI/2)+1)/2; // 0 night, 1 day
    const skyTop = `rgb(${Math.floor(16+80*t)},${Math.floor(22+130*t)},${Math.floor(42+170*t)})`;
    const skyBot = `rgb(${Math.floor(20+50*t)},${Math.floor(35+120*t)},${Math.floor(62+150*t)})`;
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,canvas.height);
    g.addColorStop(0, skyTop);
    g.addColorStop(1, skyBot);
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);

    // stars
    if(t < 0.55){
      const a = (0.55-t)/0.55;
      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#dfe9ff";
      for(const s of stars){
        ctx.fillRect((s.x*canvas.width)|0, (s.y*canvas.height)|0, s.s, s.s);
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }

    // sun/moon
    const ang = dayTime*Math.PI*2;
    const sx = canvas.width*0.5 + Math.cos(ang-Math.PI/2)*canvas.width*0.42;
    const sy = canvas.height*0.78 + Math.sin(ang-Math.PI/2)*canvas.height*0.58;
    if(t>0.2){
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd56b";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx,sy,24,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#d8e2ff";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx,sy,19,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    }

    // parallax hills
    const p1 = -cam.x*0.12;
    const p2 = -cam.x*0.2;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(25,60,45,0.38)";
    for(let i=-1;i<8;i++) ctx.fillRect(((i*260+p1)% (canvas.width+260))-130, canvas.height-210, 250, 220);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(18,40,34,0.45)";
    for(let i=-1;i<10;i++) ctx.fillRect(((i*180+p2)% (canvas.width+180))-90, canvas.height-140, 170, 150);
  }

  function drawWorld(){
    const x0 = Math.floor(cam.x/TILE)-1, x1 = Math.ceil((cam.x+canvas.width)/TILE)+1;
    const y0 = Math.floor(cam.y/TILE)-1, y1 = Math.ceil((cam.y+canvas.height)/TILE)+1;

    for(let y=y0;y<=y1;y++){
      if(y<0||y>=WORLD_H) continue;
      for(let x=x0;x<=x1;x++){
        if(x<0||x>=WORLD_W) continue;
        const id = world[y][x];
        if(id!==0){
          drawTile(id,x,y, x*TILE-cam.x, y*TILE-cam.y);
        }
      }
    }

    // Mining highlight
    const mt = tileAtPixel(mouse.worldX, mouse.worldY);
    if(mt.tx>=0&&mt.tx<WORLD_W&&mt.ty>=0&&mt.ty<WORLD_H){
      const sx = mt.tx*TILE - cam.x, sy = mt.ty*TILE - cam.y;
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.35)";
      ctx.strokeRect(sx+0.5, sy+0.5, TILE-1, TILE-1);
    }
    if(mineTarget){
      const sx = mineTarget.tx*TILE-cam.x, sy = mineTarget.ty*TILE-cam.y;
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.18+0.3*Math.min(1,mineProgress)})`;
      ctx.fillRect(sx,sy,TILE,TILE);
    }
  }

  function drawEntities(){
    // projectiles
    for(const p of projectiles){
      ctx.fillStyle = "#75cbff";
      ctx.fillRect(p.x-cam.x-2, p.y-cam.y-2, 5,5);
    }

    // enemies
    for(const e of enemies){
      const sx = e.x-cam.x, sy = e.y-cam.y;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#56d167";
      ctx.fillRect(sx, sy+6, e.w, e.h-6);
      ctx.fillRect(sx+2, sy+2, e.w-4, 8);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#1d2b1f";
      ctx.fillRect(sx+6, sy+7, 3,2);
      ctx.fillRect(sx+e.w-9, sy+7, 3,2);

      // hp bar
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)";
      ctx.fillRect(sx, sy-7, e.w, 4);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ff6565";
      ctx.fillRect(sx, sy-7, e.w*(e.hp/e.maxHp), 4);
    }

    // player
    const px = player.x-cam.x, py = player.y-cam.y;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#e4c7a0";
    ctx.fillRect(px+5, py+2, 8, 8); // head
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2e6fcd";
    ctx.fillRect(px+3, py+10, 12, 12); // body
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2f2f3a";
    ctx.fillRect(px+4, py+22, 4, 12);
    ctx.fillRect(px+10, py+22, 4, 12);

    if(player.swingTimer>0){
      const cx = px + player.w/2 + player.dir*18, cy = py + 16;
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,236,148,0.9)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx,cy,20, player.dir<0?Math.PI*0.3:Math.PI*0.7, player.dir<0?Math.PI*1.45:Math.PI*0.55, player.dir<0);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    }
  }

  function drawLighting(){
    const t = (Math.sin(dayTime*Math.PI*2 - Math.PI/2)+1)/2;
    let dark = (1-t)*0.5;

    const ptx = Math.floor((player.x+player.w/2)/TILE);
    const pty = Math.floor((player.y+player.h/2)/TILE);
    const depth = Math.max(0, pty - surface[clamp(ptx,0,WORLD_W-1)] - 2);
    dark += clamp(depth/20,0,0.5);

    if(dark<=0.02) return;
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,${clamp(dark,0,0.82)})`;
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);

    const lx = player.x+player.w/2-cam.x, ly = player.y+player.h/2-cam.y;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "destination-out";
    const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(lx,ly,25,lx,ly,170);
    rg.addColorStop(0,"rgba(0,0,0,0.9)");
    rg.addColorStop(1,"rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = rg;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(lx,ly,170,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawUI(){
    const x=18,y=16;
    // bars
    ctx.fillStyle="#0008"; ctx.fillRect(x-4,y-4,216,68);
    ctx.fillStyle="#432"; ctx.fillRect(x,y,200,14);
    ctx.fillStyle="#e35b5b"; ctx.fillRect(x,y,200*(player.hp/player.maxHp),14);
    ctx.fillStyle="#223"; ctx.fillRect(x,y+20,200,12);
    ctx.fillStyle="#5aa2ff"; ctx.fillRect(x,y+20,200*(player.mana/player.maxMana),12);
    ctx.fillStyle="#262326"; ctx.fillRect(x,y+38,200,10);
    ctx.fillStyle="#71d67b"; ctx.fillRect(x,y+38,200*(player.xp/player.nextXp),10);
    ctx.fillStyle="#fff";
    ctx.font="14px monospace";
    ctx.fillText(`HP ${Math.ceil(player.hp)}/${player.maxHp}`, x+6, y+11);
    ctx.fillText(`MP ${Math.floor(player.mana)}/${player.maxMana}`, x+6, y+30);
    ctx.fillText(`LV ${player.level} XP ${player.xp}/${player.nextXp}`, x+6, y+47);

    // hotbar
    const bw = 52, bh = 52;
    const total = HOTBAR.length*bw + (HOTBAR.length-1)*6;
    const sx = (canvas.width-total)/2, sy = canvas.height-68;
    for(let i=0;i<HOTBAR.length;i++){
      const id = HOTBAR[i], bx=sx+i*(bw+6), by=sy;
      ctx.fillStyle = i===player.selected ? "#ffe08a" : "#222a";
      ctx.fillRect(bx-2,by-2,bw+4,bh+4);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#1a1d25";
      ctx.fillRect(bx,by,bw,bh);

      drawTile(id,0,0,bx+14,by+8);
      ctx.fillStyle="#fff";
      ctx.font="12px monospace";
      ctx.fillText(`${i+1}`, bx+4, by+13);
      ctx.fillText(`${player.inventory[id]||0}`, bx+4, by+47);
    }

    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(0,0,0,0.45)";
    ctx.fillRect(canvas.width-320, 12, 308, 70);
    ctx.fillStyle="#d7e3ff";
    ctx.font="13px monospace";
    ctx.fillText("A/D Move  SPACE Jump  F Sword", canvas.width-312, 32);
    ctx.fillText("Q Magic Bolt  Left Mine  Right Place", canvas.width-312, 50);
    ctx.fillText("1-5 / MouseWheel Select Block", canvas.width-312, 68);
  }

  let last = performance.now();
  function loop(now){
    const dt = Math.min(0.033, (now-last)/1000);
    last = now;

    update(dt);
    drawBackground();
    drawWorld();
    drawEntities();
    drawLighting();
    drawUI();

    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
</body>
