<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0" />
<title>Pixel Terra RPG</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; background: #0b0f1b; font-family: monospace; }
  canvas { display: block; image-rendering: pixelated; cursor: crosshair; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;

  function resize() {
    canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
  resize();

  const TILE = 24;
  const WORLD_W = 260;
  const WORLD_H = 100;
  const GRAVITY = 1650;
  const MAX_FALL = 850;

  const TILE_DEF = {
    0: { name: "Air", solid: false, hardness: 0, color: "#00000000", drop: 0 },
    1: { name: "Grass", solid: true, hardness: 0.9, drop: 2 },
    2: { name: "Dirt", solid: true, hardness: 0.9, drop: 2 },
    3: { name: "Stone", solid: true, hardness: 1.8, drop: 3 },
    4: { name: "Wood", solid: true, hardness: 1.2, drop: 4 },
    5: { name: "Leaf", solid: false, hardness: 0.45, drop: 0 },
    6: { name: "Copper", solid: true, hardness: 2.2, drop: 6 },
  };
  const HOTBAR = [2,3,4,1,6];

  const world = Array.from({length: WORLD_H}, () => new Uint8Array(WORLD_W));
  const surface = new Int16Array(WORLD_W);

  function clamp(v,a,b){ return v<a?a:v>b?b:v; }
  function rnd(a,b){ return Math.random()*(b-a)+a; }
  function irnd(a,b){ return (Math.random()*(b-a+1)|0)+a; }

  function hash2(x,y){
    let n = x * 374761393 + y * 668265263;
    n = (n ^ (n >> 13)) * 1274126177;
    n = n ^ (n >> 16);
    return (n >>> 0) / 4294967295;
  }

  function generateWorld() {
    let h = Math.floor(WORLD_H * 0.42);
    for (let x=0;x<WORLD_W;x++){
      h += irnd(-1,1);
      h = clamp(h, Math.floor(WORLD_H*0.30), Math.floor(WORLD_H*0.55));
      surface[x] = h;

      for (let y=0;y<WORLD_H;y++){
        if (y < h) world[y][x] = 0;
        else if (y === h) world[y][x] = 1;
        else if (y <= h + 4 + irnd(0,2)) world[y][x] = 2;
        else world[y][x] = 3;
      }
    }

    // Caves
    for (let i=0;i<180;i++){
      let x = irnd(5, WORLD_W-6);
      let y = irnd(Math.floor(WORLD_H*0.38), WORLD_H-8);
      let steps = irnd(35, 110);
      for (let s=0;s<steps;s++){
        for(let oy=-1; oy<=1; oy++){
          for(let ox=-1; ox<=1; ox++){
            const tx=x+ox, ty=y+oy;
            if (tx>1 && tx<WORLD_W-1 && ty>1 && ty<WORLD_H-1 && ty>surface[tx]+1) world[ty][tx]=0;
          }
        }
        x += irnd(-1,1);
        y += irnd(-1,1);
        x = clamp(x,2,WORLD_W-3);
        y = clamp(y,Math.floor(WORLD_H*0.30),WORLD_H-3);
      }
    }

    // Copper ore pockets
    for (let i=0;i<380;i++){
      const x = irnd(3,WORLD_W-4);
      const y = irnd(Math.floor(WORLD_H*0.42), WORLD_H-5);
      if (world[y][x]===3 && Math.random()<0.7) {
        const r = irnd(1,2);
        for(let oy=-r;oy<=r;oy++) for(let ox=-r;ox<=r;ox++){
          const tx=x+ox, ty=y+oy;
          if(tx>0&&tx<WORLD_W&&ty>0&&ty<WORLD_H&&world[ty][tx]===3&&Math.hypot(ox,oy)<=r+0.3){
            world[ty][tx]=6;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Trees
    for (let x=4;x<WORLD_W-4;x++){
      if (world[surface[x]][x]===1 && Math.random()<0.09){
        const th = irnd(4,7);
        for(let t=1;t<=th;t++){
          const ty = surface[x]-t;
          if (ty>2) world[ty][x]=4;
        }
        const topY = surface[x]-th;
        for(let oy=-2; oy<=2; oy++){
          for(let ox=-2; ox<=2; ox++){
            const tx=x+ox, ty=topY+oy;
            if(tx>0&&tx<WORLD_W&&ty>0&&ty<WORLD_H&&Math.hypot(ox,oy)<2.35){
              if(world[ty][tx]===0) world[ty][tx]=5;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  generateWorld();

  function isSolid(tx,ty){
    if (tx < 0 || tx >= WORLD_W || ty >= WORLD_H) return true;
    if (ty < 0) return false;
    return TILE_DEF[world[ty][tx]].solid;
  }

  function rectHitsSolid(x,y,w,h){
    const l = Math.floor(x / TILE), r = Math.floor((x+w-0.001)/TILE);
    const t = Math.floor(y / TILE), b = Math.floor((y+h-0.001)/TILE);
    for(let yy=t; yy<=b; yy++) for(let xx=l; xx<=r; xx++) if(isSolid(xx,yy)) return true;
    return false;
  }

  function tileAtPixel(px,py){
    return { tx: Math.floor(px/TILE), ty: Math.floor(py/TILE) };
  }

  function findGroundY(tx){
    tx = clamp(tx,0,WORLD_W-1);
    for(let y=0;y<WORLD_H-1;y++){
      if(!TILE_DEF[world[y][tx]].solid && TILE_DEF[world[y+1][tx]].solid) return y;
    }
    return surface[tx]-1;
  }

  const spawnX = Math.floor(WORLD_W * 0.5);
  const spawnY = surface[spawnX] - 3;

  const player = {
    x: spawnX*TILE, y: spawnY*TILE, w: 18, h: 34,
    vx: 0, vy: 0, dir: 1, onGround: false,

    hp: 100, maxHp: 100,
    mana: 50, maxMana: 50,
    level: 1, xp: 0, nextXp: 45,
    attack: 12,

    hurtCd: 0,
    meleeCd: 0,
    castCd: 0,
    swingTimer: 0,

    inventory: { 1: 5, 2: 45, 3: 0, 4: 18, 6: 0 },
    selected: 0
  };

  const cam = { x: 0, y: 0 };

  const keys = {};
  const mouse = { x:0, y:0, worldX:0, worldY:0, left:false, right:false };

  const enemies = [];
  const projectiles = [];
  const stars = Array.from({length: 120}, () => ({x: Math.random(), y: Math.random()*0.65, s: Math.random()*2+1}));

  let dayTime = 0.25; // 0..1
  let enemySpawnTimer = 0;
  let mineTarget = null;
  let mineProgress = 0;
  let placeCd = 0;

  function addItem(tileId, count=1){
    player.inventory[tileId] = (player.inventory[tileId]||0) + count;
  }

  function gainXP(v){
    player.xp += v;
    while(player.xp >= player.nextXp){
      player.xp -= player.nextXp;
      player.level++;
      player.nextXp = Math.floor(player.nextXp * 1.35 + 8);
      player.maxHp += 12;
      player.maxMana += 6;
      player.attack += 2;
      player.hp = player.maxHp;
      player.mana = player.maxMana;
    }
  }

  function hurtPlayer(dmg){
    if (player.hurtCd > 0) return;
    player.hp -= dmg;
    player.hurtCd = 0.65;
    player.vx += (Math.random()<0.5?-1:1) * 140;
    player.vy = -180;
    if (player.hp <= 0){
      player.hp = player.maxHp;
      player.mana = player.maxMana;
      player.x = spawnX*TILE;
      player.y = (surface[spawnX]-4)*TILE;
      player.vx = 0; player.vy = 0;
    }
  }

  function spawnSlime(xTile){
    xTile = clamp(xTile, 5, WORLD_W-6);
    const gy = findGroundY(xTile);
    const ex = xTile*TILE + 3;
    const ey = gy*TILE - 18;
    enemies.push({
      x: ex, y: ey, w: 22, h: 18,
      vx: 0, vy: 0, hp: 24 + player.level*5, maxHp: 24 + player.level*5,
      jumpCd: rnd(0.4,1.1), dir: Math.random()<0.5?-1:1
    });
  }

  function meleeAttack(){
    if(player.meleeCd>0) return;
    player.meleeCd = 0.34;
    player.swingTimer = 0.12;

    const range = 50;
    const cx = player.x + player.w/2 + player.dir*24;
    const cy = player.y + player.h/2;
    for(let i=enemies.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const e = enemies[i];
      const ex = e.x + e.w/2, ey = e.y + e.h/2;
      if(Math.hypot(ex-cx, ey-cy) < range){
        e.hp -= player.attack;
        e.vx += player.dir*170;
        e.vy = -170;
        if(e.hp<=0){
          gainXP(12 + (Math.random()*4|0));
          if(Math.random()<0.55) addItem(2,1);
          enemies.splice(i,1);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function castBolt(){
    if(player.castCd>0 || player.mana < 10) return;
    player.castCd = 0.25;
    player.mana -= 10;
    const speed = 420;
    const dx = mouse.worldX - (player.x+player.w/2);
    const dy = mouse.worldY - (player.y+player.h/2);
    const len = Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
    projectiles.push({
      x: player.x+player.w/2, y: player.y+player.h/2-6,
      vx: dx/len*speed, vy: dy/len*speed,
      life: 1.2, dmg: 14 + player.level*2
    });
  }

  function mineTile(tx,ty,dt){
    if(tx<0||tx>=WORLD_W||ty<0||ty>=WORLD_H) { mineTarget=null; mineProgress=0; return; }
    const id = world[ty][tx];
    if(id===0){ mineTarget=null; mineProgress=0; return; }

    const px = player.x + player.w/2, py = player.y + player.h/2;
    const cx = tx*TILE + TILE/2, cy = ty*TILE + TILE/2;
    if(Math.hypot(cx-px, cy-py) > TILE*6){
      mineTarget=null; mineProgress=0; return;
    }

    if(!mineTarget || mineTarget.tx!==tx || mineTarget.ty!==ty){
      mineTarget = {tx,ty};
      mineProgress = 0;
    }

    const hardness = TILE_DEF[id].hardness || 1;
    const minePower = 1.15 + player.level*0.14;
    mineProgress += dt * minePower / hardness;
    if(mineProgress >= 1){
      world[ty][tx] = 0;
      const drop = TILE_DEF[id].drop;
      if(drop) addItem(drop,1);
      if(id===6) gainXP(8);
      mineTarget = null;
      mineProgress = 0;
    }
  }

  function placeSelectedBlock(){
    if(placeCd>0) return;
    placeCd = 0.12;
    const id = HOTBAR[player.selected];
    if((player.inventory[id]||0)<=0) return;

    const {tx,ty} = tileAtPixel(mouse.worldX, mouse.worldY);
    if(tx<0||tx>=WORLD_W||ty<0||ty>=WORLD_H) return;
    if(world[ty][tx]!==0) return;

    const px = player.x + player.w/2, py = player.y + player.h/2;
    const cx = tx*TILE + TILE/2, cy = ty*TILE + TILE/2;
    if(Math.hypot(cx-px, cy-py) > TILE*6) return;

    const aroundSolid = isSolid(tx+1,ty)||isSolid(tx-1,ty)||isSolid(tx,ty+1)||isSolid(tx,ty-1);
    if(!aroundSolid) return;

    const rx=tx*TILE, ry=ty*TILE;
    const overlap = !(player.x+player.w<=rx || player.x>=rx+TILE || player.y+player.h<=ry || player.y>=ry+TILE);
    if(overlap) return;

    world[ty][tx] = id;
    player.inventory[id]--;
  }

  function moveBody(body, dt){
    body.vy += GRAVITY * dt;
    if(body.vy > MAX_FALL) body.vy = MAX_FALL;

    body.x += body.vx * dt;
    if(rectHitsSolid(body.x, body.y, body.w, body.h)){
      if(body.vx > 0){
        const tx = Math.floor((body.x + body.w)/TILE);
        body.x = tx*TILE - body.w - 0.01;
      }else if(body.vx < 0){
        const tx = Math.floor(body.x/TILE);
        body.x = (tx+1)*TILE + 0.01;
      }
      body.vx = 0;
    }

    body.y += body.vy * dt;
    if(rectHitsSolid(body.x, body.y, body.w, body.h)){
      if(body.vy > 0){
        const ty = Math.floor((body.y + body.h)/TILE);
        body.y = ty*TILE - body.h - 0.01;
        body.onGround = true;
      }else if(body.vy < 0){
        const ty = Math.floor(body.y/TILE);
        body.y = (ty+1)*TILE + 0.01;
      }
      body.vy = 0;
    } else {
      body.onGround = false;
    }
  }

  window.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
    keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
    if(e.key >= "1" && e.key <= "5") player.selected = +e.key - 1;
    if(e.key.toLowerCase()==="f") meleeAttack();
    if(e.key.toLowerCase()==="q") castBolt();
  });
  window.addEventListener("keyup", e => keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false);

  canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", e => {
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    mouse.x = e.clientX - r.left;
    mouse.y = e.clientY - r.top;
  });
  canvas.addEventListener("mousedown", e => {
    if(e.button===0) mouse.left = true;
    if(e.button===2){ mouse.right = true; placeSelectedBlock(); }
  });
  window.addEventListener("mouseup", e => {
    if(e.button===0){ mouse.left = false; mineTarget=null; mineProgress=0; }
    if(e.button===2) mouse.right = false;
  });
  canvas.addEventListener("contextmenu", e => e.preventDefault());
  canvas.addEventListener("wheel", e => {
    if(e.deltaY>0) player.selected = (player.selected+1)%HOTBAR.length;
    else player.selected = (player.selected-1+HOTBAR.length)%HOTBAR.length;
    e.preventDefault();
  }, {passive:false});

  function update(dt){
    dayTime = (dayTime + dt * 0.012) % 1;

    const accel = player.onGround ? 1900 : 1200;
    const maxSpeed = player.onGround ? 220 : 250;
    const left = keys["a"] || keys["arrowleft"];
    const right = keys["d"] || keys["arrowright"];
    if(left) { player.vx -= accel*dt; player.dir = -1; }
    if(right){ player.vx += accel*dt; player.dir = 1; }
    if(!left && !right){
      const drag = player.onGround ? 1900 : 450;
      if(player.vx>0) player.vx = Math.max(0, player.vx-drag*dt);
      else player.vx = Math.min(0, player.vx+drag*dt);
    }
    player.vx = clamp(player.vx, -maxSpeed, maxSpeed);

    if((keys["w"]||keys["arrowup"]||keys[" "]) && player.onGround){
      player.vy = -520;
      player.onGround = false;
    }

    moveBody(player, dt);

    player.hurtCd = Math.max(0, player.hurtCd-dt);
    player.meleeCd = Math.max(0, player.meleeCd-dt);
    player.castCd = Math.max(0, player.castCd-dt);
    player.swingTimer = Math.max(0, player.swingTimer-dt);
    placeCd = Math.max(0, placeCd-dt);

    player.mana = Math.min(player.maxMana, player.mana + dt*5.2);

    cam.x = clamp(player.x + player.w/2 - canvas.width/2, 0, WORLD_W*TILE - canvas.width);
    cam.y = clamp(player.y + player.h/2 - canvas.height/2, 0, WORLD_H*TILE - canvas.height);

    mouse.worldX = mouse.x + cam.x;
    mouse.worldY = mouse.y + cam.y;

    if(mouse.left){
      const t = tileAtPixel(mouse.worldX, mouse.worldY);
      mineTile(t.tx,t.ty,dt);
    }

    // Enemies
    enemySpawnTimer -= dt;
    const night = (Math.sin(dayTime*Math.PI*2 - Math.PI/2)+1)/2 < 0.35;
    if(enemySpawnTimer<=0 && enemies.length<18){
      enemySpawnTimer = rnd(1.2,2.8);
      const side = Math.random()<0.5?-1:1;
      const tx = Math.floor(player.x/TILE) + side*irnd(9,18);
      if(tx>3&&tx<WORLD_W-4 && (night || player.y/TILE > surface[clamp(tx,0,WORLD_W-1)]+5)) spawnSlime(tx);
    }

    for(let i=enemies.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const e = enemies[i];
      const px = player.x + player.w/2;
      const ex = e.x + e.w/2;
      const dir = px < ex ? -1 : 1;
      e.vx += dir * 340 * dt;
      e.vx = clamp(e.vx, -95, 95);

      e.jumpCd -= dt;
      if(e.onGround && e.jumpCd<=0 && Math.abs(px-ex)<240){
        e.vy = -320;
        e.jumpCd = rnd(0.8,1.6);
      }

      moveBody(e,dt);
      e.vx *= e.onGround ? 0.92 : 0.99;

      // touch damage
      if(!(player.x+player.w<e.x || player.x>e.x+e.w || player.y+player.h<e.y || player.y>e.y+e.h)){
        hurtPlayer(8);
      }

      // despawn far
      if(Math.abs(e.x-player.x) > canvas.width*2.6) enemies.splice(i,1);
    }

    // Projectiles
    for(let i=projectiles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const p = projectiles[i];
      p.life -= dt;
      p.x += p.vx*dt;
      p.y += p.vy*dt;

      const tx = Math.floor(p.x/TILE), ty = Math.floor(p.y/TILE);
      if(p.life<=0 || isSolid(tx,ty)){ projectiles.splice(i,1); continue; }

      let hit = false;
      for(let j=enemies.length-1;j>=0;j--){
        const e = enemies[j];
        if(p.x>e.x && p.x<e.x+e.w && p.y>e.y && p.y<e.y+e.h){
          e.hp -= p.dmg;
          e.vx += Math.sign(p.vx)*130;
          e.vy = -120;
          hit = true;
          if(e.hp<=0){
            gainXP(14);
            if(Math.random()<0.4) addItem(3,1);
            enemies.splice(j,1);
          }
          break;
        }
      }
      if(hit) projectiles.splice(i,1);
    }
  }

  function tileColor(id, x, y){
    const n = hash2(x,y);
    switch(id){
      case 1: return ["#7a4f2f","#66bb3a",n];
      case 2: return ["#7a4f2f",null,n];
      case 3: return ["#6d7177",null,n];
      case 4: return ["#8a5c2f",null,n];
      case 5: return ["#3fae42",null,n];
      case 6: return ["#6d7177","#c97b2f",n];
      default: return ["#000",null,0];
    }
  }

  function drawTile(id, tx, ty, sx, sy){
    if(id===0) return;
    const [base, accent, n] = tileColor(id, tx, ty);
    ctx.fillStyle = base;
    ctx.fillRect(sx,sy,TILE,TILE);

    if(id===1){
      ctx.fillStyle = "#5cb338";
      ctx.fillRect(sx,sy, TILE, 6);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#4da02f";
      for(let i=0;i<4;i++) ctx.fillRect(sx+(i*6),sy+5,3,1);
    } else if(id===2){
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.12)";
      for(let i=0;i<4;i++) ctx.fillRect(sx+((i*5+((n*9)|0))%TILE), sy+((i*6+((n*13)|0))%TILE), 2,2);
    } else if(id===3){
      ctx.fillStyle = "#838a93";
      for(let i=0;i<5;i++) ctx.fillRect(sx+((i*4+((n*7)|0))%TILE), sy+((i*5+((n*11)|0))%TILE), 2,2);
    } else if(id===4){
      ctx.fillStyle = "#6f451f";
      ctx.fillRect(sx+8,sy,2,TILE);
      ctx.fillRect(sx+14,sy,2,TILE);
    } else if(id===5){
      ctx.fillStyle = "#57c457";
      for(let i=0;i<6;i++) ctx.fillRect(sx+((i*4+((n*17)|0))%TILE), sy+((i*3+((n*7)|0))%TILE), 3,3);
    } else if(id===6){
      ctx.fillStyle = "#8a8f97";
      for(let i=0;i<4;i++) ctx.fillRect(sx+((i*5+3)%TILE), sy+((i*6+5)%TILE), 2,2);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#c77933";
      for(let i=0;i<5;i++) ctx.fillRect(sx+((i*3+((n*19)|0))%TILE), sy+((i*5+((n*23)|0))%TILE), 3,3);
    }
  }

  function drawBackground(){
    const t = (Math.sin(dayTime*Math.PI*2 - Math.PI/2)+1)/2; // 0 night, 1 day
    const skyTop = `rgb(${Math.floor(16+80*t)},${Math.floor(22+130*t)},${Math.floor(42+170*t)})`;
    const skyBot = `rgb(${Math.floor(20+50*t)},${Math.floor(35+120*t)},${Math.floor(62+150*t)})`;
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,canvas.height);
    g.addColorStop(0, skyTop);
    g.addColorStop(1, skyBot);
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);

    // stars
    if(t < 0.55){
      const a = (0.55-t)/0.55;
      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#dfe9ff";
      for(const s of stars){
        ctx.fillRect((s.x*canvas.width)|0, (s.y*canvas.height)|0, s.s, s.s);
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }

    // sun/moon
    const ang = dayTime*Math.PI*2;
    const sx = canvas.width*0.5 + Math.cos(ang-Math.PI/2)*canvas.width*0.42;
    const sy = canvas.height*0.78 + Math.sin(ang-Math.PI/2)*canvas.height*0.58;
    if(t>0.2){
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd56b";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx,sy,24,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#d8e2ff";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx,sy,19,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    }

    // parallax hills
    const p1 = -cam.x*0.12;
    const p2 = -cam.x*0.2;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(25,60,45,0.38)";
    for(let i=-1;i<8;i++) ctx.fillRect(((i*260+p1)% (canvas.width+260))-130, canvas.height-210, 250, 220);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(18,40,34,0.45)";
    for(let i=-1;i<10;i++) ctx.fillRect(((i*180+p2)% (canvas.width+180))-90, canvas.height-140, 170, 150);
  }

  function drawWorld(){
    const x0 = Math.floor(cam.x/TILE)-1, x1 = Math.ceil((cam.x+canvas.width)/TILE)+1;
    const y0 = Math.floor(cam.y/TILE)-1, y1 = Math.ceil((cam.y+canvas.height)/TILE)+1;

    for(let y=y0;y<=y1;y++){
      if(y<0||y>=WORLD_H) continue;
      for(let x=x0;x<=x1;x++){
        if(x<0||x>=WORLD_W) continue;
        const id = world[y][x];
        if(id!==0){
          drawTile(id,x,y, x*TILE-cam.x, y*TILE-cam.y);
        }
      }
    }

    // Mining highlight
    const mt = tileAtPixel(mouse.worldX, mouse.worldY);
    if(mt.tx>=0&&mt.tx<WORLD_W&&mt.ty>=0&&mt.ty<WORLD_H){
      const sx = mt.tx*TILE - cam.x, sy = mt.ty*TILE - cam.y;
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.35)";
      ctx.strokeRect(sx+0.5, sy+0.5, TILE-1, TILE-1);
    }
    if(mineTarget){
      const sx = mineTarget.tx*TILE-cam.x, sy = mineTarget.ty*TILE-cam.y;
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.18+0.3*Math.min(1,mineProgress)})`;
      ctx.fillRect(sx,sy,TILE,TILE);
    }
  }

  function drawEntities(){
    // projectiles
    for(const p of projectiles){
      ctx.fillStyle = "#75cbff";
      ctx.fillRect(p.x-cam.x-2, p.y-cam.y-2, 5,5);
    }

    // enemies
    for(const e of enemies){
      const sx = e.x-cam.x, sy = e.y-cam.y;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#56d167";
      ctx.fillRect(sx, sy+6, e.w, e.h-6);
      ctx.fillRect(sx+2, sy+2, e.w-4, 8);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#1d2b1f";
      ctx.fillRect(sx+6, sy+7, 3,2);
      ctx.fillRect(sx+e.w-9, sy+7, 3,2);

      // hp bar
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)";
      ctx.fillRect(sx, sy-7, e.w, 4);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ff6565";
      ctx.fillRect(sx, sy-7, e.w*(e.hp/e.maxHp), 4);
    }

    // player
    const px = player.x-cam.x, py = player.y-cam.y;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#e4c7a0";
    ctx.fillRect(px+5, py+2, 8, 8); // head
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2e6fcd";
    ctx.fillRect(px+3, py+10, 12, 12); // body
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2f2f3a";
    ctx.fillRect(px+4, py+22, 4, 12);
    ctx.fillRect(px+10, py+22, 4, 12);

    if(player.swingTimer>0){
      const cx = px + player.w/2 + player.dir*18, cy = py + 16;
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,236,148,0.9)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx,cy,20, player.dir<0?Math.PI*0.3:Math.PI*0.7, player.dir<0?Math.PI*1.45:Math.PI*0.55, player.dir<0);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    }
  }

  function drawLighting(){
    const t = (Math.sin(dayTime*Math.PI*2 - Math.PI/2)+1)/2;
    let dark = (1-t)*0.5;

    const ptx = Math.floor((player.x+player.w/2)/TILE);
    const pty = Math.floor((player.y+player.h/2)/TILE);
    const depth = Math.max(0, pty - surface[clamp(ptx,0,WORLD_W-1)] - 2);
    dark += clamp(depth/20,0,0.5);

    if(dark<=0.02) return;
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,${clamp(dark,0,0.82)})`;
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);

    const lx = player.x+player.w/2-cam.x, ly = player.y+player.h/2-cam.y;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "destination-out";
    const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(lx,ly,25,lx,ly,170);
    rg.addColorStop(0,"rgba(0,0,0,0.9)");
    rg.addColorStop(1,"rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = rg;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(lx,ly,170,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawUI(){
    const x=18,y=16;
    // bars
    ctx.fillStyle="#0008"; ctx.fillRect(x-4,y-4,216,68);
    ctx.fillStyle="#432"; ctx.fillRect(x,y,200,14);
    ctx.fillStyle="#e35b5b"; ctx.fillRect(x,y,200*(player.hp/player.maxHp),14);
    ctx.fillStyle="#223"; ctx.fillRect(x,y+20,200,12);
    ctx.fillStyle="#5aa2ff"; ctx.fillRect(x,y+20,200*(player.mana/player.maxMana),12);
    ctx.fillStyle="#262326"; ctx.fillRect(x,y+38,200,10);
    ctx.fillStyle="#71d67b"; ctx.fillRect(x,y+38,200*(player.xp/player.nextXp),10);
    ctx.fillStyle="#fff";
    ctx.font="14px monospace";
    ctx.fillText(`HP ${Math.ceil(player.hp)}/${player.maxHp}`, x+6, y+11);
    ctx.fillText(`MP ${Math.floor(player.mana)}/${player.maxMana}`, x+6, y+30);
    ctx.fillText(`LV ${player.level} XP ${player.xp}/${player.nextXp}`, x+6, y+47);

    // hotbar
    const bw = 52, bh = 52;
    const total = HOTBAR.length*bw + (HOTBAR.length-1)*6;
    const sx = (canvas.width-total)/2, sy = canvas.height-68;
    for(let i=0;i<HOTBAR.length;i++){
      const id = HOTBAR[i], bx=sx+i*(bw+6), by=sy;
      ctx.fillStyle = i===player.selected ? "#ffe08a" : "#222a";
      ctx.fillRect(bx-2,by-2,bw+4,bh+4);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#1a1d25";
      ctx.fillRect(bx,by,bw,bh);

      drawTile(id,0,0,bx+14,by+8);
      ctx.fillStyle="#fff";
      ctx.font="12px monospace";
      ctx.fillText(`${i+1}`, bx+4, by+13);
      ctx.fillText(`${player.inventory[id]||0}`, bx+4, by+47);
    }

    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(0,0,0,0.45)";
    ctx.fillRect(canvas.width-320, 12, 308, 70);
    ctx.fillStyle="#d7e3ff";
    ctx.font="13px monospace";
    ctx.fillText("A/D Move  SPACE Jump  F Sword", canvas.width-312, 32);
    ctx.fillText("Q Magic Bolt  Left Mine  Right Place", canvas.width-312, 50);
    ctx.fillText("1-5 / MouseWheel Select Block", canvas.width-312, 68);
  }

  let last = performance.now();
  function loop(now){
    const dt = Math.min(0.033, (now-last)/1000);
    last = now;

    update(dt);
    drawBackground();
    drawWorld();
    drawEntities();
    drawLighting();
    drawUI();

    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>

// Smoke particles
class ParticleSystem {
  constructor(max, size, color, opacity){
    this.max = max;
    this.positions = new Float32Array(max*3);
    this.sizes = new Float32Array(max);
    this.alphas = new Float32Array(max);
    this.vel = new Array(max).fill(0).map(()=>new THREE.Vector3());
    this.life = new Float32Array(max);
    this.active = new Uint8Array(max);
    this.ptr = 0;

    const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    geo.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(this.positions,3));
    geo.setAttribute("aSize", new THREE.BufferAttribute(this.sizes,1));
    geo.setAttribute("aAlpha", new THREE.BufferAttribute(this.alphas,1));
    const mat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
      transparent:true, depthWrite:false, blending:THREE.NormalBlending,
      uniforms:{ uColor:{value:new THREE.Color(color)}, uOpacity:{value:opacity} },
      vertexShader: `
        attribute float aSize;
        attribute float aAlpha;
        varying float vA;
        void main(){
          vA = aAlpha;
          vec4 mv = modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0);
          gl_PointSize = aSize * (300.0 / -mv.z);
          gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mv;
        }
      `,
      fragmentShader: `
        uniform vec3 uColor;
        uniform float uOpacity;
        varying float vA;
        void main(){
          vec2 uv = gl_PointCoord - 0.5;
          float d = dot(uv,uv);
          float a = smoothstep(0.25,0.0,d) * vA * uOpacity;
          gl_FragColor = vec4(uColor,a);
        }
      `
    });
    this.points = new THREE.Points(geo, mat);
    this.geo = geo;
  }
  emit(p, v, life, size, alpha){
    const i = this.ptr++ % this.max;
    this.positions[i*3]=p.x; this.positions[i*3+1]=p.y; this.positions[i*3+2]=p.z;
    this.vel[i].copy(v);
    this.life[i]=life;
    this.sizes[i]=size;
    this.alphas[i]=alpha;
    this.active[i]=1;
  }
  update(dt, gravity=0){
    for(let i=0;i<this.max;i++){
      if(!this.active[i]) continue;
      this.life[i]-=dt;
      if(this.life[i]<=0){ this.active[i]=0; this.alphas[i]=0; continue; }
      this.vel[i].y += gravity*dt;
      this.positions[i*3] += this.vel[i].x*dt;
      this.positions[i*3+1] += this.vel[i].y*dt;
      this.positions[i*3+2] += this.vel[i].z*dt;
      this.sizes[i] *= (1 + dt*0.28);
      this.alphas[i] *= Math.exp(-dt*1.15);
    }
    this.geo.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
    this.geo.attributes.aSize.needsUpdate = true;
    this.geo.attributes.aAlpha.needsUpdate = true;
  }
}

// Physics

// Audio
let audioCtx = null;

function initAudio(){
  if(audioCtx) return;
  audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
  master = audioCtx.createGain();
  master.gain.value = 0.7;
  master.connect(audioCtx.destination);

  const noiseBuf = audioCtx.createBuffer(1, audioCtx.sampleRate*4, audioCtx.sampleRate);
  const d = noiseBuf.getChannelData(0);
  let last = 0;
  for(let i=0;i<d.length;i++){
    const white = Math.random()*2-1;
    last = (last + 0.02*white)/1.02;
    d[i] = last*3.5;
  }

  function noiseNode(){
    const n = audioCtx.createBufferSource();
    n.buffer = noiseBuf;
    n.loop = true;
    return n;
  }

  // Rumble
  rumbleGain = audioCtx.createGain();
  rumbleGain.gain.value = 0;
  const rumbleLP = audioCtx.createBiquadFilter();
  rumbleLP.type = "lowpass";
  rumbleLP.frequency.value = 90;
  const n1 = noiseNode();
  n1.connect(rumbleLP).connect(rumbleGain).connect(master);
  n1.start();

  // Roar
  roarGain = audioCtx.createGain();
  roarGain.gain.value = 0;
  const roarBP = audioCtx.createBiquadFilter();
  roarBP.type = "bandpass";
  roarBP.frequency.value = 220;
  roarBP.Q.value = 0.7;
  const n2 = noiseNode();
  n2.connect(roarBP).connect(roarGain).connect(master);
  n2.start();
  const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
  osc.type = "sawtooth";
  const oscGain = audioCtx.createGain();
  oscGain.gain.value = 0.02;
  osc.connect(oscGain).connect(roarGain);
  osc.start();

  // Wind
  windGain = audioCtx.createGain();
  windGain.gain.value = 0;
  const windHP = audioCtx.createBiquadFilter();
  windHP.type = "highpass";
  windHP.frequency.value = 500;
  const n3 = noiseNode();
  n3.connect(windHP).connect(windGain).connect(master);
  n3.start();

  // Mechanical door
  mechGain = audioCtx.createGain();
  mechGain.gain.value = 0;
  mechGain.connect(master);
  const mechOsc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
  mechOsc.type = "square";
  mechOsc.frequency.value = 36;
  mechOsc.connect(mechGain);
  mechOsc.start();

  // store refs
  initAudio.osc = osc;
  initAudio.roarBP = roarBP;
  initAudio.windHP = windHP;
}
window.addEventListener("pointerdown", ()=>{ initAudio(); if(audioCtx && audioCtx.state!=="running") audioCtx.resume(); }, { once:false });
setTimeout(()=>{ try{ initAudio(); if(audioCtx.state!=="running") audioCtx.resume(); }catch(e){} }, 200);

// Camera shot director
function setShot(t, missileWorldPos, dir, speed){
  if(t < 5){
    // low-angle side close up
    targetCamPos.copy(missileWorldPos).add(new THREE.Vector3(18, 6, 28));
    targetLook.copy(missileWorldPos).add(new THREE.Vector3(0, 7, 0));
  } else if(t < 10){
    // chase behind below
    targetCamPos.copy(missileWorldPos).addScaledVector(dir, -22).add(new THREE.Vector3(0,-7,0));
    targetLook.copy(missileWorldPos).addScaledVector(dir, 35);
  } else if(t < 14){
    // FPV
    targetCamPos.copy(missileWorldPos).addScaledVector(dir, 1.6).add(new THREE.Vector3(0,0.12,0));
    targetLook.copy(missileWorldPos).addScaledVector(dir, 1600).add(new THREE.Vector3(0,20,0));
  } else if(t < 19){
    // side profile tracking
    const side = new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(dir, up).normalize();
    targetCamPos.copy(missileWorldPos).addScaledVector(side, 38).add(new THREE.Vector3(0,10,0));
    targetLook.copy(missileWorldPos).addScaledVector(dir, 120);
  } else if(t < 24){
    // top-down wide
    targetCamPos.copy(missileWorldPos).add(new THREE.Vector3(0, 900 + speed*0.15, 380));
    targetLook.copy(missileWorldPos).add(new THREE.Vector3(0,-250,0));
  } else {
    // orbiting
    const a = (t-24)*0.65;
    const r = 42 + Math.sin(t*0.5)*8;
    targetCamPos.copy(missileWorldPos).add(new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(a)*r, 14+Math.sin(a*1.5)*8, Math.sin(a)*r));
    targetLook.copy(missileWorldPos).addScaledVector(dir, 120);
  }

  // camera shake at ignition
  if(t > 2.8 && t < 5.5){
    const s = (5.5-t)/2.7;
    targetCamPos.x += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.65*s;
    targetCamPos.y += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.35*s;
    targetCamPos.z += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.65*s;
  }

  camera.position.lerp(targetCamPos, 0.09);
  const m = new THREE.Matrix4().lookAt(camera.position, targetLook, up);
  camQuat.setFromRotationMatrix(m);
  camera.quaternion.slerp(camQuat, 0.1);
}

// Timing
let prev = performance.now();
function animate(now){
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  const dt = Math.min(0.033, (now - prev) / 1000);
  prev = now;
  const t = (now - state.start) / 1000;
  state.t = t;

  // Door animation (0-3s)
  const doorP = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(t/3,0,1);
  const ease = doorP<1 ? 1-Math.pow(1-doorP,2.4) : 1;
  doorL.position.x = -11 - ease*12;
  doorR.position.x = 11 + ease*12;

  // Launch
  const launchT = t - 3.0;
  let throttle = 0;
  if(launchT > 0){
    state.launched = true;
    throttle = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(launchT/1.1, 0, 1);

    const alt = state.missilePos.y;
    const rho = Math.exp(-Math.max(0,alt)/8500);
    const pitch = THREE.MathUtils.clamp((launchT-10)/15, 0, 1) * 0.12;
    state.dir.set(Math.sin(pitch), Math.cos(pitch), Math.sin(launchT*0.22)*0.03).normalize();

    const thrustAccel = (360*Math.exp(-launchT/26)+110) * throttle;
    state.acc.copy(state.dir).multiplyScalar(thrustAccel);
    state.acc.y -= 9.81;

    const vMag = state.vel.length();
    const drag = state.vel.clone().multiplyScalar(-0.000012 * rho * vMag);
    state.acc.add(drag);

    state.vel.addScaledVector(state.acc, dt);
    state.missilePos.addScaledVector(state.vel, dt);

    const worldToBunker = bunkerRoot.worldToLocal(state.missilePos.clone());
    missile.position.copy(worldToBunker);

    tmpV.copy(state.vel).normalize();
    if(tmpV.lengthSq() > 0.1){
      const q = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(up, tmpV);
      missile.quaternion.slerp(q, 0.2);
    }

    // Fin vibration
    for(let i=0;i<fins.length;i++){
      fins[i].rotation.y = Math.sin(t*55 + i*1.9) * 0.03 * throttle;
      fins[i].rotation.x = Math.cos(t*47 + i*1.2) * 0.018 * throttle;
    }

    // Exhaust and smoke
    const worldPos = missile.getWorldPosition(new THREE.Vector3());
    const down = tmpV.lengthSq()>0.01 ? tmpV.clone().multiplyScalar(-1) : new THREE.Vector3(0,-1,0);
    for(let i=0;i<10;i++){
      const jitter = new THREE.Vector3((Math.random()-0.5)*1.2, (Math.random()-0.5)*0.8, (Math.random()-0.5)*1.2);
      const p = worldPos.clone().add(down.clone().multiplyScalar(1.8)).add(jitter);
      const v = down.clone().multiplyScalar(70 + Math.random()*35).add(new THREE.Vector3((Math.random()-0.5)*9, Math.random()*8, (Math.random()-0.5)*9));
      smoke.emit(p, v, 2.2 + Math.random()*2.1, 90 + Math.random()*110, 0.95);
    }
    if(launchT < 4){
      for(let i=0;i<28;i++){
        const a = Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
        const r = Math.random()*18;
        const gp = new THREE.Vector3(-320 + Math.cos(a)*r, terrainHeight(-320 + Math.cos(a)*r,70 + Math.sin(a)*r)+1, 70 + Math.sin(a)*r);
        const vv = new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(a)*(12+Math.random()*25), 8+Math.random()*22, Math.sin(a)*(12+Math.random()*25));
        dust.emit(gp, vv, 2.5 + Math.random()*2.6, 120 + Math.random()*120, 0.75);
      }
    }

    pushTrail(worldPos);

    // Flame intensity
    flame.visible = true;
    const dyn = throttle * (0.75 + Math.sin(t*45)*0.1 + Math.random()*0.08);
    flame.scale.set(1.0 + dyn*0.55, 1.6 + dyn*2.6, 1.0 + dyn*0.55);
    flameMat.uniforms.power.value = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(dyn,0,1.4);
    flameMat.uniforms.t.value = t;
    exhaustLight.intensity = 20 * dyn;
    exhaustLight.distance = 180 + dyn*80;

    // Hypersonic heating
    const speed = state.vel.length();
    const heat = THREE.MathUtils.clamp((speed-1200)/2800,0,1) * Math.exp(-Math.max(0,alt-42000)/18000);
    nose.material.emissiveIntensity = heat*3.2;
    plasma.material.opacity = heat*0.75;
    plasma.scale.setScalar(1 + heat*1.6);
  } else {
    flame.visible = false;
    exhaustLight.intensity = 0;
  }

  smoke.update(dt, 1.8);
  dust.update(dt, -2.0);

  const worldMissile = missile.getWorldPosition(new THREE.Vector3());
  const speed = state.vel.length();
  const dir = speed>1 ? state.vel.clone().normalize() : new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0);
  setShot(t, worldMissile, dir, speed);

  // audio updates
  if(audioCtx){
    const lt = Math.max(0, launchT);
    const th = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(lt/1.2,0,1);
    const sp = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(speed/4500,0,1);
    rumbleGain.gain.value = (lt<0.2?0:1) * th * Math.max(0,1-Math.max(0,lt-8)/22) * 0.9;
    roarGain.gain.value = th * (0.6 + sp*0.7);
    windGain.gain.value = 0.05 + sp*0.45;
    mechGain.gain.value = (t<3) ? (0.07*(1-doorP)) : 0;
    initAudio.osc.frequency.value = 46 + sp*120;
    initAudio.roarBP.frequency.value = 180 + sp*780;
    initAudio.windHP.frequency.value = 450 + sp*2200;
  }

  // clouds subtle drift
  clouds.rotation.y += dt*0.0025;

  composer.render();
}
requestAnimationFrame(animate);

window.addEventListener("resize", ()=>{
  renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
  composer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
  camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
});

// initialize position state from missile world transform
state.missilePos.copy(missile.getWorldPosition(new THREE.Vector3()));
</script>

// Sky dome

// Noise helpers
function hash(x, z){
  const s = Math.sin(x*127.1 + z*311.7) * 43758.5453123;
  return s - Math.floor(s);
}
function noise2(x,z){
  const xi = Math.floor(x), zi = Math.floor(z);
  const xf = x-xi, zf = z-zi;
  const a = hash(xi,zi), b = hash(xi+1,zi), c = hash(xi,zi+1), d = hash(xi+1,zi+1);
  const u = xf*xf*(3-2*xf), v = zf*zf*(3-2*zf);
  return THREE.MathUtils.lerp(THREE.MathUtils.lerp(a,b,u), THREE.MathUtils.lerp(c,d,u), v);
}
function fbm(x,z){
  let f=0, a=0.5, fr=0.002;
  for(let i=0;i<6;i++){ f += a*noise2(x*fr,z*fr); a*=0.5; fr*=2.1; }
  return f;
}
function terrainHeight(x,z){

  const ridges = (fbm(x,z)-0.5)*180 + (fbm(x*0.5,z*0.5)-0.5)*260;
  const plateau = Math.exp(-((x+340)*(x+340)+(z-65)*(z-65))/90000)*220;
  return Math.max(0, mountain + ridges + plateau);

class ParticleSystem {
  constructor(max, size, color, opacity){
    this.max = max;
    this.positions = new Float32Array(max*3);
    this.sizes = new Float32Array(max);
    this.alphas = new Float32Array(max);
    this.vel = new Array(max).fill(0).map(()=>new THREE.Vector3());
    this.life = new Float32Array(max);
    this.active = new Uint8Array(max);
    this.ptr = 0;

    const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    geo.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(this.positions,3));
    geo.setAttribute("aSize", new THREE.BufferAttribute(this.sizes,1));
    geo.setAttribute("aAlpha", new THREE.BufferAttribute(this.alphas,1));
    const mat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
      transparent:true, depthWrite:false, blending:THREE.NormalBlending,
      uniforms:{ uColor:{value:new THREE.Color(color)}, uOpacity:{value:opacity} },
      vertexShader: `
        attribute float aSize;
        attribute float aAlpha;
        varying float vA;
        void main(){
          vA = aAlpha;
          vec4 mv = modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0);
          gl_PointSize = aSize * (300.0 / -mv.z);
          gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mv;
        }
      `,
      fragmentShader: `
        uniform vec3 uColor;
        uniform float uOpacity;
        varying float vA;
        void main(){
          vec2 uv = gl_PointCoord - 0.5;
          float d = dot(uv,uv);
          float a = smoothstep(0.25,0.0,d) * vA * uOpacity;
          gl_FragColor = vec4(uColor,a);
        }
      `
    });
    this.points = new THREE.Points(geo, mat);
    this.geo = geo;
  }
  emit(p, v, life, size, alpha){
    const i = this.ptr++ % this.max;
    this.positions[i*3]=p.x; this.positions[i*3+1]=p.y; this.positions[i*3+2]=p.z;
    this.vel[i].copy(v);
    this.life[i]=life;
    this.sizes[i]=size;
    this.alphas[i]=alpha;
    this.active[i]=1;
  }
  update(dt, gravity=0){
    for(let i=0;i<this.max;i++){
      if(!this.active[i]) continue;
      this.life[i]-=dt;
      if(this.life[i]<=0){ this.active[i]=0; this.alphas[i]=0; continue; }
      this.vel[i].y += gravity*dt;
      this.positions[i*3] += this.vel[i].x*dt;
      this.positions[i*3+1] += this.vel[i].y*dt;
      this.positions[i*3+2] += this.vel[i].z*dt;
      this.sizes[i] *= (1 + dt*0.28);
      this.alphas[i] *= Math.exp(-dt*1.15);
    }
    this.geo.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
    this.geo.attributes.aSize.needsUpdate = true;
    this.geo.attributes.aAlpha.needsUpdate = true;
  }
}

const smoke = new ParticleSystem(3600, 120, 0xd6d8db, 0.82);
scene.add(smoke.points);
const dust = new ParticleSystem(1800, 140, 0xb9a58a, 0.72);
scene.add(dust.points);

// Exhaust trail line
const trailMax = 2500;
const trailPos = new Float32Array(trailMax*3);
const trailCol = new Float32Array(trailMax*3);
for(let i=0;i<trailMax;i++){
  trailPos[i*3]=trailPos[i*3+1]=trailPos[i*3+2]=999999;
}
const trailGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
trailGeo.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(trailPos,3));
trailGeo.setAttribute("color", new THREE.BufferAttribute(trailCol,3));
const trailMat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ vertexColors:true, transparent:true, opacity:0.65 });
const trail = new THREE.Line(trailGeo, trailMat);
scene.add(trail);
let trailIndex = 0;
function pushTrail(p){
  trailPos[trailIndex*3]=p.x;
  trailPos[trailIndex*3+1]=p.y;
  trailPos[trailIndex*3+2]=p.z;
  const k = trailIndex/trailMax;
  trailCol[trailIndex*3] = 1.0 - k*0.5;
  trailCol[trailIndex*3+1] = 0.62 - k*0.4;
  trailCol[trailIndex*3+2] = 0.22 - k*0.15;
  trailIndex = (trailIndex+1)%trailMax;
  trailGeo.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
  trailGeo.attributes.color.needsUpdate = true;
}

// Physics
const state = {
  t: 0,
  start: performance.now(),
  missilePos: new THREE.Vector3().copy(missile.getWorldPosition(new THREE.Vector3())),
  vel: new THREE.Vector3(),
  acc: new THREE.Vector3(),
  dir: new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0),
  launched:false
};

const up = new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0);
const tmpV = new THREE.Vector3();
const targetCamPos = new THREE.Vector3();
const targetLook = new THREE.Vector3();
const camQuat = new THREE.Quaternion();

// Audio
let audioCtx = null;
let master = null;
let roarGain, rumbleGain, windGain, mechGain;
function initAudio(){
  if(audioCtx) return;
  audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
  master = audioCtx.createGain();
  master.gain.value = 0.7;
  master.connect(audioCtx.destination);

  const noiseBuf = audioCtx.createBuffer(1, audioCtx.sampleRate*4, audioCtx.sampleRate);
  const d = noiseBuf.getChannelData(0);
  let last = 0;
  for(let i=0;i<d.length;i++){
    const white = Math.random()*2-1;
    last = (last + 0.02*white)/1.02;
    d[i] = last*3.5;
  }

  function noiseNode(){
    const n = audioCtx.createBufferSource();
    n.buffer = noiseBuf;
    n.loop = true;
    return n;
  }

  // Rumble
  rumbleGain = audioCtx.createGain();
  rumbleGain.gain.value = 0;
  const rumbleLP = audioCtx.createBiquadFilter();
  rumbleLP.type = "lowpass";
  rumbleLP.frequency.value = 90;
  const n1 = noiseNode();
  n1.connect(rumbleLP).connect(rumbleGain).connect(master);
  n1.start();

  // Roar
  roarGain = audioCtx.createGain();
  roarGain.gain.value = 0;
  const roarBP = audioCtx.createBiquadFilter();
  roarBP.type = "bandpass";
  roarBP.frequency.value = 220;
  roarBP.Q.value = 0.7;
  const n2 = noiseNode();
  n2.connect(roarBP).connect(roarGain).connect(master);
  n2.start();
  const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
  osc.type = "sawtooth";
  const oscGain = audioCtx.createGain();
  oscGain.gain.value = 0.02;
  osc.connect(oscGain).connect(roarGain);
  osc.start();

  // Wind
  windGain = audioCtx.createGain();
  windGain.gain.value = 0;
  const windHP = audioCtx.createBiquadFilter();
  windHP.type = "highpass";
  windHP.frequency.value = 500;
  const n3 = noiseNode();
  n3.connect(windHP).connect(windGain).connect(master);
  n3.start();

  // Mechanical door
  mechGain = audioCtx.createGain();
  mechGain.gain.value = 0;
  mechGain.connect(master);
  const mechOsc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
  mechOsc.type = "square";
  mechOsc.frequency.value = 36;
  mechOsc.connect(mechGain);
  mechOsc.start();

  // store refs
  initAudio.osc = osc;
  initAudio.roarBP = roarBP;
  initAudio.windHP = windHP;
}
window.addEventListener("pointerdown", ()=>{ initAudio(); if(audioCtx && audioCtx.state!=="running") audioCtx.resume(); }, { once:false });
setTimeout(()=>{ try{ initAudio(); if(audioCtx.state!=="running") audioCtx.resume(); }catch(e){} }, 200);

// Camera shot director
function setShot(t, missileWorldPos, dir, speed){
  if(t < 5){
    // low-angle side close up
    targetCamPos.copy(missileWorldPos).add(new THREE.Vector3(18, 6, 28));
    targetLook.copy(missileWorldPos).add(new THREE.Vector3(0, 7, 0));
  } else if(t < 10){
    // chase behind below
    targetCamPos.copy(missileWorldPos).addScaledVector(dir, -22).add(new THREE.Vector3(0,-7,0));
    targetLook.copy(missileWorldPos).addScaledVector(dir, 35);
  } else if(t < 14){
    // FPV
    targetCamPos.copy(missileWorldPos).addScaledVector(dir, 1.6).add(new THREE.Vector3(0,0.12,0));
    targetLook.copy(missileWorldPos).addScaledVector(dir, 1600).add(new THREE.Vector3(0,20,0));
  } else if(t < 19){
    // side profile tracking
    const side = new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(dir, up).normalize();
    targetCamPos.copy(missileWorldPos).addScaledVector(side, 38).add(new THREE.Vector3(0,10,0));
    targetLook.copy(missileWorldPos).addScaledVector(dir, 120);
  } else if(t < 24){
    // top-down wide
    targetCamPos.copy(missileWorldPos).add(new THREE.Vector3(0, 900 + speed*0.15, 380));
    targetLook.copy(missileWorldPos).add(new THREE.Vector3(0,-250,0));
  } else {
    // orbiting
    const a = (t-24)*0.65;
    const r = 42 + Math.sin(t*0.5)*8;
    targetCamPos.copy(missileWorldPos).add(new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(a)*r, 14+Math.sin(a*1.5)*8, Math.sin(a)*r));
    targetLook.copy(missileWorldPos).addScaledVector(dir, 120);
  }

  // camera shake at ignition
  if(t > 2.8 && t < 5.5){
    const s = (5.5-t)/2.7;
    targetCamPos.x += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.65*s;
    targetCamPos.y += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.35*s;
    targetCamPos.z += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.65*s;
  }

  camera.position.lerp(targetCamPos, 0.09);
  const m = new THREE.Matrix4().lookAt(camera.position, targetLook, up);
  camQuat.setFromRotationMatrix(m);
  camera.quaternion.slerp(camQuat, 0.1);
}

// Timing
let prev = performance.now();
function animate(now){
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  const dt = Math.min(0.033, (now - prev) / 1000);
  prev = now;
  const t = (now - state.start) / 1000;
  state.t = t;

  // Door animation (0-3s)
  const doorP = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(t/3,0,1);
  const ease = doorP<1 ? 1-Math.pow(1-doorP,2.4) : 1;
  doorL.position.x = -11 - ease*12;
  doorR.position.x = 11 + ease*12;

  // Launch
  const launchT = t - 3.0;
  let throttle = 0;
  if(launchT > 0){
    state.launched = true;
    throttle = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(launchT/1.1, 0, 1);

    const alt = state.missilePos.y;
    const rho = Math.exp(-Math.max(0,alt)/8500);
    const pitch = THREE.MathUtils.clamp((launchT-10)/15, 0, 1) * 0.12;
    state.dir.set(Math.sin(pitch), Math.cos(pitch), Math.sin(launchT*0.22)*0.03).normalize();

    const thrustAccel = (360*Math.exp(-launchT/26)+110) * throttle;
    state.acc.copy(state.dir).multiplyScalar(thrustAccel);
    state.acc.y -= 9.81;

    const vMag = state.vel.length();
    const drag = state.vel.clone().multiplyScalar(-0.000012 * rho * vMag);
    state.acc.add(drag);

    state.vel.addScaledVector(state.acc, dt);
    state.missilePos.addScaledVector(state.vel, dt);

    const worldToBunker = bunkerRoot.worldToLocal(state.missilePos.clone());
    missile.position.copy(worldToBunker);

    tmpV.copy(state.vel).normalize();
    if(tmpV.lengthSq() > 0.1){
      const q = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(up, tmpV);
      missile.quaternion.slerp(q, 0.2);
    }

    // Fin vibration
    for(let i=0;i<fins.length;i++){
      fins[i].rotation.y = Math.sin(t*55 + i*1.9) * 0.03 * throttle;
      fins[i].rotation.x = Math.cos(t*47 + i*1.2) * 0.018 * throttle;
    }

    // Exhaust and smoke
    const worldPos = missile.getWorldPosition(new THREE.Vector3());
    const down = tmpV.lengthSq()>0.01 ? tmpV.clone().multiplyScalar(-1) : new THREE.Vector3(0,-1,0);
    for(let i=0;i<10;i++){
      const jitter = new THREE.Vector3((Math.random()-0.5)*1.2, (Math.random()-0.5)*0.8, (Math.random()-0.5)*1.2);
      const p = worldPos.clone().add(down.clone().multiplyScalar(1.8)).add(jitter);
      const v = down.clone().multiplyScalar(70 + Math.random()*35).add(new THREE.Vector3((Math.random()-0.5)*9, Math.random()*8, (Math.random()-0.5)*9));
      smoke.emit(p, v, 2.2 + Math.random()*2.1, 90 + Math.random()*110, 0.95);
    }
    if(launchT < 4){
      for(let i=0;i<28;i++){
        const a = Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
        const r = Math.random()*18;
        const gp = new THREE.Vector3(-320 + Math.cos(a)*r, terrainHeight(-320 + Math.cos(a)*r,70 + Math.sin(a)*r)+1, 70 + Math.sin(a)*r);
        const vv = new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(a)*(12+Math.random()*25), 8+Math.random()*22, Math.sin(a)*(12+Math.random()*25));
        dust.emit(gp, vv, 2.5 + Math.random()*2.6, 120 + Math.random()*120, 0.75);
      }
    }

    pushTrail(worldPos);

    // Flame intensity
    flame.visible = true;
    const dyn = throttle * (0.75 + Math.sin(t*45)*0.1 + Math.random()*0.08);
    flame.scale.set(1.0 + dyn*0.55, 1.6 + dyn*2.6, 1.0 + dyn*0.55);
    flameMat.uniforms.power.value = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(dyn,0,1.4);
    flameMat.uniforms.t.value = t;
    exhaustLight.intensity = 20 * dyn;
    exhaustLight.distance = 180 + dyn*80;

    // Hypersonic heating
    const speed = state.vel.length();
    const heat = THREE.MathUtils.clamp((speed-1200)/2800,0,1) * Math.exp(-Math.max(0,alt-42000)/18000);
    nose.material.emissiveIntensity = heat*3.2;
    plasma.material.opacity = heat*0.75;
    plasma.scale.setScalar(1 + heat*1.6);
  } else {
    flame.visible = false;
    exhaustLight.intensity = 0;
  }

  smoke.update(dt, 1.8);
  dust.update(dt, -2.0);

  const worldMissile = missile.getWorldPosition(new THREE.Vector3());
  const speed = state.vel.length();
  const dir = speed>1 ? state.vel.clone().normalize() : new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0);
  setShot(t, worldMissile, dir, speed);

  // audio updates
  if(audioCtx){
    const lt = Math.max(0, launchT);
    const th = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(lt/1.2,0,1);
    const sp = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(speed/4500,0,1);
    rumbleGain.gain.value = (lt<0.2?0:1) * th * Math.max(0,1-Math.max(0,lt-8)/22) * 0.9;
    roarGain.gain.value = th * (0.6 + sp*0.7);
    windGain.gain.value = 0.05 + sp*0.45;
    mechGain.gain.value = (t<3) ? (0.07*(1-doorP)) : 0;
    initAudio.osc.frequency.value = 46 + sp*120;
    initAudio.roarBP.frequency.value = 180 + sp*780;
    initAudio.windHP.frequency.value = 450 + sp*2200;
  }

  // clouds subtle drift
  clouds.rotation.y += dt*0.0025;

  composer.render();
}
requestAnimationFrame(animate);

window.addEventListener("resize", ()=>{
  renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
  composer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
  camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
});

// initialize position state from missile world transform
state.missilePos.copy(missile.getWorldPosition(new THREE.Vector3()));
</script>

</html>

messages.content: You are an expert HTML5 game developer. Respond with only the complete, self-contained HTML source code for the requested game. Start your response with <!DOCTYPE html> and end it with </html>. Do not include Markdown code fences, explanations, or any text outside the HTML document. Include all CSS and JavaScript in the HTML file.
Create a game where u have to duel with one person and win. The controls should be realistic. There should be the ability dodge an attack,counter the attack or block the attack

response:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
<title>Duel: Block, Dodge, Counter</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; background: #0f1116; overflow: hidden; font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; }
  canvas { display: block; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  function resize() {
    canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
  resize();

  const keys = {};
  const justPressed = {};
  const actionKeys = new Set(["KeyA","KeyD","KeyJ","KeyK","KeyL","KeyI","KeyR","Space"]);
  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (actionKeys.has(e.code)) e.preventDefault();
    if (!keys[e.code]) justPressed[e.code] = true;
    keys[e.code] = true;
  });
  window.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
    keys[e.code] = false;
  });

  const game = {
    time: 0,
    over: false,
    winner: null,
    message: "",
    messageTimer: 0,
    floorY: 0
  };

  function fighter(name, isPlayer, x) {
    return {
      name, isPlayer, x, y: 0,
      dir: isPlayer ? 1 : -1,
      vx: 0,
      hp: 100,
      stamina: 100,
      state: "idle", // idle, attackWindup, attackStrike, dodge, counter, recovery, stun
      timer: 0,
      totalTimer: 0,
      counterActive: false,
      blocking: false,
      cooldown: 0,
      dodgeDir: 0,
      ai: {
        think: 0,
        reactionDelay: 0,
        queuedReaction: null,
        blockUntil: 0
      }
    };
  }

  let player = fighter("You", true, 280);
  let enemy = fighter("Rival", false, 760);

  const meleeRange = 120;
  const arenaPadding = 80;

  function resetGame() {
    player = fighter("You", true, Math.max(180, canvas.width * 0.28));
    enemy = fighter("Rival", false, Math.min(canvas.width - 180, canvas.width * 0.72));
    game.time = 0;
    game.over = false;
    game.winner = null;
    game.message = "Fight!";
    game.messageTimer = 1.2;
  }

  function opponentOf(f) {
    return f === player ? enemy : player;
  }

  function setState(f, state, duration) {
    f.state = state;
    f.timer = duration;
    f.totalTimer = duration;
    if (state !== "counter") f.counterActive = false;
    if (state !== "idle") f.blocking = false;
  }

  function canAct(f) {
    return f.state === "idle";
  }

  function canBlock(f) {
    return !["stun","dodge","attackWindup","attackStrike","counter"].includes(f.state) && f.stamina > 3;
  }

  function clamp(v, a, b) { return Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v)); }

  function showMessage(msg, t = 0.8) {
    game.message = msg;
    game.messageTimer = t;
  }

  function endGame(winnerName) {
    game.over = true;
    game.winner = winnerName;
  }

  function dealDamage(target, amount) {
    target.hp = Math.max(0, target.hp - amount);
    if (target.hp <= 0 && !game.over) {
      endGame(target === player ? "Rival" : "You");
    }
  }

  function startStun(f, dur) {
    setState(f, "stun", dur);
    f.vx = 0;
    f.blocking = false;
  }

  function startAttack(f) {
    if (!canAct(f) || f.stamina < 18 || f.cooldown > 0 || game.over) return false;
    f.stamina -= 18;
    setState(f, "attackWindup", f.isPlayer ? 0.28 : 0.36 + Math.random() * 0.18);
    f.cooldown = 0.45;
    return true;
  }

  function startDodge(f, forcedDir = null) {
    if (!canAct(f) || f.stamina < 24 || game.over) return false;
    f.stamina -= 24;
    let dir = forcedDir;
    const opp = opponentOf(f);

    if (dir == null) {
      if (f.isPlayer) {
        const inputDir = (keys["KeyD"] ? 1 : 0) - (keys["KeyA"] ? 1 : 0);
        dir = inputDir !== 0 ? inputDir : Math.sign(f.x - opp.x) || -1; // default backstep
      } else {
        dir = (Math.random() < 0.72) ? (Math.sign(f.x - opp.x) || 1) : (Math.sign(opp.x - f.x) || -1);
      }
    }
    f.dodgeDir = dir;
    setState(f, "dodge", 0.28);
    return true;
  }

  function startCounter(f) {
    if (!canAct(f) || f.stamina < 16 || game.over) return false;
    f.stamina -= 16;
    setState(f, "counter", 0.30);
    return true;
  }

  function resolveAttack(attacker, defender) {
    const dist = Math.abs(attacker.x - defender.x);
    if (dist > meleeRange + 16) {
      if (attacker.isPlayer) showMessage("Your strike missed.");
      return;
    }

    if (defender.state === "dodge") {
      if (attacker.isPlayer) showMessage("Dodged!");
      else showMessage("You dodged the attack!");
      return;
    }

    if (defender.state === "counter" && defender.counterActive) {
      const riposte = 22 + Math.random() * 6;
      dealDamage(attacker, riposte);
      startStun(attacker, 0.85);
      showMessage(defender.isPlayer ? "Perfect counter!" : "You got countered!");
      return;
    }

    if (defender.blocking && canBlock(defender)) {
      defender.stamina -= 24;
      const chip = 3 + Math.random() * 2.5;
      dealDamage(defender, chip);
      if (defender.stamina <= 0) {
        defender.stamina = 0;
        dealDamage(defender, 11);
        startStun(defender, 0.7);
        showMessage(defender.isPlayer ? "Guard broken!" : "Enemy guard broken!");
      } else {
        if (attacker.isPlayer) showMessage("Blocked.");
      }
      return;
    }

    const dmg = 14 + Math.random() * 10;
    dealDamage(defender, dmg);
    startStun(defender, 0.34);
    if (attacker.isPlayer) showMessage("Clean hit!");
  }

  function updateState(f, dt) {
    if (f.cooldown > 0) f.cooldown -= dt;
    f.cooldown = Math.max(0, f.cooldown);

    // stamina
    if (f.blocking) {
      f.stamina -= 10 * dt;
    } else if (["attackWindup","attackStrike","dodge","counter","stun"].includes(f.state)) {
      f.stamina += 7 * dt;
    } else {
      f.stamina += 20 * dt;
    }
    f.stamina = clamp(f.stamina, 0, 100);
    if (f.stamina <= 0 && f.blocking) f.blocking = false;

    switch (f.state) {
      case "attackWindup":
        f.timer -= dt;
        if (f.timer <= 0) {
          setState(f, "attackStrike", 0.11);
          resolveAttack(f, opponentOf(f));
        }
        break;
      case "attackStrike":
        f.timer -= dt;
        if (f.timer <= 0) setState(f, "recovery", 0.26);
        break;
      case "dodge":
        f.timer -= dt;
        if (f.timer <= 0) setState(f, "recovery", 0.15);
        break;
      case "counter": {
        f.timer -= dt;
        const elapsed = f.totalTimer - f.timer;
        f.counterActive = elapsed > 0.06 && elapsed < 0.24;
        if (f.timer <= 0) {
          f.counterActive = false;
          setState(f, "recovery", 0.2);
        }
        break;
      }
      case "recovery":
        f.timer -= dt;
        if (f.timer <= 0) setState(f, "idle", 0);
        break;
      case "stun":
        f.timer -= dt;
        if (f.timer <= 0) setState(f, "idle", 0);
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }
  }

  function updatePlayer(dt) {
    if (game.over) return;
    const f = player;
    const opp = enemy;

    f.dir = opp.x >= f.x ? 1 : -1;

    // One-shot actions
    if (justPressed["KeyJ"] || justPressed["Space"]) startAttack(f);
    if (justPressed["KeyL"]) startDodge(f);
    if (justPressed["KeyI"]) startCounter(f);

    // Block (hold)
    if (keys["KeyK"] && canBlock(f) && !game.over) f.blocking = true;
    else f.blocking = false;

    // Movement
    if (f.state === "dodge") {
      f.vx = f.dodgeDir * 480;
    } else if (f.state === "stun") {
      f.vx = 0;
    } else {
      const move = (keys["KeyD"] ? 1 : 0) - (keys["KeyA"] ? 1 : 0);
      let speed = 220;
      if (f.blocking) speed *= 0.45;
      if (f.state === "attackWindup" || f.state === "recovery") speed *= 0.55;
      f.vx = move * speed;
    }

    f.x += f.vx * dt;
    f.x = clamp(f.x, arenaPadding, canvas.width - arenaPadding);
  }

  function tryEnemyReaction() {
    const e = enemy, p = player;
    const dist = Math.abs(e.x - p.x);
    if (!canAct(e) || e.stamina < 14 || dist > 170) return;

    if (p.state === "attackWindup" || p.state === "attackStrike") {
      const r = Math.random();
      if (r < 0.45 && e.stamina > 12) {
        e.ai.queuedReaction = "block";
      } else if (r < 0.75 && e.stamina > 24) {
        e.ai.queuedReaction = "dodge";
      } else if (e.stamina > 16) {
        e.ai.queuedReaction = "counter";
      }
      e.ai.reactionDelay = 0.08 + Math.random() * 0.16;
    }
  }

  function updateEnemyAI(dt) {
    if (game.over) return;
    const e = enemy, p = player;
    const dist = Math.abs(e.x - p.x);
    e.dir = p.x >= e.x ? 1 : -1;

    e.ai.think -= dt;
    if (e.ai.think <= 0) {
      e.ai.think = 0.14 + Math.random() * 0.2;

      if (canAct(e)) {
        tryEnemyReaction();

        if (!e.ai.queuedReaction) {
          if (dist < 135 && e.cooldown <= 0 && e.stamina >= 18 && Math.random() < 0.65) {
            startAttack(e);
          } else if (dist < 125 && e.stamina > 16 && Math.random() < 0.15) {
            startCounter(e);
          } else if (dist < 130 && e.stamina > 18 && Math.random() < 0.2) {
            e.ai.blockUntil = game.time + (0.25 + Math.random() * 0.35);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    if (e.ai.reactionDelay > 0) {
      e.ai.reactionDelay -= dt;
      if (e.ai.reactionDelay <= 0 && e.ai.queuedReaction && canAct(e)) {
        const act = e.ai.queuedReaction;
        if (act === "block") e.ai.blockUntil = game.time + 0.45;
        if (act === "dodge") startDodge(e);
        if (act === "counter") startCounter(e);
        e.ai.queuedReaction = null;
      }
    }

    if (canBlock(e) && game.time < e.ai.blockUntil) e.blocking = true;
    else e.blocking = false;

    if (e.state === "dodge") {
      e.vx = e.dodgeDir * 470;
    } else if (e.state === "stun") {
      e.vx = 0;
    } else {
      const target = 110;
      let speed = e.blocking ? 90 : 170;
      if (dist > target + 15) e.vx = (p.x > e.x ? 1 : -1) * speed;
      else if (dist < target - 20) e.vx = (p.x > e.x ? -1 : 1) * (speed * 0.8);
      else e.vx = 0;

      if (e.state === "attackWindup" || e.state === "recovery") e.vx *= 0.4;
    }

    e.x += e.vx * dt;
    e.x = clamp(e.x, arenaPadding, canvas.width - arenaPadding);
  }

  function drawBar(x, y, w, h, value, color, bg = "#00000088") {
    ctx.fillStyle = bg;
    ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, h);
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.fillRect(x + 2, y + 2, (w - 4) * clamp(value, 0, 1), h - 4);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#ffffff33";
    ctx.strokeRect(x, y, w, h);
  }

  function drawFighter(f, bodyColor, accentColor) {
    const ground = game.floorY;
    const x = f.x, y = ground;
    const s = Math.max(0.8, Math.min(1.2, canvas.width / 1100));

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    ctx.scale(f.dir, 1);

    if (f.state === "dodge") {
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.35;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#9ec5ff";
      ctx.fillRect(-20*s, -95*s, 40*s, 95*s);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }

    // Legs
    ctx.strokeStyle = bodyColor;
    ctx.lineWidth = 8*s;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -8*s);
    ctx.lineTo(-12*s, 28*s);
    ctx.moveTo(0, -8*s);
    ctx.lineTo(14*s, 28*s);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Torso
    ctx.lineWidth = 10*s;
    let lean = 0;
    if (f.state === "attackWindup") lean = -8*s;
    if (f.state === "attackStrike") lean = 8*s;
    if (f.state === "stun") lean = -5*s;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -10*s);

      ctx.lineTo(20*s, -58*s);

  function loop(now) {
    const dt = Math.min(0.033, (now - last) / 1000);

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
<title>Duel: Block, Dodge, Counter</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; background: #0f1116; overflow: hidden; font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; }
  canvas { display: block; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  function resize() {
    canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
  resize();

  const keys = {};
  const justPressed = {};
  const actionKeys = new Set(["KeyA","KeyD","KeyJ","KeyK","KeyL","KeyI","KeyR","Space"]);
  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (actionKeys.has(e.code)) e.preventDefault();
    if (!keys[e.code]) justPressed[e.code] = true;
    keys[e.code] = true;
  });
  window.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
    keys[e.code] = false;
  });

  const game = {
    time: 0,
    over: false,
    winner: null,
    message: "",
    messageTimer: 0,
    floorY: 0
  };

  function fighter(name, isPlayer, x) {
    return {
      name, isPlayer, x, y: 0,
      dir: isPlayer ? 1 : -1,
      vx: 0,
      hp: 100,
      stamina: 100,
      state: "idle", // idle, attackWindup, attackStrike, dodge, counter, recovery, stun
      timer: 0,
      totalTimer: 0,
      counterActive: false,
      blocking: false,
      cooldown: 0,
      dodgeDir: 0,
      ai: {
        think: 0,
        reactionDelay: 0,
        queuedReaction: null,
        blockUntil: 0
      }
    };
  }

  let player = fighter("You", true, 280);
  let enemy = fighter("Rival", false, 760);

  const meleeRange = 120;
  const arenaPadding = 80;

  function resetGame() {
    player = fighter("You", true, Math.max(180, canvas.width * 0.28));
    enemy = fighter("Rival", false, Math.min(canvas.width - 180, canvas.width * 0.72));
    game.time = 0;
    game.over = false;
    game.winner = null;
    game.message = "Fight!";
    game.messageTimer = 1.2;
  }

  function opponentOf(f) {
    return f === player ? enemy : player;
  }

  function setState(f, state, duration) {
    f.state = state;
    f.timer = duration;
    f.totalTimer = duration;
    if (state !== "counter") f.counterActive = false;
    if (state !== "idle") f.blocking = false;
  }

  function canAct(f) {
    return f.state === "idle";
  }

  function canBlock(f) {
    return !["stun","dodge","attackWindup","attackStrike","counter"].includes(f.state) && f.stamina > 3;
  }

  function clamp(v, a, b) { return Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v)); }

  function showMessage(msg, t = 0.8) {
    game.message = msg;
    game.messageTimer = t;
  }

  function endGame(winnerName) {
    game.over = true;
    game.winner = winnerName;
  }

  function dealDamage(target, amount) {
    target.hp = Math.max(0, target.hp - amount);
    if (target.hp <= 0 && !game.over) {
      endGame(target === player ? "Rival" : "You");
    }
  }

  function startStun(f, dur) {
    setState(f, "stun", dur);
    f.vx = 0;
    f.blocking = false;
  }

  function startAttack(f) {
    if (!canAct(f) || f.stamina < 18 || f.cooldown > 0 || game.over) return false;
    f.stamina -= 18;
    setState(f, "attackWindup", f.isPlayer ? 0.28 : 0.36 + Math.random() * 0.18);
    f.cooldown = 0.45;
    return true;
  }

  function startDodge(f, forcedDir = null) {
    if (!canAct(f) || f.stamina < 24 || game.over) return false;
    f.stamina -= 24;

    const opp = opponentOf(f);

    if (dir == null) {

        const inputDir = (keys["KeyD"] ? 1 : 0) - (keys["KeyA"] ? 1 : 0);
        dir = inputDir !== 0 ? inputDir : Math.sign(f.x - opp.x) || -1; // default backstep
      } else {
        dir = (Math.random() < 0.72) ? (Math.sign(f.x - opp.x) || 1) : (Math.sign(opp.x - f.x) || -1);
      }
    }
    f.dodgeDir = dir;
    setState(f, "dodge", 0.28);
    return true;
  }

    if (!canAct(f) || f.stamina < 16 || game.over) return false;

    setState(f, "counter", 0.30);

  }

    const dist = Math.abs(attacker.x - defender.x);

      return;

    if (defender.state === "dodge") {
      if (attacker.isPlayer) showMessage("Dodged!");
      else showMessage("You dodged the attack!");
      return;

      const riposte = 22 + Math.random() * 6;
      dealDamage(attacker, riposte);
      startStun(attacker, 0.85);
      showMessage(defender.isPlayer ? "Perfect counter!" : "You got countered!");

    }

    if (defender.blocking && canBlock(defender)) {
      defender.stamina -= 24;
      const chip = 3 + Math.random() * 2.5;
      dealDamage(defender, chip);
      if (defender.stamina <= 0) {
        defender.stamina = 0;
        dealDamage(defender, 11);
        startStun(defender, 0.7);
        showMessage(defender.isPlayer ? "Guard broken!" : "Enemy guard broken!");
      } else {
        if (attacker.isPlayer) showMessage("Blocked.");
      }
      return;
    }

    const dmg = 14 + Math.random() * 10;
    dealDamage(defender, dmg);
    startStun(defender, 0.34);
    if (attacker.isPlayer) showMessage("Clean hit!");

    if (f.cooldown > 0) f.cooldown -= dt;

      f.stamina -= 10 * dt;

    switch (f.state) {

      case "attackStrike":

        if (f.timer <= 0) setState(f, "recovery", 0.26);

      case "dodge":
        f.timer -= dt;
        if (f.timer <= 0) setState(f, "recovery", 0.15);

      case "counter": {

    if (keys["KeyK"] && canBlock(f) && !game.over) f.blocking = true;
    else f.blocking = false;

    if (f.state === "dodge") {

      if (f.blocking) speed *= 0.45;
      if (f.state === "attackWindup" || f.state === "recovery") speed *= 0.55;
      f.vx = move * speed;

    f.x += f.vx * dt;
    f.x = clamp(f.x, arenaPadding, canvas.width - arenaPadding);

    if (p.state === "attackWindup" || p.state === "attackStrike") {
      const r = Math.random();
      if (r < 0.45 && e.stamina > 12) {
        e.ai.queuedReaction = "block";
      } else if (r < 0.75 && e.stamina > 24) {
        e.ai.queuedReaction = "dodge";
      } else if (e.stamina > 16) {
        e.ai.queuedReaction = "counter";
      }
      e.ai.reactionDelay = 0.08 + Math.random() * 0.16;
    }
  }

  function updateEnemyAI(dt) {

    if (e.ai.think <= 0) {

      if (canAct(e)) {
        tryEnemyReaction();

        if (!e.ai.queuedReaction) {
          if (dist < 135 && e.cooldown <= 0 && e.stamina >= 18 && Math.random() < 0.65) {
            startAttack(e);
          } else if (dist < 125 && e.stamina > 16 && Math.random() < 0.15) {
            startCounter(e);
          } else if (dist < 130 && e.stamina > 18 && Math.random() < 0.2) {
            e.ai.blockUntil = game.time + (0.25 + Math.random() * 0.35);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    if (e.ai.reactionDelay > 0) {
      e.ai.reactionDelay -= dt;
      if (e.ai.reactionDelay <= 0 && e.ai.queuedReaction && canAct(e)) {

        ctx.arc(20*s, -72*s, 6*s, 0, Math.PI*2);

    }

      ctx.font = `${22*s}px Arial`;
      ctx.fillText("!", -4*s, -110*s);
    }

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawScene() {

    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff14";
    ctx.fillRect(0, game.floorY + 26, canvas.width, 3);

    // Fighters
    drawFighter(player, "#d8e9ff", "#9ed0ff");
    drawFighter(enemy, "#ffd9d9", "#ffb0b0");

    // HUD
    const w = Math.min(320, canvas.width * 0.28);
    drawBar(24, 22, w, 22, player.hp / 100, "#4de06f");
    drawBar(24, 52, w, 14, player.stamina / 100, "#5ab8ff");
    ctx.fillStyle = "#e8eef9";
    ctx.font = "16px Arial";

    if (game.messageTimer > 0) {

    }

    ctx.fillStyle = "#d7deea";

    if (game.over) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#000000aa";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

  }

    if (game.messageTimer > 0) game.messageTimer -= dt;

    updatePlayer(dt);
    updateEnemyAI(dt);

    updateState(player, dt);
    updateState(enemy, dt);

    // Face each other
    player.dir = enemy.x >= player.x ? 1 : -1;
    enemy.dir = player.x >= enemy.x ? 1 : -1;

    drawScene();

    for (const k in justPressed) delete justPressed[k];
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  resetGame();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>

  function buildLevel() {

    [4320, 4380, 4440].forEach(x => addCoin(x, 470));
    for (let x = 4520; x < 6150; x += 130) addCoin(x, 510 - Math.sin(x * 0.01) * 40);

    [700, 980, 1880, 2110, 3010, 3560, 4700, 5200, 5790, 6730, 7180, 8010, 8320].forEach(addEnemy);

  // Clouds
  for (let i = 0; i < 22; i++) {

  }

  function rects(a, b) {
    return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;

  function pointInSolid(px, py) {
    for (let i = 0; i < solids.length; i++) {

  function surfaceYAt(x) {

  function emit(x, y, n, color, spd = 220) {

      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;

      particles.push({
        x, y,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * v,
        vy: Math.sin(a) * v - 80,
        life: 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.5,
        max: 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.5,
        size: 2 + Math.random() * 4,
        color,
        g: 900
      });
    }
  }

  function hurtPlayer() {
    if (player.invuln > 0 || state !== "playing") return;
    lives--;
    player.invuln = 2;
    camera.shakeT = 0.35;
    camera.shakeMag = 10;
    emit(player.x + player.w / 2, player.y + player.h / 2, 18, "#ff8f8f", 260);

    if (lives <= 0) {
      state = "gameover";
      return;
    }
    player.x = checkpoints[checkpointIndex];
    player.y = 300;
    player.vx = player.vy = 0;
  }

  function updateEntityPhysics(e, dt) {
    e.onGround = false;

    e.x += e.vx * dt;
    for (let i = 0; i < solids.length; i++) {
      const s = solids[i];
      if (rects(e, s)) {

  function just(...codes) { return codes.some(c => pressed[c]); }

  function update(dt) {

      player.facing = dir;

    if (jumpPressed) player.jumpBuffer = 0.14;
    else player.jumpBuffer = Math.max(0, player.jumpBuffer - dt);

    player.coyote = player.onGround ? 0.11 : Math.max(0, player.coyote - dt);

      player.coyote = 0;

    if (!jumpDown && player.vy < 0) player.vy *= 0.94;
    player.vy += GRAVITY * dt;
    if (player.vy > 1150) player.vy = 1150;

    const prevY = player.y;
    updateEntityPhysics(player, dt);

    if (player.onGround && prevY + player.h < player.y + player.h + 1 && Math.abs(player.vx) > 80) {
      if (Math.random() < 0.35) emit(player.x + player.w * (player.facing < 0 ? 0.85 : 0.15), player.y + player.h, 1, "#c8b28a", 70);

    if (player.y > WORLD_H + 260) {
      hurtPlayer();
    }

    // checkpoints
    if (checkpointIndex < checkpoints.length - 1 && player.x > checkpoints[checkpointIndex + 1]) checkpointIndex++;

    // Enemy update + interaction
    for (const e of enemies) {
      if (e.dead) continue;
      e.vy += GRAVITY * dt;
      if (e.vy > 900) e.vy = 900;

      e.vx = e.dir * 85;
      updateEntityPhysics(e, dt);

      const aheadX = e.dir > 0 ? e.x + e.w + 3 : e.x - 3;
      const footY = e.y + e.h + 2;
      if (!pointInSolid(aheadX, footY)) e.dir *= -1;
      if (e.vx === 0) e.dir *= -1;

      if (rects(player, e)) {
        const stomp = player.vy > 80 && (player.y + player.h - e.y) < 20 && prevY + player.h <= e.y + 8;

          e.dead = true;
          player.vy = -430;

          emit(e.x + e.w / 2, e.y + e.h / 2, 14, "#8a5a2b", 220);
          camera.shakeT = 0.16;
          camera.shakeMag = 6;

    // Coins
    for (const c of coins) {
      if (c.taken) continue;

  function drawWorld() {
    for (const s of solids) {
      const sx = s.x - camera.x;

        ctx.lineWidth = 2;

        }
      } else if (s.type === "pipe") {

        ctx.fillRect(sx + 6, sy + 6, s.w - 12, s.h - 6);

        ctx.fillRect(sx - 6, sy - 16, s.w + 12, 20);

    ctx.lineTo(fx + 64, fy + 36);
    ctx.lineTo(fx + 8, fy + 52);

    ctx.fillRect(x + 10, y + 12, 7, 9);
    ctx.fillRect(x + 22, y + 12, 7, 9);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#222";
    ctx.fillRect(x + 12, y + 14, 3, 5);
    ctx.fillRect(x + 24, y + 14, 3, 5);

    ctx.strokeStyle = "#3e2b1a";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + 11, y + 26);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 28, y + 26);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#3e2b1a";
    ctx.fillRect(x + 6, y + e.h - 5, 12, 5);
    ctx.fillRect(x + 20, y + e.h - 5, 12, 5);
  }

  function drawPlayer() {
    const blink = player.invuln > 0 && Math.floor(player.invuln * 15) % 2 === 0;
    if (blink) return;

    const x = player.x - camera.x, y = player.y - camera.y;
    const runCycle = Math.sin(player.runAnim) * Math.min(1, Math.abs(player.vx) / 240);

    // shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.2)";

    ctx.ellipse(x + player.w / 2, y + player.h + 3, 15, 6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // legs
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2d5fd6";
    roundRect(x + 7, y + 36 + Math.max(0, leg), 11, 18, 4, true);
    roundRect(x + 23, y + 36 + Math.max(0, -leg), 11, 18, 4, true);

    // shoes
    ctx.fillStyle = "#5e341d";
    roundRect(x + 4, y + 50 + Math.max(0, leg), 15, 8, 3, true);
    roundRect(x + 22, y + 50 + Math.max(0, -leg), 15, 8, 3, true);

    // body / overalls
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff3d33";
    roundRect(x + 6, y + 18, 30, 18, 4, true);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2d5fd6";
    roundRect(x + 8, y + 28, 26, 20, 4, true);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd6b6";
    ctx.fillRect(x + 5, y + 26, 4, 10);
    ctx.fillRect(x + 33, y + 26, 4, 10);

    // buttons
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe15a";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + 14, y + 34, 2.4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + 28, y + 34, 2.4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

    // head
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd6b6";
    roundRect(x + 10, y + 6, 22, 16, 6, true);

    // moustache
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2f1d12";
    ctx.fillRect(x + 14, y + 17, 14, 3);

    // eye
    ctx.fillStyle = "#1d1d1d";
    ctx.fillRect(x + (player.facing > 0 ? 24 : 16), y + 11, 3, 5);

    // hat
    ctx.fillStyle = "#d12828";
    roundRect(x + 8, y + 2, 25, 8, 4, true);
    ctx.fillRect(x + 7, y + 9, 28, 4);
  }

  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r, fill = true) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    if (fill) ctx.fill();
    else ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    for (const p of particles) {
      const a = p.life / p.max;
      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.fillRect(p.x - camera.x, p.y - camera.y, p.size, p.size);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.28)";
    roundRect(18, 16, 320, 88, 14, true);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.font = "700 26px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(`SCORE  ${score}`, 34, 48);
    ctx.fillText(`COINS  ${coinCount}`, 34, 76);
    ctx.fillText(`LIVES  ${lives}`, 190, 76);

    ctx.font = "600 18px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.9)";
    ctx.fillText("Move: ← → / A D    Jump: Space / ↑    Run: Shift", 24, H - 18);
  }

  function drawOverlay() {
    if (state === "title") {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.35)";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.font = "900 72px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("MARIO-STYLE ADVENTURE", W / 2, H / 2 - 70);
      ctx.font = "700 30px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("Press Enter or Space to Start", W / 2, H / 2 + 10);
      ctx.font = "500 22px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("Jump gaps, stomp enemies, collect coins, reach the flag!", W / 2, H / 2 + 56);
      ctx.textAlign = "left";
    }
    if (state === "win" || state === "gameover") {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.45)";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.font = "900 84px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText(state === "win" ? "YOU WIN!" : "GAME OVER", W / 2, H / 2 - 40);
      ctx.font = "700 34px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}   Coins: ${coinCount}`, W / 2, H / 2 + 18);
      ctx.font = "600 26px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("Press R / Enter / Space to Play Again", W / 2, H / 2 + 72);
      ctx.textAlign = "left";
    }
  }

  function render() {
    let shakeX = 0, shakeY = 0;
    if (camera.shakeT > 0) {
      const m = camera.shakeMag * (camera.shakeT / 0.35);
      shakeX = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * m;
      shakeY = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * m;
    }

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(shakeX, shakeY);

    drawSky();
    drawWorld();
    drawCoins();

    for (const e of enemies) if (!e.dead) drawEnemy(e);
    drawPlayer();
    drawParticles();

    // vignette
    const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H / 2, H * 0.25, W / 2, H / 2, H * 0.75);
    vg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    vg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0.2)");
    ctx.fillStyle = vg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    drawHUD();
    drawOverlay();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function gameLoop(ts) {
    if (!gameLoop.last) gameLoop.last = ts;
    let dt = (ts - gameLoop.last) / 1000;
    gameLoop.last = ts;
    if (dt > 0.033) dt = 0.033;

    update(dt);
    render();
    requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
  }

  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (!keys[e.code]) pressed[e.code] = true;
    keys[e.code] = true;
    if (["ArrowUp", "ArrowDown", "ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight", "Space"].includes(e.code)) e.preventDefault();
  }, { passive: false });
  window.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => { keys[e.code] = false; });

  buildLevel();
  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
})();
</script>
</body>
