<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no" />
<title>Mario-Style Adventure</title>
<style>
  :root {
    --ui: #ffffff;
    --shadow: rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
  }
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #000;
    font-family: "Trebuchet MS", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  }
  #game {
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
    display: block;
    background: #7ec8ff;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="1280" height="720"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
  const WORLD_W = 9200, WORLD_H = 1200;
  const GRAVITY = 1800;

  const keys = {};
  const pressed = {};

  let state = "title"; // title, playing, win, gameover
  let score = 0;
  let coinCount = 0;
  let lives = 3;

  const camera = { x: 0, y: 0, shakeT: 0, shakeMag: 0 };
  let time = 0;

  const solids = [];
  const enemies = [];
  const coins = [];
  const clouds = [];
  const particles = [];
  const checkpoints = [120, 1750, 3050, 4700, 6900, 8450];
  let checkpointIndex = 0;

  const flag = { x: 8900, y: 220, h: 380 };

  const player = {
    x: 120, y: 350, w: 42, h: 58,
    vx: 0, vy: 0,
    onGround: false,
    coyote: 0,
    jumpBuffer: 0,
    facing: 1,
    runAnim: 0,
    invuln: 0
  };

  function resetGame() {
    score = 0;
    coinCount = 0;
    lives = 3;
    checkpointIndex = 0;
    player.x = checkpoints[0];
    player.y = 350;
    player.vx = player.vy = 0;
    player.onGround = false;
    player.coyote = 0;
    player.jumpBuffer = 0;
    player.invuln = 0;
    camera.x = camera.y = 0;
    camera.shakeT = 0;
    enemies.length = 0;
    coins.length = 0;
    particles.length = 0;
    buildLevel();
    state = "playing";
  }

  function addSolid(x, y, w, h, type = "ground") {
    solids.push({ x, y, w, h, type });
  }
  function addEnemy(x) {
    const top = surfaceYAt(x + 18);
    enemies.push({
      x, y: top - 40, w: 38, h: 36,
      vx: -70, vy: 0, dir: -1, onGround: false, dead: false
    });
  }
  function addCoin(x, y) {
    coins.push({ x, y, r: 13, taken: false, t: Math.random() * 6.28 });
  }

  function buildLevel() {
    solids.length = 0;

    // Ground segments with gaps
    addSolid(0, 600, 1400, 400, "ground");
    addSolid(1600, 600, 1000, 400, "ground");
    addSolid(2750, 600, 1450, 400, "ground");
    addSolid(4450, 600, 1750, 400, "ground");
    addSolid(6500, 600, 2700, 400, "ground");

    // Platforms / bricks
    [
      [820, 470, 180, 28, "brick"], [1040, 420, 180, 28, "brick"],
      [1530, 470, 150, 26, "stone"], [1740, 420, 160, 26, "stone"],
      [1970, 360, 160, 26, "stone"], [2250, 440, 180, 26, "brick"],
      [2880, 500, 160, 26, "brick"], [3110, 440, 180, 26, "stone"],
      [3380, 380, 180, 26, "stone"], [3650, 440, 180, 26, "brick"],
      [4580, 470, 160, 26, "brick"], [4820, 420, 160, 26, "brick"],
      [5050, 360, 160, 26, "stone"], [5300, 420, 180, 26, "stone"],
      [5600, 500, 180, 26, "brick"], [6760, 500, 180, 26, "stone"],
      [7000, 440, 180, 26, "stone"], [7240, 380, 180, 26, "stone"],
      [7480, 320, 180, 26, "stone"], [7800, 500, 210, 26, "brick"],
      [8090, 450, 210, 26, "brick"]
    ].forEach(p => addSolid(...p));

    // Pipes
    addSolid(1180, 500, 82, 100, "pipe");
    addSolid(2480, 470, 88, 130, "pipe");
    addSolid(4090, 450, 90, 150, "pipe");
    addSolid(6030, 460, 90, 140, "pipe");
    addSolid(8420, 430, 100, 170, "pipe");

    // Stair steps near end
    let sx = 8560, sy = 540;
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      addSolid(sx + i * 46, sy - i * 46, 46, 46 * (i + 1), "stone");
    }

    // Coins
    for (let x = 260; x < 1300; x += 150) addCoin(x, 520);
    [1460, 1520, 1580].forEach(x => addCoin(x, 470));
    for (let x = 1680; x < 2550; x += 120) addCoin(x, 520 - Math.sin(x * 0.02) * 50);
    for (let x = 2830; x < 4150; x += 140) addCoin(x, 500 - Math.cos(x * 0.015) * 70);
    [4320, 4380, 4440].forEach(x => addCoin(x, 470));
    for (let x = 4520; x < 6150; x += 130) addCoin(x, 510 - Math.sin(x * 0.01) * 40);
    [6400, 6460, 6520].forEach(x => addCoin(x, 440));
    for (let x = 6620; x < 9000; x += 140) addCoin(x, 505 - Math.sin(x * 0.012) * 55);

    // Enemies
    [700, 980, 1880, 2110, 3010, 3560, 4700, 5200, 5790, 6730, 7180, 8010, 8320].forEach(addEnemy);
  }

  // Clouds
  for (let i = 0; i < 22; i++) {
    clouds.push({
      x: Math.random() * WORLD_W,
      y: 70 + Math.random() * 250,
      s: 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.2,
      speed: 8 + Math.random() * 12
    });
  }

  function rects(a, b) {
    return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
  }

  function pointInSolid(px, py) {
    for (let i = 0; i < solids.length; i++) {
      const s = solids[i];
      if (px >= s.x && px <= s.x + s.w && py >= s.y && py <= s.y + s.h) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  function surfaceYAt(x) {
    let best = WORLD_H;
    for (let i = 0; i < solids.length; i++) {
      const s = solids[i];
      if (x >= s.x && x <= s.x + s.w && s.y < best) best = s.y;
    }
    return best;
  }

  function emit(x, y, n, color, spd = 220) {
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const v = Math.random() * spd;
      particles.push({
        x, y,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * v,
        vy: Math.sin(a) * v - 80,
        life: 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.5,
        max: 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.5,
        size: 2 + Math.random() * 4,
        color,
        g: 900
      });
    }
  }

  function hurtPlayer() {
    if (player.invuln > 0 || state !== "playing") return;
    lives--;
    player.invuln = 2;
    camera.shakeT = 0.35;
    camera.shakeMag = 10;
    emit(player.x + player.w / 2, player.y + player.h / 2, 18, "#ff8f8f", 260);

    if (lives <= 0) {
      state = "gameover";
      return;
    }
    player.x = checkpoints[checkpointIndex];
    player.y = 300;
    player.vx = player.vy = 0;
  }

  function updateEntityPhysics(e, dt) {
    e.onGround = false;

    e.x += e.vx * dt;
    for (let i = 0; i < solids.length; i++) {
      const s = solids[i];
      if (rects(e, s)) {
        if (e.vx > 0) e.x = s.x - e.w;
        else if (e.vx < 0) e.x = s.x + s.w;
        e.vx = 0;
      }
    }

    e.y += e.vy * dt;
    for (let i = 0; i < solids.length; i++) {
      const s = solids[i];
      if (rects(e, s)) {
        if (e.vy > 0) {
          e.y = s.y - e.h;
          e.vy = 0;
          e.onGround = true;
        } else if (e.vy < 0) {
          e.y = s.y + s.h;
          e.vy = 0;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function isDown(...codes) { return codes.some(c => keys[c]); }
  function just(...codes) { return codes.some(c => pressed[c]); }

  function update(dt) {
    time += dt;

    // clouds drift globally
    for (const c of clouds) {
      c.x += c.speed * dt;
      if (c.x > WORLD_W + 400) c.x = -400;
    }

    if (state === "title") {
      if (just("Enter", "Space")) resetGame();
      clearPressed();
      return;
    }

    if (state === "win" || state === "gameover") {
      if (just("KeyR", "Enter", "Space")) resetGame();
      updateParticles(dt);
      clearPressed();
      return;
    }

    // Playing
    player.invuln = Math.max(0, player.invuln - dt);

    const moveL = isDown("ArrowLeft", "KeyA");
    const moveR = isDown("ArrowRight", "KeyD");
    const run = isDown("ShiftLeft", "ShiftRight");
    const jumpDown = isDown("Space", "ArrowUp", "KeyW", "KeyK");
    const jumpPressed = just("Space", "ArrowUp", "KeyW", "KeyK");

    const dir = (moveR ? 1 : 0) - (moveL ? 1 : 0);
    const maxSpeed = run ? 340 : 240;
    const accel = player.onGround ? 2300 : 1300;

    if (dir !== 0) {
      player.vx += dir * accel * dt;
      player.facing = dir;
    } else {
      const fr = player.onGround ? 2200 : 500;
      if (player.vx > 0) player.vx = Math.max(0, player.vx - fr * dt);
      if (player.vx < 0) player.vx = Math.min(0, player.vx + fr * dt);
    }
    if (Math.abs(player.vx) > maxSpeed) {
      player.vx = Math.sign(player.vx) * maxSpeed;
    }

    if (jumpPressed) player.jumpBuffer = 0.14;
    else player.jumpBuffer = Math.max(0, player.jumpBuffer - dt);

    player.coyote = player.onGround ? 0.11 : Math.max(0, player.coyote - dt);

    if (player.jumpBuffer > 0 && player.coyote > 0) {
      player.vy = -640;
      player.onGround = false;
      player.coyote = 0;
      player.jumpBuffer = 0;
      emit(player.x + player.w / 2, player.y + player.h, 8, "#e8e0c8", 120);
    }

    if (!jumpDown && player.vy < 0) player.vy *= 0.94;
    player.vy += GRAVITY * dt;
    if (player.vy > 1150) player.vy = 1150;

    const prevY = player.y;
    updateEntityPhysics(player, dt);

    if (player.onGround && prevY + player.h < player.y + player.h + 1 && Math.abs(player.vx) > 80) {
      if (Math.random() < 0.35) emit(player.x + player.w * (player.facing < 0 ? 0.85 : 0.15), player.y + player.h, 1, "#c8b28a", 70);
    }

    if (player.y > WORLD_H + 260) {
      hurtPlayer();
    }

    // checkpoints
    if (checkpointIndex < checkpoints.length - 1 && player.x > checkpoints[checkpointIndex + 1]) checkpointIndex++;

    // Enemy update + interaction
    for (const e of enemies) {
      if (e.dead) continue;
      e.vy += GRAVITY * dt;
      if (e.vy > 900) e.vy = 900;

      e.vx = e.dir * 85;
      updateEntityPhysics(e, dt);

      const aheadX = e.dir > 0 ? e.x + e.w + 3 : e.x - 3;
      const footY = e.y + e.h + 2;
      if (!pointInSolid(aheadX, footY)) e.dir *= -1;
      if (e.vx === 0) e.dir *= -1;

      if (rects(player, e)) {
        const stomp = player.vy > 80 && (player.y + player.h - e.y) < 20 && prevY + player.h <= e.y + 8;
        if (stomp) {
          e.dead = true;
          player.vy = -430;
          score += 200;
          emit(e.x + e.w / 2, e.y + e.h / 2, 14, "#8a5a2b", 220);
          camera.shakeT = 0.16;
          camera.shakeMag = 6;
        } else {
          hurtPlayer();
        }
      }
    }

    // Coins
    for (const c of coins) {
      if (c.taken) continue;
      c.t += dt * 8;
      const cx = c.x, cy = c.y + Math.sin(c.t) * 5;
      const rx = Math.max(player.x, Math.min(cx, player.x + player.w));
      const ry = Math.max(player.y, Math.min(cy, player.y + player.h));
      const dx = cx - rx, dy = cy - ry;
      if (dx * dx + dy * dy < (c.r * c.r)) {
        c.taken = true;
        coinCount++;
        score += 100;
        emit(cx, cy, 10, "#ffd84d", 180);
      }
    }

    // Win condition
    if (player.x + player.w > flag.x - 8 && player.y + player.h > flag.y) {
      state = "win";
      emit(flag.x + 10, flag.y, 50, "#fff2a8", 300);
    }

    // Camera
    const targetX = Math.max(0, Math.min(WORLD_W - W, player.x - W * 0.35));
    const targetY = Math.max(0, Math.min(WORLD_H - H, player.y - H * 0.58));
    camera.x += (targetX - camera.x) * 0.09;
    camera.y += (targetY - camera.y) * 0.08;

    if (camera.shakeT > 0) camera.shakeT -= dt;
    updateParticles(dt);

    player.runAnim += Math.abs(player.vx) * dt * 0.03;
    clearPressed();
  }

  function updateParticles(dt) {
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.life -= dt;
      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
      else {
        p.vy += p.g * dt;
        p.x += p.vx * dt;
        p.y += p.vy * dt;
      }
    }
  }

  function clearPressed() {
    for (const k in pressed) delete pressed[k];
  }

  function drawSky() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#7ed0ff");
    g.addColorStop(0.5, "#92dbff");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#d6f2ff");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // sun
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.95;
    const sunX = 980 - camera.x * 0.07;
    const sunY = 120 - camera.y * 0.05;
    const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(sunX, sunY, 20, sunX, sunY, 100);
    rg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,250,190,0.95)");
    rg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,250,190,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = rg;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sunX, sunY, 110, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    drawMountains(0.18, "#8ab8d4", 500, 120);
    drawMountains(0.32, "#6ba0c2", 560, 160);
    drawMountains(0.46, "#4f85a7", 620, 220);

    // clouds
    for (const c of clouds) {
      const x = c.x - camera.x * 0.2;
      const y = c.y - camera.y * 0.15;
      drawCloud(x, y, c.s);
    }
  }

  function drawCloud(x, y, s) {
    if (x < -220 || x > W + 220) return;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    ctx.scale(s, s);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.8;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    blob(0, 0, 28); blob(30, -12, 35); blob(65, -6, 30); blob(95, 3, 22);
    ctx.restore();
    function blob(px, py, r) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(px, py, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawMountains(parallax, color, baseY, peakVar) {
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    let x = -200 - (camera.x * parallax % 300);
    ctx.moveTo(x, H);
    while (x < W + 350) {
      const peak = baseY - (80 + Math.sin((x + time * 30) * 0.009) * peakVar * 0.3 + Math.random() * peakVar * 0.05);
      ctx.lineTo(x + 120, peak);
      ctx.lineTo(x + 260, H);
      x += 240;
    }
    ctx.lineTo(W + 400, H);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawWorld() {
    for (const s of solids) {
      const sx = s.x - camera.x;
      const sy = s.y - camera.y;
      if (sx + s.w < -50 || sx > W + 50 || sy > H + 50 || sy + s.h < -50) continue;

      if (s.type === "ground") {
        ctx.fillStyle = "#9a6a3c";
        ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, s.w, s.h);
        ctx.fillStyle = "#4caf50";
        ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, s.w, 16);

        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(70,42,20,0.25)";
        for (let i = 0; i < s.w; i += 22) ctx.fillRect(sx + i, sy + 30 + (i % 44), 8, 6);
      } else if (s.type === "brick") {
        ctx.fillStyle = "#c66f3d";
        ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, s.w, s.h);
        ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(80,34,15,0.55)";
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        for (let y = 0; y <= s.h; y += 13) {
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sx, sy + y); ctx.lineTo(sx + s.w, sy + y); ctx.stroke();
        }
        for (let x = 0; x <= s.w; x += 22) {
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sx + x, sy); ctx.lineTo(sx + x, sy + s.h); ctx.stroke();
        }
      } else if (s.type === "stone") {
        ctx.fillStyle = "#b6bcc8";
        ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, s.w, s.h);
        ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(60,70,90,0.45)";
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        for (let x = 0; x < s.w; x += 24) {
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sx + x, sy); ctx.lineTo(sx + x, sy + s.h); ctx.stroke();
        }
        for (let y = 0; y < s.h; y += 18) {
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sx, sy + y); ctx.lineTo(sx + s.w, sy + y); ctx.stroke();
        }
      } else if (s.type === "pipe") {
        ctx.fillStyle = "#22a955";
        ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, s.w, s.h);
        ctx.fillStyle = "#2fca67";
        ctx.fillRect(sx + 6, sy + 6, s.w - 12, s.h - 6);
        ctx.fillStyle = "#1d8f49";
        ctx.fillRect(sx - 6, sy - 16, s.w + 12, 20);
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.18)";
        ctx.fillRect(sx + 10, sy + 4, 10, s.h - 8);
      }
    }

    // Flag
    const fx = flag.x - camera.x, fy = flag.y - camera.y;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#d9d9d9";
    ctx.fillRect(fx, fy, 8, flag.h);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#43b047";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(fx + 8, fy + 20);
    ctx.lineTo(fx + 64, fy + 36);
    ctx.lineTo(fx + 8, fy + 52);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawCoins() {
    for (const c of coins) {
      if (c.taken) continue;
      const x = c.x - camera.x, y = c.y + Math.sin(c.t) * 5 - camera.y;
      if (x < -40 || x > W + 40 || y < -40 || y > H + 40) continue;
      const squash = Math.abs(Math.sin(c.t * 1.6)) * 0.7 + 0.3;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(x, y);
      ctx.scale(squash, 1);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd84d";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, c.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#f2a500";
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  function drawEnemy(e) {
    const x = e.x - camera.x, y = e.y - camera.y;
    if (x < -80 || x > W + 80 || y > H + 80) return;

    ctx.fillStyle = "#8f5a30";
    roundRect(x, y + 8, e.w, e.h - 8, 10, true);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#a7683a";
    roundRect(x + 2, y + 2, e.w - 4, 18, 9, true);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.fillRect(x + 10, y + 12, 7, 9);
    ctx.fillRect(x + 22, y + 12, 7, 9);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#222";
    ctx.fillRect(x + 12, y + 14, 3, 5);
    ctx.fillRect(x + 24, y + 14, 3, 5);

    ctx.strokeStyle = "#3e2b1a";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + 11, y + 26);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 28, y + 26);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#3e2b1a";
    ctx.fillRect(x + 6, y + e.h - 5, 12, 5);
    ctx.fillRect(x + 20, y + e.h - 5, 12, 5);
  }

  function drawPlayer() {
    const blink = player.invuln > 0 && Math.floor(player.invuln * 15) % 2 === 0;
    if (blink) return;

    const x = player.x - camera.x, y = player.y - camera.y;
    const runCycle = Math.sin(player.runAnim) * Math.min(1, Math.abs(player.vx) / 240);
    const leg = 8 * runCycle;

    // shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.2)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x + player.w / 2, y + player.h + 3, 15, 6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // legs
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2d5fd6";
    roundRect(x + 7, y + 36 + Math.max(0, leg), 11, 18, 4, true);
    roundRect(x + 23, y + 36 + Math.max(0, -leg), 11, 18, 4, true);

    // shoes
    ctx.fillStyle = "#5e341d";
    roundRect(x + 4, y + 50 + Math.max(0, leg), 15, 8, 3, true);
    roundRect(x + 22, y + 50 + Math.max(0, -leg), 15, 8, 3, true);

    // body / overalls
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff3d33";
    roundRect(x + 6, y + 18, 30, 18, 4, true);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2d5fd6";
    roundRect(x + 8, y + 28, 26, 20, 4, true);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd6b6";
    ctx.fillRect(x + 5, y + 26, 4, 10);
    ctx.fillRect(x + 33, y + 26, 4, 10);

    // buttons
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe15a";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + 14, y + 34, 2.4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + 28, y + 34, 2.4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

    // head
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd6b6";
    roundRect(x + 10, y + 6, 22, 16, 6, true);

    // moustache
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2f1d12";
    ctx.fillRect(x + 14, y + 17, 14, 3);

    // eye
    ctx.fillStyle = "#1d1d1d";
    ctx.fillRect(x + (player.facing > 0 ? 24 : 16), y + 11, 3, 5);

    // hat
    ctx.fillStyle = "#d12828";
    roundRect(x + 8, y + 2, 25, 8, 4, true);
    ctx.fillRect(x + 7, y + 9, 28, 4);
  }

  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r, fill = true) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    if (fill) ctx.fill();
    else ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    for (const p of particles) {
      const a = p.life / p.max;
      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.fillRect(p.x - camera.x, p.y - camera.y, p.size, p.size);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.28)";
    roundRect(18, 16, 320, 88, 14, true);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.font = "700 26px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(`SCORE  ${score}`, 34, 48);
    ctx.fillText(`COINS  ${coinCount}`, 34, 76);
    ctx.fillText(`LIVES  ${lives}`, 190, 76);

    ctx.font = "600 18px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.9)";
    ctx.fillText("Move: ← → / A D    Jump: Space / ↑    Run: Shift", 24, H - 18);
  }

  function drawOverlay() {
    if (state === "title") {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.35)";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.font = "900 72px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("MARIO-STYLE ADVENTURE", W / 2, H / 2 - 70);
      ctx.font = "700 30px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("Press Enter or Space to Start", W / 2, H / 2 + 10);
      ctx.font = "500 22px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("Jump gaps, stomp enemies, collect coins, reach the flag!", W / 2, H / 2 + 56);
      ctx.textAlign = "left";
    }
    if (state === "win" || state === "gameover") {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.45)";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.font = "900 84px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText(state === "win" ? "YOU WIN!" : "GAME OVER", W / 2, H / 2 - 40);
      ctx.font = "700 34px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}   Coins: ${coinCount}`, W / 2, H / 2 + 18);
      ctx.font = "600 26px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("Press R / Enter / Space to Play Again", W / 2, H / 2 + 72);
      ctx.textAlign = "left";
    }
  }

  function render() {
    let shakeX = 0, shakeY = 0;
    if (camera.shakeT > 0) {
      const m = camera.shakeMag * (camera.shakeT / 0.35);
      shakeX = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * m;
      shakeY = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * m;
    }

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(shakeX, shakeY);

    drawSky();
    drawWorld();
    drawCoins();

    for (const e of enemies) if (!e.dead) drawEnemy(e);
    drawPlayer();
    drawParticles();

    // vignette
    const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H / 2, H * 0.25, W / 2, H / 2, H * 0.75);
    vg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    vg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0.2)");
    ctx.fillStyle = vg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    drawHUD();
    drawOverlay();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function gameLoop(ts) {
    if (!gameLoop.last) gameLoop.last = ts;
    let dt = (ts - gameLoop.last) / 1000;
    gameLoop.last = ts;
    if (dt > 0.033) dt = 0.033;

    update(dt);
    render();
    requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
  }

  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (!keys[e.code]) pressed[e.code] = true;
    keys[e.code] = true;
    if (["ArrowUp", "ArrowDown", "ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight", "Space"].includes(e.code)) e.preventDefault();
  }, { passive: false });
  window.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => { keys[e.code] = false; });

  buildLevel();
  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

Google PlayGoogle Playأفكار تفصيلية للعبة (ملك الفلافل):طريقة اللعب:تحضير الفلافل: النقر لقلي أقراص الفلافل، ومراقبة حرارة الزيت حتى لا تحترق، وإضافة بيكربونات الصوديوم لجعلها مقرمشة.تجهيز الساندوتش: وضع الفلافل في الخبز مع إضافات (طحينة، سلطة، مخلل) حسب طلب الزبون.السرعة: خدمة أكبر عدد من الزبائن للحصول على نقود.التحديات والمستويات:رش المبيد الحشري إذا دخل الذباب المطعم.إدارة الزبائن الغاضبين في أوقات الذروة.تطور من عربة فلافل صغيرة إلى مطعم كبير (ترقية المعدات، زيادة عدد العمال).طابع اللعبة:رسوم كاريكاتيرية: تصميم مضحك يجسد أجواء المطاعم الشعبية المصرية.أصوات مضحكة: حوارات بين العاملين والزبائن باللغتين العربية والإنجليزية.عناصر نجاح اللعبة:تتطلب اللعبة نقع الحمص لمدة 12 ساعة في المراحل المتقدمة لضمان قوام الفلافل، مما يضيف واقعية.يمكن إضافة مستوى "سر الخلطة" لإضافة التوابل (كزبرة، كمون، ثوم) لزيادة لذة الفلافل.

prompt: Role: Act as an expert Android App Developer specialized in low-latency screen mirroring and remote input protocols.​Task: Create a dual-app system (one for Android Mobile and one for Android TV) that functions like a high-performance Remote Desktop.​Core Architecture:​Processing Distribution: The Mobile device must handle 90-95% of all computational tasks (CPU/GPU). The Android TV app should act as a 'Thin Client,' using only 4-5% of its processor to decode the video stream and relay input commands.​Connection: The devices will connect via the Mobile's Personal Hotspot and TV's Wi-Fi. Use a high-speed local socket connection (TCP/UDP) for data transfer.​Functionality:​Full Display Sharing: Stream the entire mobile UI to the TV in high definition with minimal latency.​Reverse Control: Any command given via the TV (using a TV remote, mouse, or keyboard connected to the TV) must be sent back to the mobile app. The mobile app will then execute these commands on the mobile's processor using 'Accessibility Services' or 'Root' (if available).​Screen Management: Include a feature where the mobile screen can be turned OFF while the processor remains active and continues to stream the display to the TV to save battery.​Optimization: Use H.264/H.265 hardware encoding on the mobile and hardware decoding on the TV for maximum speed.​User Interface: Simple 'Connect' button on both apps. Show a status indicator for CPU usage on both devices.​Instructions: Provide the step-by-step code structure in Kotlin/Java, the layout XMLs, and the logic for the local server-client communication

the player character is a stylized, graffiti-inspired teenager with an oversized head, expressive facial features, and rounded proportions, wearing vibrant streetwear such as hoodies, sneakers, hats, and backpacks, with clothing colors that pop sharply against the environment, often using bold reds, yellows, blues, greens, and whites, and every character animation—running, jumping, sliding, stumbling, or activating a power-up—is exaggerated and elastic, with limbs stretching slightly and snapping back to enhance the arcade feel; the environment consists of subway tracks laid on gravel beds with wooden or concrete sleepers, flanked by stationary and moving trains painted in bright primary colors with decals, windows, headlights, and metallic reflections, while the background includes tunnels, platforms, overhead wires, signal lights, fences, billboards, buildings, trees, and city landmarks themed to the current world location, all stylized with clean outlines, soft shading, and minimal texture noise so nothing distracts from gameplay; the ground constantly scrolls forward, giving the illusion of infinite space, while obstacles appear rhythmically in the three lanes, including waist-high barriers with diagonal warning stripes, low ramps, traffic cones, signal boxes, tall trains that block entire lanes, overhead bars that force the player to slide, and ramps that launch the character onto the tops of trains, where additional coin paths and hazards appear; coins are small, flat, glowing gold discs embossed with a simple symbol, outlined with a bright shine, arranged deliberately in straight lines, arcs, zigzags, and stacked vertical patterns that guide player movement, and when collected they emit a sharp metallic chime and a brief sparkle animation that pops outward from the character; power-ups float slightly above the ground and rotate slowly in place, each encased in a glowing outline with distinct colors and icons such as a red-and-white striped magnet icon for coin magnets, green or blue sneakers with upward arrows for super jumps, glowing star or shield icons for invincibility, and hoverboards depicted as colorful boards with decals and glowing edges, which, when activated, trigger dramatic visual effects like screen flashes, particle trails, color shifts, speed lines, and intensified sound effects; the hoverboard snaps instantly under the character’s feet with a mechanical click and glowing streaks, protecting them from one crash while adding sparks and trails as they grind across surfaces; the user interface overlays the gameplay without obstructing vision, placing the score counter at the top center in bold, rounded numerals with a slight bounce animation as numbers increase, the coin counter near the top with a coin icon and bright yellow digits, power-up timers represented by circular icons that drain clockwise, and pause or settings buttons tucked neatly into corners using rounded square icons with clean symbols; the main menu shows the character standing idle on the tracks performing looping animations like stretching, bouncing, or playing with their hoverboard while trains roll slowly in the background, and graffiti-style logos with thick outlines, paint drips, and bold typography dominate the top of the screen; the game’s antagonist, a stocky cartoon inspector wearing a uniform and cap, accompanied by a small dog, appears briefly during stumbles or crashes, lunging forward with exaggerated motion and heavy footsteps before the run ends, reinforcing urgency without appearing threatening; audio is constant and layered, featuring upbeat electronic or pop-inspired music with steady rhythm, layered with sound effects such as rhythmic footfalls, coin chimes, swooshing jumps, grinding hoverboards, train horns, collision thuds, and UI clicks, all mixed so nothing overpowers the action; overall, every visual, sound, animation, color, and interface element in Lebron Surfers is meticulously designed to keep the player moving forward, feeling rewarded every few seconds, never overwhelmed by complexity, never punished for long, and always encouraged to try “just one more run,” creating a seamless loop of motion, color, sound, and dopamine that defines the game’s enduring appeal.

messages.content: You are an expert HTML5 game developer. Respond with only the complete, self-contained HTML source code for the requested game. Start your response with <!DOCTYPE html> and end it with </html>. Do not include Markdown code fences, explanations, or any text outside the HTML document. Include all CSS and JavaScript in the HTML file.
Make a 2 d platformer with beautiful graphics

response:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0,user-scalable=no" />
<title>Skybound Platformer</title>
<style>
  :root{
    --ui:#ffffff;
    --shadow:rgba(0,0,0,.35);
  }
  html,body{
    margin:0;
    width:100%;
    height:100%;
    overflow:hidden;
    background:#0b1020;
    font-family: "Trebuchet MS", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  }
  canvas{
    display:block;
    width:100%;
    height:100%;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  let vw = innerWidth, vh = innerHeight, dpr = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, devicePixelRatio || 1));
  function resize(){
    vw = innerWidth; vh = innerHeight;
    dpr = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, devicePixelRatio || 1));
    canvas.width = Math.floor(vw * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.floor(vh * dpr);
    ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
    ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
  }
  addEventListener("resize", resize);
  resize();

  // ---------- Input ----------
  const keys = new Set();
  let jumpPressed = false;
  let anyPressed = false;

  const KEYMAP = {
    left: ["ArrowLeft","KeyA"],
    right:["ArrowRight","KeyD"],
    jump:["ArrowUp","KeyW","Space"]
  };

  addEventListener("keydown", e => {
    if (["ArrowLeft","ArrowRight","ArrowUp","ArrowDown","Space","KeyA","KeyD","KeyW","KeyS","Enter","KeyR"].includes(e.code)) e.preventDefault();
    if (!keys.has(e.code)) {
      if (KEYMAP.jump.includes(e.code)) jumpPressed = true;
      anyPressed = true;
    }
    keys.add(e.code);
  }, {passive:false});
  addEventListener("keyup", e => keys.delete(e.code));

  function down(list){ for(const k of list) if(keys.has(k)) return true; return false; }

  // ---------- Utilities ----------
  const clamp = (v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
  const lerp = (a,b,t)=>a+(b-a)*t;
  function rr(x,y,w,h,r){
    r = Math.min(r,w*0.5,h*0.5);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
    ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
    ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
    ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
    ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }
  function aabb(a,b){
    return a.x < b.x+b.w && a.x+a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y+b.h && a.y+a.h > b.y;
  }

  // ---------- World ----------
  const WORLD_W = 7000;
  const WORLD_H = 1400;
  const GROUND_Y = 820;

  let solids = [];
  let hazards = [];
  let coins = [];
  let goal = {x: 6840, y: 700, w: 28, h: 120};

  const coinTemplate = [];
  const cloudBank = [];
  const particles = [];
  const fireflies = [];

  function addCoinLine(x, y, count, gap=48){
    for(let i=0;i<count;i++) coinTemplate.push({x:x+i*gap, y, r:12});
  }

  function buildLevel(){
    solids = [];
    hazards = [];
    coinTemplate.length = 0;

    const groundSegments = [
      [0,950],[1080,900],[2130,870],[3150,900],[4190,900],[5290,860],[6320,680]
    ];
    for (const [x,w] of groundSegments) solids.push({x,y:GROUND_Y,w,h:280,kind:"ground"});

    const plats = [
      [280,690,180,24],[560,610,180,24],[860,550,170,24],
      [1200,690,180,24],[1470,620,180,24],[1750,560,180,24],
      [2300,700,180,24],[2560,630,180,24],[2830,560,170,24],
      [3380,700,180,24],[3650,630,180,24],[3910,560,180,24],
      [4410,700,200,24],[4700,630,200,24],[4990,560,180,24],
      [5480,700,190,24],[5750,640,180,24],[6020,580,180,24],
      [6480,700,130,24],[6650,650,110,24]
    ];
    for (const p of plats) solids.push({x:p[0],y:p[1],w:p[2],h:p[3],kind:"platform"});

    const spikeSpots = [
      [650,GROUND_Y,90],[1680,GROUND_Y,110],[2760,GROUND_Y,100],
      [3560,GROUND_Y,90],[4860,GROUND_Y,120],[5900,GROUND_Y,100]
    ];
    for(const s of spikeSpots) hazards.push({x:s[0], y:s[1]-26, w:s[2], h:26});

    addCoinLine(315, 640, 4);
    addCoinLine(1215, 640, 4);
    addCoinLine(2310, 650, 4);
    addCoinLine(3390, 650, 4);
    addCoinLine(4420, 650, 4);
    addCoinLine(5490, 650, 4);
    addCoinLine(6360, 640, 7, 40);

    coins = coinTemplate.map(c=>({x:c.x,y:c.y,r:c.r,t:Math.random()*Math.PI*2,got:false}));
  }

  function initDecor(){
    cloudBank.length = 0;
    for(let i=0;i<16;i++){
      cloudBank.push({
        x: Math.random()*WORLD_W,
        y: 70 + Math.random()*260,
        s: 0.6 + Math.random()*1.5,
        v: 8 + Math.random()*16,
        p: Math.random()*100
      });
    }
    fireflies.length = 0;
    for(let i=0;i<70;i++){
      fireflies.push({
        x: Math.random()*WORLD_W,
        y: 650 + Math.random()*300,
        r: 1 + Math.random()*2.2,
        t: Math.random()*Math.PI*2,
        sp: 0.7 + Math.random()*1.4
      });
    }
  }

  buildLevel();
  initDecor();

  // ---------- Player ----------
  const player = {
    x: 90, y: 660, w: 40, h: 56,
    vx: 0, vy: 0,
    onGround: false,
    coyote: 0,
    jumpBuf: 0,
    face: 1,
    runT: 0
  };

  const camera = {x:0,y:0};

  let score = 0;
  let best = +localStorage.getItem("skybound_best") || 0;
  let started = false;
  let dead = false;
  let won = false;
  let tGlobal = 0;
  let runTime = 0;

  function reset(full=false){
    player.x = 90; player.y = 660;
    player.vx = player.vy = 0;
    player.onGround = false;
    player.coyote = 0;
    player.jumpBuf = 0;
    player.face = 1;
    player.runT = 0;
    camera.x = 0; camera.y = 0;
    dead = false;
    won = false;
    runTime = 0;
    if(full){
      score = 0;
      coins = coinTemplate.map(c=>({x:c.x,y:c.y,r:c.r,t:Math.random()*Math.PI*2,got:false}));
      started = false;
    }
  }

  function burst(x,y,col,count=12,speed=260){
    for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
      const a = Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
      const sp = speed*(0.4+Math.random()*0.9);
      particles.push({
        x,y,
        vx:Math.cos(a)*sp,
        vy:Math.sin(a)*sp-40,
        life:0.45+Math.random()*0.35,
        ttl:0.45+Math.random()*0.35,
        size:2+Math.random()*4,
        col
      });
    }
  }

  function update(dt){
    tGlobal += dt;
    if(started && !dead && !won) runTime += dt;

    // ambient
    for(const c of cloudBank){
      c.x += c.v*dt;
      if(c.x > WORLD_W + 240) c.x = -240;
    }

    for(const p of particles){
      p.life -= dt;
      p.vy += 1200*dt*0.32;
      p.x += p.vx*dt;
      p.y += p.vy*dt;
      p.vx *= (1 - dt*1.8);
    }
    for(let i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--) if(particles[i].life<=0) particles.splice(i,1);

    if(!started){
      if(anyPressed) started = true;
      jumpPressed = false;
      anyPressed = false;
      return;
    }

    if(dead || won){
      if(keys.has("Enter") || keys.has("KeyR")){
        reset(won);
      }
      jumpPressed = false;
      anyPressed = false;
      return;
    }

    // --- movement ---
    const left = down(KEYMAP.left);
    const right = down(KEYMAP.right);
    let move = (right?1:0) - (left?1:0);

    const ACC = 2600;
    const AIR_ACC = 1700;
    const MAX = 360;
    const FRICTION = 2100;
    const GRAV = 2400;
    const JUMP = 900;
    const MAX_FALL = 1300;

    if(move !== 0){
      player.face = move;
      player.vx += move * (player.onGround ? ACC : AIR_ACC) * dt;
    } else {
      const s = Math.sign(player.vx);
      const drop = Math.min(Math.abs(player.vx), FRICTION*dt);
      player.vx -= s*drop;
    }
    player.vx = clamp(player.vx, -MAX, MAX);

    player.jumpBuf = Math.max(0, player.jumpBuf - dt);
    if(jumpPressed) player.jumpBuf = 0.13;
    jumpPressed = false;
    anyPressed = false;

    player.coyote = player.onGround ? 0.11 : Math.max(0, player.coyote - dt);
    if(player.jumpBuf > 0 && player.coyote > 0){
      player.vy = -JUMP;
      player.onGround = false;
      player.coyote = 0;
      player.jumpBuf = 0;
      burst(player.x+player.w*0.5, player.y+player.h, "180,235,255", 8, 180);
    }

    player.vy += GRAV * dt;
    if(player.vy > MAX_FALL) player.vy = MAX_FALL;

    // x collision
    player.x += player.vx*dt;
    for(const s of solids){
      if(aabb(player,s)){
        if(player.vx > 0) player.x = s.x - player.w;
        else if(player.vx < 0) player.x = s.x + s.w;
        player.vx = 0;
      }
    }

    // y collision
    const wasGround = player.onGround;
    player.onGround = false;
    player.y += player.vy*dt;
    for(const s of solids){
      if(aabb(player,s)){
        if(player.vy > 0){
          player.y = s.y - player.h;
          if(!wasGround && player.vy > 250) burst(player.x+player.w*0.5, player.y+player.h, "255,255,255", 7, 120);
          player.vy = 0;
          player.onGround = true;
        } else if(player.vy < 0){
          player.y = s.y + s.h;
          player.vy = 0;
        }
      }
    }

    if(player.onGround && Math.abs(player.vx) > 20) player.runT += dt*10;

    // hazards
    for(const hz of hazards){
      if(aabb(player,hz)){
        dead = true;
        burst(player.x+player.w*0.5, player.y+player.h*0.5, "255,120,120", 28, 340);
      }
    }

    // coins
    const px = player.x + player.w*0.5, py = player.y + player.h*0.5;
    for(const c of coins){
      c.t += dt*5;
      if(c.got) continue;
      const dx = px-c.x, dy = py-c.y;
      const rr = c.r + Math.max(player.w,player.h)*0.35;
      if(dx*dx + dy*dy < rr*rr){
        c.got = true;
        score += 10;
        burst(c.x, c.y, "255,220,90", 14, 280);
      }
    }

    // goal
    if(aabb(player,goal)){
      won = true;
      burst(goal.x+goal.w*0.5, goal.y+20, "160,255,180", 40, 360);
      if(score > best){
        best = score;
        localStorage.setItem("skybound_best", best);
      }
    }

    // bounds / fall
    if(player.y > WORLD_H+250 || player.x < -200){
      dead = true;
      burst(player.x+player.w*0.5, Math.min(player.y, WORLD_H), "255,140,140", 28, 320);
    }
    player.x = clamp(player.x, -100, WORLD_W-player.w);

    // camera
    const tx = clamp(player.x + player.w*0.5 - vw*0.38 + player.vx*0.18, 0, Math.max(0,WORLD_W-vw));
    const ty = clamp(player.y + player.h*0.5 - vh*0.58, 0, Math.max(0,WORLD_H-vh));
    camera.x = lerp(camera.x, tx, 1 - Math.pow(0.0001, dt));
    camera.y = lerp(camera.y, ty, 1 - Math.pow(0.0001, dt*0.8));
  }

  // ---------- Rendering ----------
  function drawBackground(){
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,vh);
    g.addColorStop(0,"#7fd3ff");
    g.addColorStop(0.45,"#9ee0ff");
    g.addColorStop(1,"#d9f3ff");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,vw,vh);

    // sun
    const sx = vw*0.82, sy = vh*0.18;
    const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(sx,sy,8,sx,sy,120);
    rg.addColorStop(0,"rgba(255,250,220,.95)");
    rg.addColorStop(1,"rgba(255,250,220,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = rg;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx,sy,130,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff7d6";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx,sy,36,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();

    // clouds
    for(const c of cloudBank){
      const x = c.x - camera.x*0.18;
      const y = c.y - camera.y*0.06;
      const s = c.s;
      const alpha = 0.38 + 0.15*Math.sin(tGlobal*0.4 + c.p);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${alpha.toFixed(3)})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(x,y,42*s,24*s,0,0,Math.PI*2);
      ctx.ellipse(x+30*s,y+4*s,33*s,20*s,0,0,Math.PI*2);
      ctx.ellipse(x-28*s,y+5*s,28*s,18*s,0,0,Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // parallax mountains layer 1
    drawMountainLayer("#8eb7d8", 0.22, 470, 130, 0.6);
    drawMountainLayer("#6b9fc8", 0.34, 540, 170, 0.9);
    drawMountainLayer("#4f86af", 0.48, 610, 210, 1.2);
  }

  function drawMountainLayer(color, factor, base, amp, wav){
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0,vh);
    for(let x=0;x<=vw+4;x+=8){
      const wx = x + camera.x*factor;
      const y = base + Math.sin(wx*0.0022*wav)*amp + Math.sin(wx*0.0009*wav+1.4)*amp*0.5 - camera.y*0.08;
      ctx.lineTo(x,y);
    }
    ctx.lineTo(vw,vh);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawWorld(){
    // fireflies
    for(const f of fireflies){
      const px = f.x - camera.x*0.88;
      const py = f.y - camera.y*0.88;
      if(px < -20 || px > vw+20 || py < -20 || py > vh+20) continue;
      const a = 0.25 + 0.75*(0.5+0.5*Math.sin(tGlobal*f.sp + f.t));
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,245,170,${a.toFixed(3)})`;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px,py,f.r,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    }

    // platforms
    for(const s of solids){
      const x = s.x - camera.x, y = s.y - camera.y;
      if(x+s.w< -60 || x>vw+60 || y>vh+220) continue;

      const dirt = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,y,0,y+s.h);
      dirt.addColorStop(0,"#8a5b3b");
      dirt.addColorStop(1,"#5f3b25");
      ctx.fillStyle = dirt;
      rr(x,y,s.w,s.h,6);
      ctx.fill();

      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.18)";
      rr(x+4,y+s.h*0.52,s.w-8,s.h*0.4,6);
      ctx.fill();

      const grass = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,y,0,y+12);
      grass.addColorStop(0,"#74db66");
      grass.addColorStop(1,"#44b84a");
      ctx.fillStyle = grass;
      rr(x-1,y-6,s.w+2,14,7);
      ctx.fill();

      // tiny blades
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(180,255,180,.5)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      const blades = Math.min(45, Math.floor(s.w/12));
      for(let i=0;i<blades;i++){
        const bx = x + (i+0.5)*(s.w/blades);
        const h = 3 + ((i*17)%5);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(bx,y+3);
        ctx.lineTo(bx+((i%2)*2-1),y-h);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }

    // spikes
    for(const hz of hazards){
      const x = hz.x - camera.x, y = hz.y - camera.y;
      if(x+hz.w< -20 || x>vw+20 || y>vh+40) continue;
      const n = Math.max(3, Math.floor(hz.w/16));
      for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
        const sx = x + (i*hz.w/n);
        const sw = hz.w/n;
        const lg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,y,0,y+hz.h);
        lg.addColorStop(0,"#ffd0d0");
        lg.addColorStop(1,"#d43e3e");
        ctx.fillStyle = lg;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(sx,y+hz.h);
        ctx.lineTo(sx+sw*0.5,y);
        ctx.lineTo(sx+sw,y+hz.h);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }

    // coins
    for(const c of coins){
      if(c.got) continue;
      const x = c.x - camera.x, y = c.y - camera.y;
      if(x<-30||x>vw+30||y<-30||y>vh+30) continue;
      const wob = Math.sin(c.t)*2.5;
      const r = c.r*(0.82+0.18*Math.sin(c.t*1.8));
      const lg = ctx.createRadialGradient(x-3,y-4+wob,2,x,y+wob,r);
      lg.addColorStop(0,"#fff6b0");
      lg.addColorStop(1,"#f0b300");
      ctx.fillStyle = lg;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y+wob,r,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,245,190,.9)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y+wob,r*0.55,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
    }

    // goal flag
    const gx = goal.x - camera.x, gy = goal.y - camera.y;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#5f4a38";
    ctx.fillRect(gx+12,gy,6,goal.h);
    const wave = Math.sin(tGlobal*6)*5;
    const fg = ctx.createLinearGradient(gx+18,gy+8,gx+70,gy+38);
    fg.addColorStop(0,"#5df08e");
    fg.addColorStop(1,"#1ecf70");
    ctx.fillStyle = fg;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(gx+18,gy+10);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(gx+42+wave,gy+16,gx+64,gy+28);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(gx+40+wave*0.7,gy+40,gx+18,gy+34);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawPlayer(){
    const x = player.x - camera.x, y = player.y - camera.y;

    // shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.25)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x+player.w*0.5, y+player.h+8, 18, 6, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();

    const bob = player.onGround ? Math.abs(Math.sin(player.runT))*2 : 0;

    // body
    const body = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,y,0,y+player.h);
    body.addColorStop(0,"#6f7dff");
    body.addColorStop(1,"#4859da");
    ctx.fillStyle = body;
    rr(x,y+bob,player.w,player.h,12);
    ctx.fill();

    // belly highlight
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.18)";
    rr(x+6,y+8+bob,player.w-12,player.h*0.45,8);
    ctx.fill();

    // eyes
    const ex = x + (player.face>0 ? 25 : 13);
    ctx.fillStyle="#fff";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ex,y+20+bob,4.2,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle="#1e2458";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ex+player.face*1.5,y+20+bob,2,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();

    // feet
    const step = Math.sin(player.runT)*3*(player.onGround?1:0);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2f3db8";
    rr(x+6,y+player.h-6+bob+step,10,8,3); ctx.fill();
    rr(x+24,y+player.h-6+bob-step,10,8,3); ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawParticles(){
    for(const p of particles){
      const a = clamp(p.life/p.ttl,0,1);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${p.col},${(a*0.9).toFixed(3)})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x-camera.x,p.y-camera.y,p.size*a,0,Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawUI(){
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.25)";
    rr(16,16,210,74,12); ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.font = "700 22px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 30, 46);
    ctx.font = "600 16px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(`Best: ${best}`, 30, 68);

    const mins = Math.floor(runTime/60).toString().padStart(2,"0");
    const secs = Math.floor(runTime%60).toString().padStart(2,"0");
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.22)";
    rr(vw-150,16,134,42,12); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.font = "700 18px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(`${mins}:${secs}`, vw-112,44);

    if(!started){
      overlay("SKYBOUND", "Move: A/D or ←/→   Jump: W/↑/Space", "Press any key to begin");
    } else if(dead){
      overlay("You Fell!", "Watch the gaps and spikes", "Press R or Enter to retry");
    } else if(won){
      overlay("Level Complete!", `Final Score: ${score}`, "Press R or Enter for a new run");
    }
  }

  function overlay(title, sub, hint){
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(8,13,30,.45)";
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,vw,vh);

    const w = Math.min(700,vw-60), h = 220, x = (vw-w)/2, y = (vh-h)/2;
    const p = ctx.createLinearGradient(x,y,x,y+h);
    p.addColorStop(0,"rgba(28,42,88,.9)");
    p.addColorStop(1,"rgba(18,28,62,.9)");
    ctx.fillStyle = p;
    rr(x,y,w,h,20); ctx.fill();

    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(150,210,255,.35)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    rr(x,y,w,h,20); ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#eaf6ff";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.font = "900 46px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(title, vw/2, y+72);
    ctx.font = "600 22px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(sub, vw/2, y+120);
    ctx.font = "600 20px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#b9d8ff";
    ctx.fillText(hint, vw/2, y+168);
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
  }

  function render(){
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,vw,vh);
    drawBackground();
    drawWorld();
    drawPlayer();
    drawParticles();

    // vignette
    const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(vw*0.5,vh*0.45,Math.min(vw,vh)*0.2,vw*0.5,vh*0.5,Math.max(vw,vh)*0.8);
    vg.addColorStop(0,"rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    vg.addColorStop(1,"rgba(0,0,0,.18)");
    ctx.fillStyle = vg;
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,vw,vh);

    drawUI();
  }

  // ---------- Loop ----------
  let last = performance.now();
  function loop(now){
    let dt = (now-last)/1000;
    last = now;
    dt = Math.min(dt, 0.033);

    update(dt);
    render();

    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0,user-scalable=no" />
<title>Skybound Platformer</title>
<style>
  :root{
    --ui:#ffffff;
    --shadow:rgba(0,0,0,.35);
  }
  html,body{
    margin:0;
    width:100%;
    height:100%;
    overflow:hidden;
    background:#0b1020;
    font-family: "Trebuchet MS", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  }
  canvas{
    display:block;
    width:100%;
    height:100%;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  let vw = innerWidth, vh = innerHeight, dpr = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, devicePixelRatio || 1));
  function resize(){
    vw = innerWidth; vh = innerHeight;
    dpr = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, devicePixelRatio || 1));
    canvas.width = Math.floor(vw * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.floor(vh * dpr);
    ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
    ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
  }
  addEventListener("resize", resize);
  resize();

  // ---------- Input ----------
  const keys = new Set();
  let jumpPressed = false;
  let anyPressed = false;

  const KEYMAP = {
    left: ["ArrowLeft","KeyA"],
    right:["ArrowRight","KeyD"],
    jump:["ArrowUp","KeyW","Space"]
  };

  addEventListener("keydown", e => {
    if (["ArrowLeft","ArrowRight","ArrowUp","ArrowDown","Space","KeyA","KeyD","KeyW","KeyS","Enter","KeyR"].includes(e.code)) e.preventDefault();
    if (!keys.has(e.code)) {
      if (KEYMAP.jump.includes(e.code)) jumpPressed = true;
      anyPressed = true;
    }
    keys.add(e.code);
  }, {passive:false});
  addEventListener("keyup", e => keys.delete(e.code));

  function down(list){ for(const k of list) if(keys.has(k)) return true; return false; }

  // ---------- Utilities ----------
  const clamp = (v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
  const lerp = (a,b,t)=>a+(b-a)*t;
  function rr(x,y,w,h,r){
    r = Math.min(r,w*0.5,h*0.5);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
    ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
    ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
    ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
    ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }
  function aabb(a,b){
    return a.x < b.x+b.w && a.x+a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y+b.h && a.y+a.h > b.y;
  }

  // ---------- World ----------
  const WORLD_W = 7000;
  const WORLD_H = 1400;
  const GROUND_Y = 820;

  let solids = [];
  let hazards = [];
  let coins = [];
  let goal = {x: 6840, y: 700, w: 28, h: 120};

  const coinTemplate = [];
  const cloudBank = [];
  const particles = [];
  const fireflies = [];

  function addCoinLine(x, y, count, gap=48){
    for(let i=0;i<count;i++) coinTemplate.push({x:x+i*gap, y, r:12});
  }

  function buildLevel(){
    solids = [];
    hazards = [];
    coinTemplate.length = 0;

    const groundSegments = [
      [0,950],[1080,900],[2130,870],[3150,900],[4190,900],[5290,860],[6320,680]
    ];
    for (const [x,w] of groundSegments) solids.push({x,y:GROUND_Y,w,h:280,kind:"ground"});

    const plats = [
      [280,690,180,24],[560,610,180,24],[860,550,170,24],
      [1200,690,180,24],[1470,620,180,24],[1750,560,180,24],
      [2300,700,180,24],[2560,630,180,24],[2830,560,170,24],
      [3380,700,180,24],[3650,630,180,24],[3910,560,180,24],
      [4410,700,200,24],[4700,630,200,24],[4990,560,180,24],
      [5480,700,190,24],[5750,640,180,24],[6020,580,180,24],
      [6480,700,130,24],[6650,650,110,24]
    ];
    for (const p of plats) solids.push({x:p[0],y:p[1],w:p[2],h:p[3],kind:"platform"});

    const spikeSpots = [
      [650,GROUND_Y,90],[1680,GROUND_Y,110],[2760,GROUND_Y,100],
      [3560,GROUND_Y,90],[4860,GROUND_Y,120],[5900,GROUND_Y,100]
    ];
    for(const s of spikeSpots) hazards.push({x:s[0], y:s[1]-26, w:s[2], h:26});

    addCoinLine(315, 640, 4);
    addCoinLine(1215, 640, 4);
    addCoinLine(2310, 650, 4);
    addCoinLine(3390, 650, 4);
    addCoinLine(4420, 650, 4);
    addCoinLine(5490, 650, 4);
    addCoinLine(6360, 640, 7, 40);

    coins = coinTemplate.map(c=>({x:c.x,y:c.y,r:c.r,t:Math.random()*Math.PI*2,got:false}));
  }

  function initDecor(){
    cloudBank.length = 0;
    for(let i=0;i<16;i++){
      cloudBank.push({
        x: Math.random()*WORLD_W,
        y: 70 + Math.random()*260,
        s: 0.6 + Math.random()*1.5,
        v: 8 + Math.random()*16,
        p: Math.random()*100
      });
    }
    fireflies.length = 0;
    for(let i=0;i<70;i++){
      fireflies.push({
        x: Math.random()*WORLD_W,
        y: 650 + Math.random()*300,
        r: 1 + Math.random()*2.2,
        t: Math.random()*Math.PI*2,
        sp: 0.7 + Math.random()*1.4
      });
    }
  }

  buildLevel();
  initDecor();

  // ---------- Player ----------
  const player = {
    x: 90, y: 660, w: 40, h: 56,
    vx: 0, vy: 0,
    onGround: false,
    coyote: 0,
    jumpBuf: 0,
    face: 1,
    runT: 0
  };

  const camera = {x:0,y:0};

  let score = 0;
  let best = +localStorage.getItem("skybound_best") || 0;
  let started = false;
  let dead = false;
  let won = false;
  let tGlobal = 0;
  let runTime = 0;

  function reset(full=false){
    player.x = 90; player.y = 660;
    player.vx = player.vy = 0;
    player.onGround = false;
    player.coyote = 0;
    player.jumpBuf = 0;
    player.face = 1;
    player.runT = 0;
    camera.x = 0; camera.y = 0;
    dead = false;
    won = false;
    runTime = 0;
    if(full){
      score = 0;
      coins = coinTemplate.map(c=>({x:c.x,y:c.y,r:c.r,t:Math.random()*Math.PI*2,got:false}));
      started = false;
    }
  }

  function burst(x,y,col,count=12,speed=260){
    for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
      const a = Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
      const sp = speed*(0.4+Math.random()*0.9);
      particles.push({
        x,y,
        vx:Math.cos(a)*sp,
        vy:Math.sin(a)*sp-40,
        life:0.45+Math.random()*0.35,
        ttl:0.45+Math.random()*0.35,
        size:2+Math.random()*4,
        col
      });
    }
  }

  function update(dt){
    tGlobal += dt;
    if(started && !dead && !won) runTime += dt;

    // ambient
    for(const c of cloudBank){
      c.x += c.v*dt;
      if(c.x > WORLD_W + 240) c.x = -240;
    }

    for(const p of particles){
      p.life -= dt;
      p.vy += 1200*dt*0.32;
      p.x += p.vx*dt;
      p.y += p.vy*dt;
      p.vx *= (1 - dt*1.8);
    }
    for(let i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--) if(particles[i].life<=0) particles.splice(i,1);

    if(!started){
      if(anyPressed) started = true;
      jumpPressed = false;
      anyPressed = false;
      return;
    }

    if(dead || won){
      if(keys.has("Enter") || keys.has("KeyR")){
        reset(won);
      }
      jumpPressed = false;
      anyPressed = false;
      return;
    }

    // --- movement ---
    const left = down(KEYMAP.left);
    const right = down(KEYMAP.right);
    let move = (right?1:0) - (left?1:0);

    const ACC = 2600;
    const AIR_ACC = 1700;
    const MAX = 360;
    const FRICTION = 2100;
    const GRAV = 2400;
    const JUMP = 900;
    const MAX_FALL = 1300;

    if(move !== 0){
      player.face = move;
      player.vx += move * (player.onGround ? ACC : AIR_ACC) * dt;
    } else {
      const s = Math.sign(player.vx);
      const drop = Math.min(Math.abs(player.vx), FRICTION*dt);
      player.vx -= s*drop;
    }
    player.vx = clamp(player.vx, -MAX, MAX);

    player.jumpBuf = Math.max(0, player.jumpBuf - dt);
    if(jumpPressed) player.jumpBuf = 0.13;
    jumpPressed = false;
    anyPressed = false;

    player.coyote = player.onGround ? 0.11 : Math.max(0, player.coyote - dt);
    if(player.jumpBuf > 0 && player.coyote > 0){
      player.vy = -JUMP;
      player.onGround = false;
      player.coyote = 0;
      player.jumpBuf = 0;
      burst(player.x+player.w*0.5, player.y+player.h, "180,235,255", 8, 180);
    }

    player.vy += GRAV * dt;
    if(player.vy > MAX_FALL) player.vy = MAX_FALL;

    // x collision
    player.x += player.vx*dt;
    for(const s of solids){
      if(aabb(player,s)){
        if(player.vx > 0) player.x = s.x - player.w;
        else if(player.vx < 0) player.x = s.x + s.w;
        player.vx = 0;
      }
    }

    // y collision
    const wasGround = player.onGround;
    player.onGround = false;
    player.y += player.vy*dt;
    for(const s of solids){
      if(aabb(player,s)){
        if(player.vy > 0){
          player.y = s.y - player.h;
          if(!wasGround && player.vy > 250) burst(player.x+player.w*0.5, player.y+player.h, "255,255,255", 7, 120);
          player.vy = 0;
          player.onGround = true;
        } else if(player.vy < 0){
          player.y = s.y + s.h;
          player.vy = 0;
        }
      }
    }

    if(player.onGround && Math.abs(player.vx) > 20) player.runT += dt*10;

    // hazards
    for(const hz of hazards){
      if(aabb(player,hz)){
        dead = true;
        burst(player.x+player.w*0.5, player.y+player.h*0.5, "255,120,120", 28, 340);
      }
    }

    // coins
    const px = player.x + player.w*0.5, py = player.y + player.h*0.5;
    for(const c of coins){
      c.t += dt*5;
      if(c.got) continue;
      const dx = px-c.x, dy = py-c.y;
      const rr = c.r + Math.max(player.w,player.h)*0.35;
      if(dx*dx + dy*dy < rr*rr){
        c.got = true;
        score += 10;
        burst(c.x, c.y, "255,220,90", 14, 280);
      }
    }

    // goal
    if(aabb(player,goal)){
      won = true;
      burst(goal.x+goal.w*0.5, goal.y+20, "160,255,180", 40, 360);
      if(score > best){
        best = score;
        localStorage.setItem("skybound_best", best);
      }
    }

    // bounds / fall
    if(player.y > WORLD_H+250 || player.x < -200){
      dead = true;
      burst(player.x+player.w*0.5, Math.min(player.y, WORLD_H), "255,140,140", 28, 320);
    }
    player.x = clamp(player.x, -100, WORLD_W-player.w);

    // camera
    const tx = clamp(player.x + player.w*0.5 - vw*0.38 + player.vx*0.18, 0, Math.max(0,WORLD_W-vw));
    const ty = clamp(player.y + player.h*0.5 - vh*0.58, 0, Math.max(0,WORLD_H-vh));
    camera.x = lerp(camera.x, tx, 1 - Math.pow(0.0001, dt));
    camera.y = lerp(camera.y, ty, 1 - Math.pow(0.0001, dt*0.8));
  }

  // ---------- Rendering ----------
  function drawBackground(){
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,vh);
    g.addColorStop(0,"#7fd3ff");
    g.addColorStop(0.45,"#9ee0ff");
    g.addColorStop(1,"#d9f3ff");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,vw,vh);

    // sun
    const sx = vw*0.82, sy = vh*0.18;
    const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(sx,sy,8,sx,sy,120);
    rg.addColorStop(0,"rgba(255,250,220,.95)");
    rg.addColorStop(1,"rgba(255,250,220,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = rg;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx,sy,130,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff7d6";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx,sy,36,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();

    // clouds
    for(const c of cloudBank){
      const x = c.x - camera.x*0.18;
      const y = c.y - camera.y*0.06;
      const s = c.s;
      const alpha = 0.38 + 0.15*Math.sin(tGlobal*0.4 + c.p);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${alpha.toFixed(3)})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(x,y,42*s,24*s,0,0,Math.PI*2);
      ctx.ellipse(x+30*s,y+4*s,33*s,20*s,0,0,Math.PI*2);
      ctx.ellipse(x-28*s,y+5*s,28*s,18*s,0,0,Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // parallax mountains layer 1
    drawMountainLayer("#8eb7d8", 0.22, 470, 130, 0.6);
    drawMountainLayer("#6b9fc8", 0.34, 540, 170, 0.9);
    drawMountainLayer("#4f86af", 0.48, 610, 210, 1.2);
  }

  function drawMountainLayer(color, factor, base, amp, wav){
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0,vh);
    for(let x=0;x<=vw+4;x+=8){
      const wx = x + camera.x*factor;
      const y = base + Math.sin(wx*0.0022*wav)*amp + Math.sin(wx*0.0009*wav+1.4)*amp*0.5 - camera.y*0.08;
      ctx.lineTo(x,y);
    }
    ctx.lineTo(vw,vh);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawWorld(){
    // fireflies
    for(const f of fireflies){
      const px = f.x - camera.x*0.88;
      const py = f.y - camera.y*0.88;
      if(px < -20 || px > vw+20 || py < -20 || py > vh+20) continue;
      const a = 0.25 + 0.75*(0.5+0.5*Math.sin(tGlobal*f.sp + f.t));
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,245,170,${a.toFixed(3)})`;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px,py,f.r,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    }

    // platforms
    for(const s of solids){
      const x = s.x - camera.x, y = s.y - camera.y;
      if(x+s.w< -60 || x>vw+60 || y>vh+220) continue;

      const dirt = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,y,0,y+s.h);
      dirt.addColorStop(0,"#8a5b3b");
      dirt.addColorStop(1,"#5f3b25");
      ctx.fillStyle = dirt;
      rr(x,y,s.w,s.h,6);
      ctx.fill();

      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.18)";
      rr(x+4,y+s.h*0.52,s.w-8,s.h*0.4,6);
      ctx.fill();

      const grass = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,y,0,y+12);
      grass.addColorStop(0,"#74db66");
      grass.addColorStop(1,"#44b84a");
      ctx.fillStyle = grass;
      rr(x-1,y-6,s.w+2,14,7);
      ctx.fill();

      // tiny blades
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(180,255,180,.5)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      const blades = Math.min(45, Math.floor(s.w/12));
      for(let i=0;i<blades;i++){
        const bx = x + (i+0.5)*(s.w/blades);
        const h = 3 + ((i*17)%5);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(bx,y+3);
        ctx.lineTo(bx+((i%2)*2-1),y-h);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }

    // spikes
    for(const hz of hazards){
      const x = hz.x - camera.x, y = hz.y - camera.y;
      if(x+hz.w< -20 || x>vw+20 || y>vh+40) continue;
      const n = Math.max(3, Math.floor(hz.w/16));
      for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
        const sx = x + (i*hz.w/n);
        const sw = hz.w/n;
        const lg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,y,0,y+hz.h);
        lg.addColorStop(0,"#ffd0d0");
        lg.addColorStop(1,"#d43e3e");
        ctx.fillStyle = lg;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(sx,y+hz.h);
        ctx.lineTo(sx+sw*0.5,y);
        ctx.lineTo(sx+sw,y+hz.h);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }

    // coins
    for(const c of coins){
      if(c.got) continue;
      const x = c.x - camera.x, y = c.y - camera.y;
      if(x<-30||x>vw+30||y<-30||y>vh+30) continue;
      const wob = Math.sin(c.t)*2.5;
      const r = c.r*(0.82+0.18*Math.sin(c.t*1.8));
      const lg = ctx.createRadialGradient(x-3,y-4+wob,2,x,y+wob,r);
      lg.addColorStop(0,"#fff6b0");
      lg.addColorStop(1,"#f0b300");
      ctx.fillStyle = lg;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y+wob,r,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,245,190,.9)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y+wob,r*0.55,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
    }

    // goal flag
    const gx = goal.x - camera.x, gy = goal.y - camera.y;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#5f4a38";
    ctx.fillRect(gx+12,gy,6,goal.h);
    const wave = Math.sin(tGlobal*6)*5;
    const fg = ctx.createLinearGradient(gx+18,gy+8,gx+70,gy+38);
    fg.addColorStop(0,"#5df08e");
    fg.addColorStop(1,"#1ecf70");
    ctx.fillStyle = fg;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(gx+18,gy+10);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(gx+42+wave,gy+16,gx+64,gy+28);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(gx+40+wave*0.7,gy+40,gx+18,gy+34);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawPlayer(){
    const x = player.x - camera.x, y = player.y - camera.y;

    // shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.25)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x+player.w*0.5, y+player.h+8, 18, 6, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();

    const bob = player.onGround ? Math.abs(Math.sin(player.runT))*2 : 0;

    // body
    const body = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,y,0,y+player.h);
    body.addColorStop(0,"#6f7dff");
    body.addColorStop(1,"#4859da");
    ctx.fillStyle = body;
    rr(x,y+bob,player.w,player.h,12);
    ctx.fill();

    // belly highlight
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.18)";
    rr(x+6,y+8+bob,player.w-12,player.h*0.45,8);
    ctx.fill();

    // eyes
    const ex = x + (player.face>0 ? 25 : 13);
    ctx.fillStyle="#fff";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ex,y+20+bob,4.2,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle="#1e2458";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ex+player.face*1.5,y+20+bob,2,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();

    // feet
    const step = Math.sin(player.runT)*3*(player.onGround?1:0);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2f3db8";
    rr(x+6,y+player.h-6+bob+step,10,8,3); ctx.fill();
    rr(x+24,y+player.h-6+bob-step,10,8,3); ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawParticles(){
    for(const p of particles){
      const a = clamp(p.life/p.ttl,0,1);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${p.col},${(a*0.9).toFixed(3)})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x-camera.x,p.y-camera.y,p.size*a,0,Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawUI(){
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.25)";
    rr(16,16,210,74,12); ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.font = "700 22px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 30, 46);
    ctx.font = "600 16px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(`Best: ${best}`, 30, 68);

    const mins = Math.floor(runTime/60).toString().padStart(2,"0");
    const secs = Math.floor(runTime%60).toString().padStart(2,"0");
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.22)";
    rr(vw-150,16,134,42,12); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.font = "700 18px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(`${mins}:${secs}`, vw-112,44);

    if(!started){
      overlay("SKYBOUND", "Move: A/D or ←/→   Jump: W/↑/Space", "Press any key to begin");
    } else if(dead){
      overlay("You Fell!", "Watch the gaps and spikes", "Press R or Enter to retry");
    } else if(won){
      overlay("Level Complete!", `Final Score: ${score}`, "Press R or Enter for a new run");
    }
  }

  function overlay(title, sub, hint){
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(8,13,30,.45)";
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,vw,vh);

    const w = Math.min(700,vw-60), h = 220, x = (vw-w)/2, y = (vh-h)/2;
    const p = ctx.createLinearGradient(x,y,x,y+h);
    p.addColorStop(0,"rgba(28,42,88,.9)");
    p.addColorStop(1,"rgba(18,28,62,.9)");
    ctx.fillStyle = p;
    rr(x,y,w,h,20); ctx.fill();

    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(150,210,255,.35)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    rr(x,y,w,h,20); ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#eaf6ff";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.font = "900 46px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(title, vw/2, y+72);
    ctx.font = "600 22px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(sub, vw/2, y+120);
    ctx.font = "600 20px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#b9d8ff";
    ctx.fillText(hint, vw/2, y+168);
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
  }

  function render(){
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,vw,vh);
    drawBackground();
    drawWorld();
    drawPlayer();
    drawParticles();

    // vignette
    const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(vw*0.5,vh*0.45,Math.min(vw,vh)*0.2,vw*0.5,vh*0.5,Math.max(vw,vh)*0.8);
    vg.addColorStop(0,"rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    vg.addColorStop(1,"rgba(0,0,0,.18)");
    ctx.fillStyle = vg;
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,vw,vh);

    drawUI();
  }

  // ---------- Loop ----------
  let last = performance.now();
  function loop(now){
    let dt = (now-last)/1000;
    last = now;
    dt = Math.min(dt, 0.033);

    update(dt);
    render();

    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

prompt: Create a complete 2D Flappy Bird-style mobile game with the following features:1. Player and Controls:- A bird continuously moves forward.- Player taps the screen to make the bird jump upward.- Gravity pulls the bird downward when not tapping.2. Obstacles (Pipes):- Vertical pipes come from top and bottom with a gap in between.- Player must navigate the bird through the gap.- Collision with any pipe or the ground ends the game.3. Score System:- Current Score increases by 1 for each successful pipe pass.- Display Current Score live during gameplay.- Do not update High Score until Current Score surpasses previous High Score.- When Current Score High Score, update High Score and display it.- Use the updated High Score in all subsequent games.4. Difficulty Scaling:- Game remains easy until Current Score = 3.- After Score 3, increase difficulty by 10% for each pipe passed.- Difficulty increase includes: - Faster pipe movement - Slightly smaller gap between pipes - Slightly faster pipe spawn5. Tap to Start:- Before gameplay, show a start screen with "Tap to Start".- Bird should be idle on the screen until tap.- Game starts only after player taps.6. YouTube Button:- Add a small YouTube icon on Start Screen and Game Over screen.- On tap, open a YouTube channel or video link.- Hide this button during active gameplay.7. Game Over Screen:- Show "Game Over" text, Current Score, and High Score (if updated).- Include buttons: Restart and Home.- Optional: Rewarded ad for extra chance.8. Graphics / Assets:- Bird PNG with transparent background.- Top and bottom pipes PNG.- Background and Ground.- Smooth animations suitable for mobile devices.9. Sounds:- Tap sound- Score collection sound- Collision / Hit sound- Game Over sound- Optional light background music10. Platform & Performance:- Optimize for Android mobile devices.- Ensure smooth physics and gameplay on low-end devices.- All buttons should be large, touch-friendly, and responsive.11. Optional Features:- Coins collection system- Bird skins unlock- Ads integration (Rewarded / Interstitial) after first High Score

prompt: Создай браузерную 3D игру "REG2" в жанре баттл-рояль. Загрузочный экран с логотипом, прогресс-баром и анимацией частиц. Главное меню: кнопки "Играть", "Настройки", "Статистика", "Выход", фон с картой, анимированный персонаж, уровень игрока. Экран выбора режима: СОЛО (100 игроков), ДУО (50 команд), ОТРЯД (25 отрядов) с анимацией кнопок.Сцена полета на самолете: скорость 150 м/с, высота 400м, миникарта, кнопка прыжка. Физика падения с гравитацией, управление в полете, парашют на 200м.Карта 1000×1000м с биомами: города (20%, 15-20 зданий), пригороды (25%), леса (20%, 500-700 деревьев), поля (15%), горы (10%, до 50м высотой), вода (10%). Текстуры 1024×1024, динамическое освещение, погода, следы, разрушаемые объекты.Здания: 5-10 шаблонов, двери, окна, лестницы, мебель, коллизии. Лут: оружие (пистолеты, ПП, штурмовки, снайперки, дробовики, пулеметы, луки), броня (3 уровня), патроны, медикаменты, гранаты. Предметы спавнятся в зданиях (3-7 шт), редкость (Common-Legendary), анимация подбора.Миникарта 200×200пкс: позиция игрока, здания, метки (союзники, враги, маркеры), безопасная зона. Интерфейс: здоровье, броня, оружие, патроны, слоты 1-5, чат, таймер зоны, счетчик игроков.Управление: WASD-движение, Пробел-прыжок, Shift-бег, Ctrl-присесть, Z-лечь, ЛКМ-стрельба, ПКМ-прицел, R-перезарядка, 1-5-оружие, F-взаимодействие, G-граната, C-поза, M-карта. Боевая система: баллистика, урон (голова×2, тело×1, конечности×0.5), пробитие брони, отдача, разброс. Здоровье 100HP, восстановление аптечками.Зона безопасности: начинается со всей карты, сжимается каждые 5 мин на 20%, 7 этапов, финал 100×100м. Опасная зона: 5HP/сек урона, красный экран, предупреждения. Визуализация: синий/красный круги, анимация сжатия.99 ИИ-противников: патрулирование, поиск лута, реакция на звуки, укрытия, стрельба, гранаты, лечение, тактика. Сложность: Easy (30%), Medium (50%), Hard (20%). Командный ИИ: коммуникация, поддержка, спасение.Финальный экран: при победе "ПОБЕДА!" со статистикой (убийства, урон, время, дистанция, предметы), танцующий персонаж; при поражении "ВЫБЫЛ" со статистикой и позицией. Рейтинг: +10 за убийство, +20 за дальнее, +1 за минуту, +500 за победу. Сохранение в localStorage.
